### Create `apps/api/test/handover.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { crc32 } from "node:zlib";
import { unzipSync } from "fflate";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { MEDIA_SIZES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { isStoredName, runHandover, storedName, zipStored } from "../src/handover";
import { storedImageName } from "../src/media";

const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);
const sha256 = (data: Buffer | Uint8Array) => createHash("sha256").update(data).digest("hex");

/**
 * The hand-over's program (3f design, section 7.14 step 2; invariant 16), as a unit: against a store of harmless files
 * that are not images, in a temporary directory. The archive's entries equal the list byte for byte and are stored, not
 * compressed; a name outside the store's layout, a missing file and a list that names a file twice are refused with no
 * archive; the printed digests are the files' and the archive's. The store's naming rule exists twice, exported by the
 * media module and copied in handover.ts: the two are fed the same names and must agree.
 */
describe("the hand-over's program", () => {
  const dirs: string[] = [];
  afterEach(() => {
    for (const dir of dirs.splice(0)) rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  /** A store with these images' files, each size a few harmless bytes of its own, and an empty directory for the archive. */
  function store(ids: string[]) {
    const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-handover-"));
    dirs.push(root);
    const storeDir = path.join(root, "store");
    const out = path.join(root, "out");
    mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
    const files = new Map<string, Buffer>();
    for (const id of ids) {
      for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
        const name = storedName(id, size);
        const data = Buffer.from(`not an image: ${size} of ${id} ${"x".repeat(size === "large" ? 300 : 30)}`, "utf8");
        mkdirSync(path.join(storeDir, ...name.split("/").slice(0, -1)), { recursive: true });
        writeFileSync(path.join(storeDir, ...name.split("/")), data);
        files.set(name, data);
      }
    }
    return { storeDir, out, files };
  }
  async function run(input: string, storeDir: string, out: string) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const errors: string[] = [];
    const code = await runHandover({ input, store: storeDir, out, log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => errors.push(line) });
    return { code, lines, errors };
  }

  test("the store's naming rule in its two copies: the media module's and the program's give the same names, and the program accepts exactly those", () => {
    for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
      const id = randomUUID();
      for (const size of MEDIA_SIZES) {
        expect(storedName(id, size)).toBe(storedImageName(id, size));
        expect(isStoredName(storedImageName(id, size))).toBe(true);
      }
    }
    const id = randomUUID();
    const other = randomUUID();
    for (const name of [
      `files/${other.slice(0, 2) === id.slice(0, 2) ? "zz" : other.slice(0, 2)}/${id}/small.webp`,
      `files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/${id}/huge.webp`,
      `files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/${id.toUpperCase()}/small.webp`,
      `files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/../../${id}/small.webp`,
      `/etc/passwd`,
      `results/${id}.json`,
      `files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/${id}/small.webp/x`,
      `files/${id.slice(0, 2)}/${id}/small.webp${String.fromCharCode(0)}`,
      `files${String.fromCharCode(92)}${id.slice(0, 2)}${String.fromCharCode(92)}${id}${String.fromCharCode(92)}small.webp`,
      "",
    ]) {
      expect(isStoredName(name), JSON.stringify(name)).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(() => storedName("not-an-id", "small")).toThrow();
    expect(() => storedImageName("not-an-id", "small")).toThrow();
  });

  test("copies exactly the listed files, byte for byte, into one archive of stored entries, and prints each file's and the archive's size and SHA-256", async () => {
    const ids = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const s = store(ids);
    const production = randomUUID();
    const names = [...s.files.keys()];
    const done = await run([`production ${production}`, ...names, ""].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out);
    expect(done.errors).toEqual([]);
    expect(done.code).toBe(0);
    const archivePath = path.join(s.out, `handover-${production}.zip`);
    const archive = readFileSync(archivePath);
    expect(done.lines).toEqual([...names.map((name) => `${name} ${s.files.get(name)!.length} ${sha256(s.files.get(name)!)}`), `archive ${archive.length} ${sha256(archive)}`]);
    // A ZIP reader finds exactly the listed entries, with the files' bytes.
    const entries = unzipSync(new Uint8Array(archive));
    expect(Object.keys(entries)).toEqual(names);
    for (const name of names) expect(Buffer.from(entries[name]!)).toEqual(s.files.get(name));
    // Each local header: stored (method 0), with the file's own CRC-32 and size twice, then the bytes as they are.
    let at = 0;
    for (const name of names) {
      const data = s.files.get(name)!;
      expect(archive.readUInt32LE(at)).toBe(0x04034b50);
      expect(archive.readUInt16LE(at + 8)).toBe(0);
      expect(archive.readUInt32LE(at + 14)).toBe(crc32(data));
      expect([archive.readUInt32LE(at + 18), archive.readUInt32LE(at + 22)]).toEqual([data.length, data.length]);
      const nameLength = archive.readUInt16LE(at + 26);
      expect(archive.subarray(at + 30, at + 30 + nameLength).toString("utf8")).toBe(name);
      expect(archive.subarray(at + 30 + nameLength, at + 30 + nameLength + data.length)).toEqual(data);
      at += 30 + nameLength + data.length;
    }
    // A second run never overwrites the archive of the first.
    const again = await run([`production ${production}`, ...names].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out);
    expect(again.code).toBe(1);
    expect(again.lines).toEqual([]);
    expect(readFileSync(archivePath)).toEqual(archive);
  });

  test("refuses a name outside the store's layout, a missing file, a list without its production and a file named twice, each with no archive", async () => {
    const id = randomUUID();
    const s = store([id]);
    const production = randomUUID();
    const target = path.join(s.out, `handover-${production}.zip`);
    const names = [...s.files.keys()];
    const outside = await run([`production ${production}`, names[0], "../../outside.webp"].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out);
    expect([outside.code, outside.lines, outside.errors]).toEqual([1, [], ['handover: refused: "../../outside.webp" is outside the store']]);
    const missing = storedName(randomUUID(), "small");
    const gone = await run([`production ${production}`, names[0], missing].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out);
    expect([gone.code, gone.lines, gone.errors]).toEqual([1, [], [`handover: ${missing} is missing or is not a plain file of the store; no archive was written`]]);
    expect((await run(names.join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out)).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await run([`production ${production}`, names[0], names[0]].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out)).code).toBe(1);
    // A directory where a file should be is no plain file either.
    const dirId = randomUUID();
    mkdirSync(path.join(s.storeDir, ...storedName(dirId, "small").split("/")), { recursive: true });
    expect((await run([`production ${production}`, storedName(dirId, "small")].join(LF), s.storeDir, s.out)).code).toBe(1);
    expect(existsSync(target)).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the zip writer: an empty file and a name of several bytes a character, read back by a reader, with CRC-32s from node:zlib", () => {
    const files = [
      { name: "files/aa/empty", data: Buffer.alloc(0) },
      { name: `files/${String.fromCodePoint(0xe9)}/two`, data: Buffer.from([0, 1, 2, 255]) },
    ];
    const archive = zipStored(files);
    const entries = unzipSync(new Uint8Array(archive));
    expect(Object.keys(entries)).toEqual(files.map((file) => file.name));
    expect(Buffer.from(entries[files[1]!.name]!)).toEqual(files[1]!.data);
    expect(archive.readUInt32LE(14)).toBe(crc32(files[0]!.data));
    // The end record counts both entries.
    expect(archive.readUInt32LE(archive.length - 22)).toBe(0x06054b50);
    expect(archive.readUInt16LE(archive.length - 12)).toBe(2);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/cli-records.test.ts`

```ts
import { createHash, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { NOT_HELD_KINDS, RECORDS_NOT_HELD, RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID } from "../../src/auth";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { recordDigest } from "../../src/cli/records";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { STAFF_USAGE, runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { newUserWithDevice } from "./auth-fixtures";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { CHANNEL_TABLES, aPost, imagePost, removeDecided, removeFixtures, report, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { ORDER_TABLES, orderForTest, removeOrders } from "./orders-fixtures";
import { RECORD_TABLES, SEAL_FOR_GOOD, holdOf, recordCounts, recordsOf, removeRecords } from "./records-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

const NEWLINE = String.fromCharCode(10);

/**
 * The commands of the records to authorities (3f design, sections 7.13, 7.14, 8.11 and 10.5; W.8): each as the migrator,
 * one transaction with the 10-second lock timeout, the account's hold row before the record where a command releases
 * it, and its audit row last under the system actor (notification_recorded, production_recorded, address_checked),
 * whose later steps hold only the digest of the record's row. records lists and, with --verify, recomputes those digests;
 * notification-facts (in place of 3c's account-facts) prints the account's facts and records a production; a production
 * for an order to provide information waits for its tell rule; the hand-over's list holds one seal's files and its record
 * takes exactly those names. A refusal is one sentence ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. The seal
 * commits with a real key; the last test removes what the file made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the commands of the records to authorities", () => {
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let recordsBefore: Record<string, number>;
  /** The sealed account: a real auth row with an address, a profile, a post with two images, sealed for good. */
  let account: { id: string; email: string; handle: string };
  let sealed: { postId: string; caseId: string; sealActionId: string; mediaIds: string[] };
  const orders: string[] = [];
  const posts: string[] = [];

  beforeAll(async () => {
    // Read in beforeAll: a suite without a database is collected and skipped, and its environment is not loaded then.
    const config = loadConfig();
    world = deciderWorld(createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 }));
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 1 });
    admin = await world.staff("admin");
    const apiDb = world.moderation.deps.apiDb;
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    recordsBefore = await recordCounts(migrateDb);
    const { user } = await newUserWithDevice(createAuthRepo(authDb));
    const handle = `r_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into profiles (id, handle, display_name) values (${user.id}::uuid, ${handle}, 'Sealed')`);
    account = { id: user.id, email: user.email, handle };
    const p = await imagePost(apiDb, 2, account.id);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    const { caseId } = await report(apiDb, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
    const outcome = await world.decideAs(admin, caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the seal was not recorded (${outcome})`);
    const [action] = await migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${outcome.decisionId}::uuid and kind::text = 'seal_media'`);
    sealed = { postId: p.postId, caseId, sealActionId: action!.id, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await removeOrders(migrateDb, orders);
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [account.id, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts, [admin.id]);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [account.id]);
    await world.close();
    await Promise.all([closeDb(migrateDb), closeDb(authDb)]);
  });

  const env = () => ({ DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! });
  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], input?: string) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env(), { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.from(input ?? "", "utf8"));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  const lastAudit = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string | null; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${id} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;
  const auditCount = async () => (await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.audit_log`))[0]!.n;
  const theRecord = async () => (await recordsOf(migrateDb, account.id)).find((r) => r.seal_action_id === sealed.sealActionId)!;
  const production = async (id: string) => ({ ...(await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.productions where id = ${id}::uuid`))[0]! });

  test("the seal opened its record and the hold; records lists it; notification-facts prints the account's facts, records a production, and refuses a record that is not owed", async () => {
    const record = await theRecord();
    expect(record).toMatchObject({ state: "owed", case_id: sealed.caseId, account_id: account.id, opened_via: "system" });
    expect(await holdOf(migrateDb, account.id)).toMatchObject({ seal_final: true, released_at: null });
    const listed = await cli(["records"]);
    expect(listed.code).toBe(0);
    expect(listed.lines[0]).toMatch(/^out records: [0-9]+ notifications owed, [0-9]+ archives not recorded as destroyed[.]$/);
    expect(listed.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`out records: ${record.id}: case ${sealed.caseId}, duties none, owed since [0-9T:.Z-]+, address held until [0-9T:.Z-]+`));

    const audits = await auditCount();
    const facts = await cli(["notification-facts", record.id]);
    expect(facts.code).toBe(0);
    const [created] = await authDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as at from auth.users where id = ${account.id}::uuid`);
    expect(facts.lines.slice(0, 3)).toEqual([`out handle: @${account.handle}`, `out email: ${account.email}`, `out created_at: ${created!.at}`]);
    expect(facts.lines).toContain(`out post_id: ${sealed.postId}`);
    expect(facts.lines.some((line) => line.startsWith("out post_created_at: "))).toBe(true);
    expect(facts.lines).toContain(`out ${RECORDS_NOT_HELD[RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION]}`);
    const made = /^out notification-facts: recorded as production ([0-9a-f-]{36})[.]$/.exec(facts.lines.at(-1)!);
    expect(made).not.toBeNull();
    const row = await production(made![1]!);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ instrument: "notification", notification_id: record.id, account_id: account.id, seal_action_id: sealed.sealActionId, produced: ["handle", "address", "created_at", "post_ids", "post_times"], not_held: [...NOT_HELD_KINDS] });
    const audit = await lastAudit(made![1]!);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["production_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "production"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ step: "account", digest: await recordDigest(migrateDb, "production", made![1]!) });
    expect(await auditCount()).toBe(audits + 1);

    expect((await cli(["notification-facts", randomUUID()])).text).toMatch(/^err notification-facts: no notification record has the id [0-9a-f-]{36}; nothing changed$/);
    // 3c's account-facts is gone: notification-facts replaces it.
    expect((await cli(["account-facts", account.handle, sealed.caseId])).code).toBe(2);
    for (const command of ["records", "notification-open", "notification-facts", "notification-sent", "notification-declined", "notification-answer", "notification-event", "production-account", "address-check", "handover-list", "handover-record", "handover-destroyed"]) {
      expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
    }
    expect(STAFF_USAGE).not.toContain("account-facts");
  });

  test("handover-list lists one seal's stored files and opens a production; handover-record takes exactly those names; handover-destroyed ends it; a seizure is taken", async () => {
    const audits = await auditCount();
    const listed = await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "notification", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", "ST 1/26"]);
    expect(listed.code).toBe(0);
    const out = listed.lines.filter((line) => line.startsWith("out ")).map((line) => line.slice(4));
    const first = /^production ([0-9a-f-]{36})$/.exec(out[0]!);
    expect(first).not.toBeNull();
    const id = first![1]!;
    const names = sealed.mediaIds.flatMap((m) => ["small", "large"].map((size) => `files/${m.slice(0, 2)}/${m}/${size}.webp`)).sort();
    expect(out.slice(1).sort()).toEqual(names);
    expect(listed.lines).toContain(`err handover-list: production ${id}: 4 files of 1 posts.`);
    expect(await production(id)).toMatchObject({ instrument: "notification", seal_action_id: sealed.sealActionId, account_id: account.id, authority: "BKA", their_reference: "ST 1/26", produced: ["files"], archive_sha256: null });
    expect((await lastAudit(id)).metadata).toEqual({ step: "listed", digest: await recordDigest(migrateDb, "production", id) });

    const sha = (name: string) => createHash("sha256").update(name).digest("hex");
    const digests = (list: string[]) => [...list.map((name, i) => `${name} ${100 + i} ${sha(name)}`), `archive 999 ${sha("archive")}`].join(NEWLINE) + NEWLINE;
    const listOrder = out.slice(1);
    expect((await cli(["handover-record", id, "--channel", "courier", "--receipt", "R-1"], digests([...listOrder.slice(1), "files/aa/other/small.webp"]))).text).toBe(
      "err handover-record: the digests do not name exactly the files handover-list printed; nothing changed",
    );
    const recorded = await cli(["handover-record", id, "--channel", "courier", "--receipt", "R-1"], digests(listOrder));
    expect(recorded.text).toBe(`out handover-record: production ${id}: 4 files, archive ${sha("archive")}. Delete every copy once the authority confirms, then run handover-destroyed.`);
    const row = await production(id);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ archive_sha256: sha("archive"), channel: "courier", receipt: "R-1", destroyed_at: null });
    expect((row.files as { name: string; bytes: number; sha256: string }[]).map((f) => [f.name, f.bytes, f.sha256])).toEqual(listOrder.map((name, i) => [name, 100 + i, sha(name)]));
    expect((await cli(["handover-record", id, "--channel", "courier", "--receipt", "R-1"], digests(listOrder))).code).toBe(1);
    const destroyed = await cli(["handover-destroyed", id, "--how", "the archive and its copy were overwritten"]);
    expect(destroyed.text).toMatch(/^out handover-destroyed: recorded at [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$/);
    expect((await production(id)).destroyed_how).toBe("the archive and its copy were overwritten");
    expect((await cli(["handover-destroyed", id, "--how", "again"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect(await auditCount()).toBe(audits + 3);

    // A seizure: the list, then the record that the authority took the files, with no archive.
    const seized = await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "seizure", "--authority", "Staatsanwaltschaft", "--reference", "AZ 9"]);
    const seizure = /^out production ([0-9a-f-]{36})$/.exec(seized.lines.find((line) => line.startsWith("out production "))!)![1]!;
    expect((await cli(["handover-record", seizure, "--taken"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect(await production(seizure)).toMatchObject({ instrument: "seizure", archive_sha256: null, destroyed_how: "taken by the authority" });

    // Refused: not a seal's row, and an instrument that does not hand files over.
    expect((await cli(["handover-list", randomUUID(), "--instrument", "demand", "--authority", "x", "--reference", "y"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "dsa_art10", "--authority", "x", "--reference", "y"])).code).toBe(1);
  });

  test("handover-list refuses a seal whose posts' image rows are not as many as it recorded (handover_mismatch), and writes nothing", async () => {
    const audits = await auditCount();
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.seal_posts set images = images + 1 where action_id = ${sealed.sealActionId}::uuid`);
    try {
      expect((await cli(["handover-list", sealed.sealActionId, "--instrument", "demand", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", "ST 2/26"])).text).toBe(
        "err handover-list: handover_mismatch: the image rows of this seal's posts are not what the seal recorded: run staff.js text-verify, and hand nothing over; nothing changed",
      );
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.seal_posts set images = images - 1 where action_id = ${sealed.sealActionId}::uuid`);
    }
    expect(await auditCount()).toBe(audits);
  });

  test("notification-sent records the notification by kind and releases the hold; notification-answer and notification-event follow; records --verify recomputes each digest", async () => {
    const record = await theRecord();
    const args = ["notification-sent", record.id, "--authority", "BKA", "--channel", "portal", "--duty", "dsa18_1", "--duty", "tco14_5", "--state", "DE", "--basis", "the account's address", "--own-reference", "K-7", "--kinds", "handle,address,post_ids,files", "--at", "2026-10-10T03:00:00+02:00", "--receipt", "receipt 7", "--by", "the operator"];
    expect((await cli([...args.slice(0, -2)])).text).toBe("err notification-sent: --by is required; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(args.map((word) => (word === "handle,address,post_ids,files" ? "handle,name" : word)))).text).toBe(
      "err notification-sent: --kinds takes handle, address, created_at, post_ids, post_times, report_time and files; nothing changed",
    );
    const sent = await cli(args);
    expect(sent.text).toBe(`out notification-sent: record ${record.id} sent to BKA at 2026-10-10T01:00:00.000Z. The address hold is released.`);
    const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select state, duties, state_concerned, state_basis, sent_kinds, not_kept_version, own_reference, receipt, sent_by, check_result from public.authority_notifications where id = ${record.id}::uuid`);
    expect({ ...row }).toEqual({ state: "sent", duties: ["dsa18_1", "tco14_5"], state_concerned: "DE", state_basis: "the account's address", sent_kinds: ["handle", "address", "post_ids", "files"], not_kept_version: RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION, own_reference: "K-7", receipt: "receipt 7", sent_by: "the operator", check_result: true });
    expect(await holdOf(migrateDb, account.id)).toMatchObject({ release_reason: "sent" });
    const audit = await lastAudit(record.id);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["notification_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "notification"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ step: "sent", caseId: sealed.caseId, sealActionId: sealed.sealActionId, duties: ["dsa18_1", "tco14_5"], sentKinds: ["handle", "address", "post_ids", "files"], at: "2026-10-10T01:00:00.000Z" });
    expect((await cli(args)).text).toBe(`err notification-sent: record ${record.id} is sent, not owed; nothing changed`);

    expect((await cli(["notification-answer", record.id, "--their-reference", "ST 12/34", "--at", "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z", "--answer", "a sentence"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["notification-answer", record.id, "--their-reference", "ST 12/34", "--at", "2026-10-12T00:00:00Z", "--answer", "illegal"])).text).toBe("out notification-answer: recorded.");
    expect((await lastAudit(record.id)).metadata).toEqual({ step: "answered", digest: await recordDigest(migrateDb, "notification", record.id) });
    const [answer] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select reported, their_reference, answer from public.seal_report(${sealed.sealActionId}::uuid)`);
    expect({ ...answer }).toEqual({ reported: true, their_reference: "ST 12/34", answer: "illegal" });

    expect((await cli(["notification-event", record.id, "--kind", "request", "--at", "2026-10-13T00:00:00Z", "--how", "a letter", "--until", "2027-01-01T00:00:00Z"])).code).toBe(1);
    const event = await cli(["notification-event", record.id, "--kind", "request", "--at", "2026-10-13T00:00:00Z", "--how", "a letter asking for the files", "--reference", "ST 12/34-2", "--not-to-person"]);
    expect(event.lines).toEqual([
      "out notification-event: recorded.",
      "out notification-event: until further notice, nothing about this may be told to the person: korbat's access-request draft marks the case.",
    ]);
    expect((await lastAudit(record.id)).metadata).toEqual({ step: "event", digest: await recordDigest(migrateDb, "notification", record.id) });

    expect((await cli(["records", "--verify"])).code).toBe(0);
    // A record changed around the command line no longer recomputes to its audit row's digest.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set their_reference = 'changed' where id = ${record.id}::uuid`);
    try {
      const verify = await cli(["records", "--verify"]);
      expect(verify.code).toBe(1);
      expect(verify.text).toContain(`records: notification ${record.id} differs from its audit row`);
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set their_reference = 'ST 12/34' where id = ${record.id}::uuid`);
    }
    expect((await cli(["records", "--verify"])).code).toBe(0);
  });

  test("notification-open opens a record for a check on other content, with no hold; notification-declined closes it with its reason", async () => {
    const p = await imagePost(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, 0, account.id);

    expect((await cli(["notification-open", "--case", caseId, "--duty", "dsa18_3"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["notification-open", "--case", randomUUID(), "--duty", "voluntary"])).text).toMatch(/^err notification-open: no case has the id /);
    const holdBefore = await holdOf(migrateDb, account.id);
    const opened = await cli(["notification-open", "--case", caseId, "--duty", "voluntary"]);
    const made = /^out notification-open: record ([0-9a-f-]{36}), owed since [0-9T:.Z-]+[.]$/.exec(opened.text);
    expect(made).not.toBeNull();
    const id = made![1]!;
    const record = (await recordsOf(migrateDb, account.id)).find((r) => r.id === id)!;
    expect(record).toMatchObject({ state: "owed", duties: ["voluntary"], case_id: caseId, seal_action_id: null, opened_via: "cli" });
    expect((await lastAudit(id)).metadata).toMatchObject({ step: "opened", caseId, sealActionId: null, duties: ["voluntary"] });
    expect(await holdOf(migrateDb, account.id)).toEqual(holdBefore);
    expect((await cli(["notification-declined", id, "--reason", "the check found nothing to report", "--by", "the operator"])).text).toBe(`out notification-declined: record ${id} closed. No address is held for it.`);
    expect((await recordsOf(migrateDb, account.id)).find((r) => r.id === id)).toMatchObject({ state: "declined", declined_reason: "the check found nothing to report" });
    expect(await holdOf(migrateDb, account.id)).toEqual(holdBefore);
  });

  test("production-account waits for the tell rule, then prints the account's three facts and records what was asked and produced by kind", async () => {
    const view = await orderForTest(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, admin, { kind: "dsa_art10", links: [] });
    orders.push(view.id);
    const args = ["production-account", view.id, "--handle", account.handle, "--asked", "handle,address,created_at"];
    expect((await cli(args)).text).toBe("err production-account: tell_rule_missing: whether the person may be told of this order is not recorded: run staff.js order-tell-rule first; nothing changed");
    expect((await cli(["order-tell-rule", view.id, "--when", "never", "--basis", "section 5 of the order"])).code).toBe(0);
    expect((await cli([...args.slice(0, -1), "handle,name"])).code).toBe(1);
    const done = await cli(args);
    expect(done.code).toBe(0);
    expect(done.lines.slice(0, 3)).toEqual([`out handle: @${account.handle}`, `out email: ${account.email}`, expect.stringMatching(/^out created_at: /)]);
    expect(done.lines).toContain(`out ${RECORDS_NOT_HELD[RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION]}`);
    const made = /^out production-account: recorded as production ([0-9a-f-]{36}), instrument dsa_art10[.]$/.exec(done.lines.at(-1)!);
    expect(made).not.toBeNull();
    const row = await production(made![1]!);
    expect(row).toMatchObject({ instrument: "dsa_art10", order_id: view.id, account_id: account.id, asked: ["handle", "address", "created_at"], produced: ["handle", "address", "created_at"], not_held: [...NOT_HELD_KINDS] });
    // The rule never: the production is kept for as long as the person must not be told.
    const [until] = await migrateDb.execute<{ infinite: boolean }>(sql`select not_to_person_until = 'infinity'::timestamptz as infinite from public.productions where id = ${made![1]!}::uuid`);
    expect(until!.infinite).toBe(true);
    expect((await lastAudit(made![1]!)).metadata).toEqual({ step: "account", digest: await recordDigest(migrateDb, "production", made![1]!) });
    // Only an order to provide information takes it.
    const removal = await orderForTest(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, admin, { kind: "tco_removal", links: ["https://elsewhere.example/r"] });
    orders.push(removal.id);
    expect((await cli(["production-account", removal.id, "--handle", account.handle, "--asked", "handle"])).text).toMatch(/^err production-account: .* not an order to provide information; nothing changed$/);
  });

  test("address-check answers yes or no for the address on standard input, prints no address and writes one audit row", async () => {
    const yes = await cli(["address-check", "--handle", account.handle], `${account.email.toUpperCase()}${NEWLINE}`);
    expect(yes.text).toBe("out address-check: yes");
    expect(yes.text).not.toContain("@korbat");
    expect((await lastAudit(account.id)).metadata).toEqual({ match: true });
    expect((await lastAudit(account.id)).action).toBe("address_checked");
    expect((await cli(["address-check", "--handle", account.handle], "someone@else.example")).text).toBe("out address-check: no");
    expect((await lastAudit(account.id)).metadata).toEqual({ match: false });
    expect((await cli(["address-check", "--handle", "nobody_here_1"], "a@b.example")).code).toBe(1);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeOrders(migrateDb, orders.splice(0));
    await removeRecords(migrateDb, [account.id, admin.id]);
    await removeDecided(migrateDb, posts.splice(0), []);
    expect(await recordCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(recordsBefore);
    expect(RECORD_TABLES).toHaveLength(4);
    await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [account.id]);
    expect(await rowCounts(world.moderation.deps.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toMatchObject({ cases: before.cases, decisions: before.decisions, legal_orders: before.legal_orders });
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/records-fixtures.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { Db, DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { act, aPost, decideIn, imagePost, report, uuids, type DecisionInput, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/**
 * 3f Task 5: fixtures of the records to authorities (3f design, sections 6.5, 7.13 to 7.15). The three record tables and
 * auth.report_holds are the migrator's alone: the API role holds no grant on them, so every read and count here is
 * made as the migrator, and every cleanup too.
 */

/** The tables of the records to authorities, schema-qualified, which a suite that writes them counts before and after. */
export const RECORD_TABLES = ["public.authority_notifications", "public.authority_notification_events", "public.productions", "auth.report_holds"] as const;

/** How many rows each record table holds, read as the migrator (the API role cannot count them). */
export async function recordCounts(migrateDb: Db | DbTx): Promise<Record<string, number>> {
  const columns = RECORD_TABLES.map((table) => `(select count(*)::int from ${table}) as "${table}"`).join(", ");
  const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, number>>(sql.raw(`select ${columns}`));
  return { ...row! };
}

/** A seal taken while deciding, and a seal for good, as the seal tests take them. */
export const SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING: DecisionInput = { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };
export const SEAL_FOR_GOOD: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };
/** The admin's answer without a seal. */
export const NO_SEAL: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" };

/** A post of the author (a new profile unless one is given) with images, reported on the path for child sexual abuse material. */
export async function suspectPost(tx: DbTx | Db, images = 2, authorId?: string): Promise<{ authorId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[]; caseId: string }> {
  const p = await imagePost(tx, images, authorId);
  const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
  return { ...p, caseId };
}

/** The same with a seal on it: taken while deciding by the moderator, or for good by the admin. Answers the seal's ledger row too. */
export async function sealedPost(
  tx: DbTx,
  staff: TestStaff,
  how: "deciding" | "final",
  authorId?: string,
): Promise<{ authorId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[]; caseId: string; decisionId: string; sealActionId: string }> {
  const p = await suspectPost(tx, 2, authorId);
  const decisionId = await decideIn(tx, staff, p.caseId, how === "deciding" ? SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING : SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
  return { ...p, decisionId, sealActionId: await sealActionOf(tx, decisionId) };
}

/** The seal_media row of a decision. */
export async function sealActionOf(q: DbTx | Db, decisionId: string): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${decisionId}::uuid and kind::text = 'seal_media'`);
  return row!.id;
}

export interface RecordRow {
  id: string;
  state: string;
  duties: string[];
  case_id: string | null;
  seal_action_id: string | null;
  account_id: string | null;
  opened_at: string;
  opened_via: string;
  first_report_at: string | null;
  admin_answer_at: string | null;
  declined_reason: string | null;
  closed_at: string | null;
  sent_at: string | null;
  answer: string | null;
}

/** The notification records of an account, oldest first, as the migrator reads them (times as text). */
export async function recordsOf(q: DbTx | Db, accountId: string): Promise<RecordRow[]> {
  return (await q.execute<RecordRow & Record<string, unknown>>(
    sql`select id, state, duties, case_id, seal_action_id, account_id, opened_at::text, opened_via, first_report_at::text, admin_answer_at::text,
               declined_reason, closed_at::text, sent_at::text, answer
          from public.authority_notifications where account_id = ${accountId}::uuid order by opened_at, id`,
  )).map((row) => ({ ...row }));
}

export interface HoldRow {
  set_at: string;
  seal_final: boolean;
  released_at: string | null;
  release_reason: string | null;
}

/** The account's row of auth.report_holds, or null. */
export async function holdOf(q: DbTx | Db, accountId: string): Promise<HoldRow | null> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<HoldRow & Record<string, unknown>>(
    sql`select set_at::text, seal_final, released_at::text, release_reason from auth.report_holds where user_id = ${accountId}::uuid`,
  );
  return row ? { ...row } : null;
}

/** What the auth module reads of the hold: until when (as text, or null), and whether the seal behind it is for good. */
export async function heldFor(q: DbTx | Db, accountId: string): Promise<{ until: string | null; held: boolean; final: boolean }> {
  const [row] = await q.execute<{ until: string | null; held: boolean; final: boolean }>(
    sql`select auth.address_held_until(${accountId}::uuid)::text as until, auth.address_held(${accountId}::uuid) as held, auth.address_hold_final(${accountId}::uuid) as final`,
  );
  return { ...row! };
}

/** Moves an account's hold back by the interval, as the migrator, so that its seven days pass without waiting. */
export async function ageHoldForTest(q: DbTx | Db, accountId: string, interval: string): Promise<void> {
  await q.execute(sql`update auth.report_holds set set_at = set_at - ${interval}::interval where user_id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
}

/**
 * Removes, as the migrator, the records to authorities of these accounts and of these cases: their notification records
 * with their events, their productions and their holds. The records hold no foreign key to a case or an account, so a
 * suite's own cleanup of its cases leaves them standing unless it calls this.
 */
export async function removeRecords(migrateDb: Db | DbTx, accountIds: readonly string[], caseIds: readonly string[] = []): Promise<void> {
  const run = async (tx: Db | DbTx) => {
    await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.authority_notifications where account_id = any(${uuids(accountIds)}) or case_id = any(${uuids(caseIds)})`);
    await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.productions where account_id = any(${uuids(accountIds)})`);
    await tx.execute(sql`delete from auth.report_holds where user_id = any(${uuids(accountIds)})`);
  };
  await run(migrateDb);
}
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/records-grants.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS,
  NOTIFICATION_DUTIES,
  NOTIFICATION_EVENT_KINDS,
  NOTIFICATION_OPENED_VIA,
  NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS,
  NOTIFICATION_STATES,
  NOT_HELD_KINDS,
  ACCESS_PURPOSES,
  PRODUCED_KINDS,
  PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS,
  REPORT_HOLD_RELEASES,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { pgError, rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";
import { recordCounts } from "./records-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 60_000 });

/**
 * The grants of the records to authorities (3f design, sections 6.5 and 6.7; invariant 12, the records). As korbat_api:
 * no privilege at all on authority_notifications, its events and productions, EXECUTE on seal_report and
 * report_close_unsealed refused, and only reports_owed() and erase_authority_records() callable. As korbat_auth: no
 * privilege on auth.report_holds, and EXECUTE on auth.address_held, auth.address_held_until and auth.address_hold_final
 * alone of 0030's functions. Each closed list's CHECK is its contracts' constant, and the times are forced.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the grants of the records to authorities", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await recordCounts(migrateDb);
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const privileges = async (role: string, table: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ p: string }>(sql`
      select p from unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'REFERENCES', 'TRIGGER']) p
       where has_table_privilege(${role}, ${table}, p) order by p`)).map((r) => r.p);
  const columnPrivileges = async (role: string, schema: string, table: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`
      select count(*)::int as n from information_schema.columns c, unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'REFERENCES']) p
       where c.table_schema = ${schema} and c.table_name = ${table} and has_column_privilege(${role}, ${`${schema}.${table}`}, c.column_name, p)`))[0]!.n;
  const mayExecute = async (role: string, fn: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ ok: boolean }>(sql`select has_function_privilege(${role}, ${fn}, 'EXECUTE') as ok`))[0]!.ok;
  const checkValues = async (table: string, name: string) =>
    [...((await migrateDb.execute<{ d: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as d from pg_constraint where conname = ${name} and conrelid = ${table}::regclass`))[0]!.d.matchAll(/'([a-z_0-9]+)'/g))].map((m) => m[1]!);

  const FUNCTIONS = [
    "public.report_open()",
    "public.report_close_unsealed(uuid)",
    "public.reports_owed()",
    "public.seal_report(uuid)",
    "public.erase_authority_records()",
    "public.authority_records_times()",
    "auth.address_held_until(uuid)",
    "auth.address_held(uuid)",
    "auth.address_hold_final(uuid)",
  ];

  test("korbat_api holds nothing on the three record tables, column by column too, and reads no row of them", async () => {
    for (const table of ["public.authority_notifications", "public.authority_notification_events", "public.productions"]) {
      expect(await privileges("korbat_api", table)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_api", "public", table.slice("public.".length))).toBe(0);
    }
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`select count(*) from public.authority_notifications`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`select count(*) from public.productions`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person) values (gen_random_uuid(), 'note', now(), 'x', false)`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
  });

  test("korbat_api may call reports_owed() and erase_authority_records() alone of 0030's functions; seal_report and report_close_unsealed are refused", async () => {
    const callable = [];
    for (const fn of FUNCTIONS) if (await mayExecute("korbat_api", fn)) callable.push(fn);
    expect(callable).toEqual(["public.reports_owed()", "public.erase_authority_records()"]);
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`select * from public.seal_report(gen_random_uuid())`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    expect((await pgError(apiDb.execute(sql`select public.report_close_unsealed(gen_random_uuid())`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    // What it may call answers a case, a kind and a time, or a count, and nothing more.
    const owed = await apiDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select * from public.reports_owed() limit 1`);
    for (const row of owed) expect(Object.keys(row).sort()).toEqual(["case_id", "kind", "since"]);
  });

  test("korbat_auth holds nothing on auth.report_holds and may call the three auth.address_* reads alone of 0030's functions", async () => {
    expect(await privileges("korbat_auth", "auth.report_holds")).toEqual([]);
    expect(await columnPrivileges("korbat_auth", "auth", "report_holds")).toBe(0);
    expect((await pgError(authDb.execute(sql`select count(*) from auth.report_holds`)))?.code).toBe("42501");
    const callable = [];
    for (const fn of FUNCTIONS) if (await mayExecute("korbat_auth", fn)) callable.push(fn);
    expect(callable).toEqual(["auth.address_held_until(uuid)", "auth.address_held(uuid)", "auth.address_hold_final(uuid)"]);
    const [row] = await authDb.execute<{ until: string | null; held: boolean; final: boolean }>(
      sql`select auth.address_held_until(gen_random_uuid()) as until, auth.address_held(gen_random_uuid()) as held, auth.address_hold_final(gen_random_uuid()) as final`,
    );
    expect({ ...row }).toEqual({ until: null, held: false, final: false });
    // And nothing of the public record tables.
    expect(await privileges("korbat_auth", "public.authority_notifications")).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("every closed list's CHECK is its contracts' constant", async () => {
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notifications", "authority_notifications_state")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_STATES]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notifications", "authority_notifications_duties")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_DUTIES]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notifications", "authority_notifications_sent_kinds")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notifications", "authority_notifications_answer")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notifications", "authority_notifications_opened_via")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_OPENED_VIA]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.authority_notification_events", "authority_notification_events_kind")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_EVENT_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.productions", "productions_instrument")).toEqual([...PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.productions", "productions_purposes")).toEqual([...ACCESS_PURPOSES]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.productions", "productions_asked")).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.productions", "productions_produced")).toEqual([...PRODUCED_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("public.productions", "productions_not_held")).toEqual([...NOT_HELD_KINDS]);
    expect(await checkValues("auth.report_holds", "report_holds_release_reason")).toEqual([...REPORT_HOLD_RELEASES]);
  });

  test("the times are forced: opened_at and an event's at are the transaction's, unless an imported row supplies one that is not after the clock", async () => {
    await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const past = "2024-01-02 03:04:05+00";
      const [plain] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; forced: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via) values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), ${past}::timestamptz, 'cli')
            returning id, opened_at = now() as forced`,
      );
      expect(plain!.forced).toBe(true);
      const [imported] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; kept: boolean; stamped: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at) values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), ${past}::timestamptz, 'cli', ${past}::timestamptz)
            returning id, opened_at = ${past}::timestamptz as kept, imported_at = now() as stamped`,
      );
      expect({ kept: imported!.kept, stamped: imported!.stamped }).toEqual({ kept: true, stamped: true });
      const [future] = await tx.execute<{ forced: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at) values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), now() + interval '1 day', 'cli', now())
            returning opened_at = now() as forced`,
      );
      expect(future!.forced).toBe(true);
      // An update keeps the forced time.
      const [moved] = await tx.execute<{ kept: boolean }>(sql`update public.authority_notifications set opened_at = now() where id = ${imported!.id}::uuid returning opened_at = ${past}::timestamptz as kept`);
      expect(moved!.kept).toBe(true);
      // An event's time: the record's import decides.
      const [ev] = await tx.execute<{ forced: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person) values (${plain!.id}::uuid, 'request', ${past}::timestamptz, 'by letter', false) returning at = now() as forced`,
      );
      expect(ev!.forced).toBe(true);
      const [kept] = await tx.execute<{ kept: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person) values (${imported!.id}::uuid, 'request', ${past}::timestamptz, 'by letter', false) returning at = ${past}::timestamptz as kept`,
      );
      expect(kept!.kept).toBe(true);
      const [production] = await tx.execute<{ forced: boolean }>(
        sql`insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, opened_at) values ('demand', '{handle}', ${past}::timestamptz) returning opened_at = now() as forced`,
      );
      expect(production!.forced).toBe(true);
    });
  });

  test("the CHECKs refuse a seal's record without its seal, a sent record without what it sent, a time limit's mark without its mark, and a free value in a list", async () => {
    const refused = async (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => {
      let code: string | undefined;
      await rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        code = (await pgError(tx.execute(statement)))?.code;
      });
      return code;
    };
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, opened_at, opened_via) values ('owed', now(), 'system')`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, opened_at, opened_via, duties, closed_at) values ('sent', now(), 'cli', '{voluntary}', now())`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, opened_at, opened_via, duties) values ('owed', now(), 'cli', '{dsa18_3}')`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, opened_at, opened_via, duties, closed_at) values ('declined', now(), 'cli', '{voluntary}', now())`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, opened_at, asked) values ('demand', '{handle}', now(), '{name}')`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, opened_at) values ('preserved_access', '{content}', now())`)).toBe("23514");
    expect(await refused(sql`insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final, release_reason) values (gen_random_uuid(), now(), false, 'sent')`)).toBe("23514");
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await recordCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/records-hold.test.ts`

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo, type AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { runStaffCommand } from "../../src/cli/staff";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { act, appealOf, decideIn, gate, newTestStaff, removeFixtures, reviewIn, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { NO_SEAL, SEAL_FOR_GOOD, SEAL_WHILE_DECIDING, ageHoldForTest, heldFor, holdOf, recordCounts, recordsOf, removeRecords, sealActionOf, sealedPost, suspectPost } from "./records-fixtures";
import { newProfile } from "./social-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * The report hold (3f design, sections 6.5, 7.13 and 7.15; invariant 17): a seal opens an owed record once an account and
 * holds the account's address; an admin's answer without a seal closes it, and so does a seal lifted by a correction or
 * a review (declined, unsealed, the hold released, nothing in reports_owed); the seal for good after the one taken while
 * deciding keeps the record and its first times; a second seal that commits beside notification-sent still gets its
 * record and its hold. Every test but the race runs as the migrator in a transaction that is rolled back, so that it can
 * read the records, which the API role cannot; the race commits what its two sessions need and removes it.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the report hold", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let repo: AuthRepo;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let admin2: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let recordsBefore: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 4 });
    repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    admin2 = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
    recordsBefore = await recordCounts(migrateDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** One test's world, as the migrator, rolled back, with the three staff members' profiles in it. */
  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin2);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const owed = async (tx: DbTx) => (await tx.execute<{ case_id: string; kind: string; since: string }>(sql`select case_id, kind, since::text from public.reports_owed()`)).map((row) => ({ ...row }));
  const nowText = async (tx: DbTx) => (await tx.execute<{ now: string }>(sql`select now()::text as now`))[0]!.now;

  test("a seal opens an owed record once an account and holds its address for reportHoldDays; a seal for good makes the hold final", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const first = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding");
      const [record] = await recordsOf(tx, first.authorId);
      const [reported] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select min(created_at)::text as at from intake_items where case_id = ${first.caseId}::uuid and suspect`);
      expect(record).toMatchObject({ state: "owed", duties: [], case_id: first.caseId, seal_action_id: first.sealActionId, account_id: first.authorId, opened_via: "system", first_report_at: reported!.at, admin_answer_at: null, closed_at: null });
      expect(record!.opened_at).toBe(await nowText(tx));
      const hold = await holdOf(tx, first.authorId);
      expect(hold).toMatchObject({ seal_final: false, released_at: null, release_reason: null });
      const [until] = await tx.execute<{ until: string }>(sql`select (${hold!.set_at}::timestamptz + make_interval(days => ${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays}))::text as until`);
      expect(await heldFor(tx, first.authorId)).toEqual({ until: until!.until, held: true, final: false });
      expect(await owed(tx)).toContainEqual({ case_id: first.caseId, kind: "sealed_images", since: record!.opened_at });

      // A second seal of the same author's images finds the record owed: no second record.
      const second = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding", first.authorId);
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, first.authorId)).map((r) => r.id)).toEqual([record!.id]);
      expect((await holdOf(tx, first.authorId))!.seal_final).toBe(false);
      // The admin seals the second for good: the hold's sentence becomes the final one, and the record gains the answer's time.
      const final = await decideIn(tx, admin, second.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
      const [decided] = await tx.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select decided_at::text as at from decisions where id = ${final}::uuid`);
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, first.authorId))[0]).toMatchObject({ id: record!.id, state: "owed", admin_answer_at: decided!.at });
      expect(await heldFor(tx, first.authorId)).toMatchObject({ held: true, final: true });
    });
  });

  test("the hold reads as not held once reportHoldDays have passed, and releases nothing by itself", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, admin, "final");
      expect(await heldFor(tx, p.authorId)).toMatchObject({ held: true, final: true });
      await ageHoldForTest(tx, p.authorId, `${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days 1 second`);
      expect(await heldFor(tx, p.authorId)).toEqual({ until: null, held: false, final: true });
      expect(await holdOf(tx, p.authorId)).toMatchObject({ released_at: null });
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId))[0]!.state).toBe("owed");
    });
  });

  test("an admin's answer without a seal closes the record as declined, unsealed, and releases the hold; with another seal of the account in force it stays owed", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding");
      await decideIn(tx, admin, p.caseId, NO_SEAL);
      const [record] = await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId);
      expect(record).toMatchObject({ state: "declined", declined_reason: "unsealed" });
      expect(record!.closed_at).toBe(await nowText(tx));
      expect(await holdOf(tx, p.authorId)).toMatchObject({ release_reason: "declined" });
      expect(await heldFor(tx, p.authorId)).toMatchObject({ held: false });
      expect((await owed(tx)).filter((row) => row.case_id === p.caseId)).toEqual([]);

      // Two seals of one author: an answer without a seal on one leaves the other in force, and the record owed.
      const a = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding");
      const b = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding", a.authorId);
      await decideIn(tx, admin, a.caseId, NO_SEAL);
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, a.authorId)).map((r) => r.state)).toEqual(["owed"]);
      expect(await heldFor(tx, a.authorId)).toMatchObject({ held: true });
      await decideIn(tx, admin, b.caseId, NO_SEAL);
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, a.authorId)).map((r) => [r.state, r.declined_reason])).toEqual([["declined", "unsealed"]]);
    });
  });

  test("the seal for good that the admin's answer takes after the seal taken while deciding keeps the record owed with its first times", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding");
      const [record] = await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId);
      const hold = await holdOf(tx, p.authorId);
      await decideIn(tx, admin, p.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
      const after = await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId);
      expect(after).toHaveLength(1);
      expect(after[0]).toMatchObject({ id: record!.id, state: "owed", opened_at: record!.opened_at, declined_reason: null, closed_at: null, seal_action_id: p.sealActionId });
      expect(after[0]!.admin_answer_at).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await holdOf(tx, p.authorId)).toEqual({ set_at: hold!.set_at, seal_final: true, released_at: null, release_reason: null });
    });
  });

  test("a seal lifted by a correction closes the record, and so does a seal lifted by a review on the author's appeal", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, admin, "final");
      await decideIn(tx, admin, p.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: p.decisionId, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId)).map((r) => [r.state, r.declined_reason])).toEqual([["declined", "unsealed"]]);
      expect(await holdOf(tx, p.authorId)).toMatchObject({ release_reason: "declined" });

      const q = await sealedPost(tx, admin, "final");
      await appealOf(tx, q.decisionId, q.authorId);
      await reviewIn(tx, admin2, q.decisionId, { outcome: "reversed", actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
      expect((await recordsOf(tx, q.authorId)).map((r) => [r.state, r.declined_reason])).toEqual([["declined", "unsealed"]]);
      expect(await heldFor(tx, q.authorId)).toMatchObject({ held: false });
    });
  });

  test("a report alone opens nothing: only a seal does", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await suspectPost(tx);
      expect(await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await holdOf(tx, p.authorId)).toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("a second seal that commits beside notification-sent still gets its record and its hold", async () => {
    const author = await newProfile(apiDb);
    const recordId = randomUUID();
    // The account's owed record and its hold, committed: a seal's record, as report_open leaves it.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`
      insert into public.authority_notifications (id, state, case_id, seal_action_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via)
      values (${recordId}::uuid, 'owed', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), ${author.id}::uuid, now(), 'system')`);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final) values (${author.id}::uuid, now(), true)`);
    const held = gate();
    const released = gate();
    try {
      // A third session holds the record's row, so that notification-sent stops after it took the hold's row.
      const blocker = migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
        await tx.execute(sql`select 1 from public.authority_notifications where id = ${recordId}::uuid for update`);
        held.open();
        await released.opened;
      });
      await held.opened;
      const lines: string[] = [];
      const sent = runStaffCommand(
        ["notification-sent", recordId, "--authority", "BKA", "--channel", "portal", "--duty", "dsa18_1", "--state", "DE", "--basis", "the account's home", "--own-reference", "K-1", "--kinds", "handle,address", "--at", "2026-10-10T01:00:00Z", "--by", "operator"],
        { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE! },
        { log: (line) => lines.push(line), error: (line) => lines.push(line) },
        async () => Buffer.alloc(0),
      );
      await untilWaiting(1);
      // The second seal: it waits at the hold's row, which notification-sent holds.
      let inside: { records: { state: string; seal_action_id: string | null }[]; hold: unknown } | null = null;
      const seal = rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
        await staffProfile(tx, admin);
        const p = await suspectPost(tx, 2, author.id);
        const decision = await decideIn(tx, admin, p.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const action = await sealActionOf(tx, decision);
        inside = { records: (await recordsOf(tx, author.id)).map((r) => ({ state: r.state, seal_action_id: r.seal_action_id === action ? "this seal" : r.seal_action_id })), hold: await holdOf(tx, author.id) };
      });
      await untilWaiting(2);
      released.open();
      await blocker;
      expect(await sent).toBe(0);
      await seal;
      // It read the record as sent, after the command committed, and opened its own with the hold set again.
      expect(inside!.records.map((r) => r.state)).toEqual(["sent", "owed"]);
      expect(inside!.records[1]!.seal_action_id).toBe("this seal");
      expect(inside!.hold).toMatchObject({ seal_final: true, released_at: null, release_reason: null });
    } finally {
      released.open();
      await removeRecords(migrateDb, [author.id]);
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, [author.id]);
    }
  });

  /** Resolves once this many of the migrator's other sessions wait for a lock. */
  async function untilWaiting(n: number): Promise<void> {
    const deadline = Date.now() + 20_000;
    while (Date.now() < deadline) {
      const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ n: number }>(
        sql`select count(*)::int as n from pg_stat_activity where datname = current_database() and pid <> pg_backend_pid() and usename = current_user and wait_event_type = 'Lock'`,
      );
      if (row!.n >= n) return;
      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    }
    throw new Error(`fewer than ${n} sessions came to wait for a lock`);
  }

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await recordCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(recordsBefore);
  });
});
```

### Create `apps/api/test/integration/records-notifications.test.ts`

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ORDER_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { act, decideIn, newTestStaff, rowCounts, staffProfile, type TestStaff } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { holdOf, recordCounts, recordsOf, sealedPost } from "./records-fixtures";
import { rolledBack } from "./staff-fixtures";

vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 90_000 });

/**
 * The notification records' two answers and their erasure (3f design, sections 6.5, 6.8 and 7.18; invariant 21, the
 * authority's records). reports_owed() answers a case, a kind and a time for each owed record and nothing more;
 * seal_report(action) answers whether a seal was reported, the authority's reference, its answer's word and day, and
 * when the report was sent (3d's ruling O1), for the seal's own record and for a seal that met its account's record
 * owed. erase_authority_records() deletes a record and a production record_keep_years after their newest time, never
 * while the record's seal is in force, a "not to the person" mark runs (open or ahead) or an archive is not recorded as
 * destroyed, and a hold once its account has no record left. Each test runs as the migrator in a transaction that is
 * rolled back, with the times moved there.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the notification records' answers and their erasure", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let admin: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let recordsBefore: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 2 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    const repo = createAuthRepo(authDb);
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "moderator");
    admin = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, repo, "admin");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
    recordsBefore = await recordCounts(migrateDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  const inWorld = (fn: (tx: DbTx) => Promise<void>) =>
    rolledBack(migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      await staffProfile(tx, mod);
      await staffProfile(tx, admin);
      await fn(tx);
    });
  const sealReport = async (tx: DbTx, action: string) =>
    ({ ...(await tx.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(sql`select reported, their_reference, answer, answered_at::text, sent_at::text from public.seal_report(${action}::uuid)`))[0]! });
  /** A record the command line opened, with every time of it set back by the interval. */
  const oldRecord = async (tx: DbTx, interval: string, extra: { sealActionId?: string; accountId?: string } = {}) => {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, seal_action_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, closed_at, declined_reason, imported_at)
      values ('declined', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), ${extra.sealActionId ?? null}, ${extra.accountId ?? null}, now() - ${interval}::interval,
              ${extra.sealActionId ? "system" : "cli"}, now() - ${interval}::interval, 'a check that ended in no', now()) returning id`);
    // closed_at is not forced: the record's newest time is moved with its opening.
    return row!.id;
  };
  const erase = async (tx: DbTx) => Number((await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select public.erase_authority_records() as n`))[0]!.n);
  const exists = async (tx: DbTx, table: string, id: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql.raw(`select count(*)::int as n from ${table} where id = '${id}'`)))[0]!.n === 1;
  const years = `${ORDER_RULES.recordKeepYears} years`;

  test("reports_owed() answers each owed record's case, kind and since: sealed_images for a seal's, the first duty for one the command line opened", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, mod, "deciding");
      const [cli] = await tx.execute<{ id: string; case_id: string; since: string }>(sql`

      const [record] = await recordsOf(tx, p.authorId);

  test("seal_report: not reported while owed; once sent, the reference, the answer's word, its day and the time sent; a second seal of the account reads the same record; a seal without a record answers one row, not reported", async () => {

      await tx.execute(sql`set local timezone to 'UTC'`);

      const [none] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.seal_report(gen_random_uuid())`);
      expect(none!.n).toBe(1);

  test("erase_authority_records deletes a record and its events three years after their newest time, never while its seal is in force or a 'not to the person' runs", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const old = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`);
      const young = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} -1 day`);
      // An event inside the three years keeps an old record.
      const evented = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, occurred_at, how, not_to_person) values (${evented}::uuid, 'request', now(), now(), 'a later letter', false)`);
      // "Not to the person" with an open end, and with an end ahead, keep it whatever its age; one whose end passed does not.
      const open = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`);
      const ahead = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`);
      const passed = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`);
      for (const [id, until] of [[open, null], [ahead, "now() + interval '1 day'"], [passed, "now() - interval '1 day'"]] as const) {
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update public.authority_notifications set imported_at = now() where id = '${id}'`));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, occurred_at, how, not_to_person, not_to_person_until)
                                  values ('${id}', 'request', now() - interval '${years} 1 day', now() - interval '${years} 1 day', 'not to be told', true, ${until ?? "null"})`));
      }
      // A seal's record whose seal is still in force.
      const p = await sealedPost(tx, admin, "final");
      const sealed = await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`, { sealActionId: p.sealActionId, accountId: p.authorId });
      expect(await erase(tx)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", old)).toBe(false);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", passed)).toBe(false);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", young)).toBe(true);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", evented)).toBe(true);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", open)).toBe(true);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", ahead)).toBe(true);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", sealed)).toBe(true);
      // The events went with their record.
      const [left] = await tx.execute<{ n: number }>(sql`select count(*)::int as n from public.authority_notification_events where notification_id = ${passed}::uuid`);
      expect(left!.n).toBe(0);
      // Once the seal is lifted, the old record goes.
      await decideIn(tx, admin, p.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: p.decisionId, actions: [act("unseal_media")] });
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.authority_notifications", sealed)).toBe(false);
    });
  });

  test("erase_authority_records deletes a production three years old, never while its archive is not recorded as destroyed or its own 'not to the person' is ahead; a hold goes once its account has no record left", async () => {
    await inWorld(async (tx) => {
      const production = async (extra: string) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql.raw(`
          insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, opened_at, imported_at, files, archive_sha256, delivered_at, destroyed_at, destroyed_how, not_to_person_until)
          values ('demand', '{files}', now() - interval '${years} 1 day', now(), ${extra}) returning id`));
        return row!.id;
      };
      const plain = await production(`null, null, null, null, null, null`);
      const undestroyed = await production(`'[]'::jsonb, '${"b".repeat(64)}', now() - interval '${years} 1 day', null, null, null`);
      const destroyed = await production(`'[]'::jsonb, '${"b".repeat(64)}', now() - interval '${years} 1 day', now() - interval '${years}' - interval '1 hour', 'deleted', null`);
      const silent = await production(`null, null, null, null, null, now() + interval '1 day'`);
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.productions", plain)).toBe(false);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.productions", destroyed)).toBe(false);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.productions", undestroyed)).toBe(true);
      expect(await exists(tx, "public.productions", silent)).toBe(true);

      // Holds: one released and one expired go once their account has no record left; one with a record, and one still
      // held, stay.
      const hold = async (released: boolean, setAgo: string) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql.raw(`
          insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final, released_at, release_reason)
          values (gen_random_uuid(), now() - interval '${setAgo}', true, ${released ? "now()" : "null"}, ${released ? "'sent'" : "null"}) returning user_id as id`));
        return row!.id;
      };
      const releasedWithOld = await hold(true, "1 day");
      await oldRecord(tx, `${years} 1 day`, { accountId: releasedWithOld });
      const releasedWithYoung = await hold(true, "1 day");
      await oldRecord(tx, "1 day", { accountId: releasedWithYoung });
      const expired = await hold(false, `${ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays} days 1 minute`);
      const held = await hold(false, "1 day");
      await erase(tx);
      expect(await holdOf(tx, releasedWithOld)).toBeNull();
      expect(await recordsOf(tx, releasedWithOld)).toEqual([]);
      expect(await holdOf(tx, expired)).toBeNull();
      expect(await holdOf(tx, releasedWithYoung)).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await holdOf(tx, held)).not.toBeNull();
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    expect(await rowCounts(apiDb)).toEqual(before);
    expect(await recordCounts(migrateDb)).toEqual(recordsBefore);
  });
});
```

### Create `packages/contracts/test/records.test.ts`

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCESS_PURPOSES,
  HANDOVER_INSTRUMENTS,
  NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS,
  NOTIFICATION_DUTIES,
  NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS,
  NOT_HELD_KINDS,
  PRODUCED_KINDS,
  PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS,
  RECORDS_NOT_HELD,
  RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION,
  REPORT_OWED_KINDS,
  ReportsOwed,
  recordDigestOf,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * 3f Task 5 (design, sections 6.5, 10.1, 10.2 and W.8): the closed lists of the records to authorities, each the one
 * spelling of its CHECK (a database test holds the two equal), what the console learns of an owed report, the fixed
 * sentence of what korbat does not hold, and the digest a later step's audit row holds in place of the facts.
 */
describe("the records to authorities", () => {
  test("the closed lists: by kind, never by value, and an answer is a word", () => {
    expect(NOTIFICATION_DUTIES).toEqual(["dsa18_1", "dsa18_2", "tco14_5", "voluntary"]);
    expect(NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS).toEqual(["handle", "address", "created_at", "post_ids", "post_times", "report_time", "files"]);
    expect(NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS).toEqual(["not_illegal", "illegal", "no_assessment", "other"]);
    expect(PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS).toEqual(["notification", "demand", "court_order", "seizure", "dsa_art10", "preserved_access"]);
    expect(HANDOVER_INSTRUMENTS.every((kind) => (PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS as readonly string[]).includes(kind))).toBe(true);
    expect(ACCESS_PURPOSES).toEqual(["review", "complaint", "authority"]);
    expect(PRODUCED_KINDS).toEqual([...NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS, "content"]);
    expect(NOT_HELD_KINDS).toEqual(["name", "postal_address", "date_of_birth", "phone_number", "ip_address"]);
  });

  test("what the console learns of an owed report: a case, a kind and a time, and nothing more", () => {
    const owed = { total: 1, items: [{ caseId: "3a0b1c2d-4e5f-4a6b-8c7d-9e0f1a2b3c4d", kind: "sealed_images", since: "2026-10-17T00:00:00.000Z" }] };
    expect(ReportsOwed.parse(owed)).toEqual(owed);
    expect(REPORT_OWED_KINDS).toEqual(["sealed_images", ...NOTIFICATION_DUTIES]);
    expect(ReportsOwed.safeParse({ ...owed, items: [{ ...owed.items[0], kind: "BKA" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    // An authority, a reference or an account would be a member the schema does not know: it is stripped, never passed on.
    const parsed = ReportsOwed.parse({ ...owed, items: [{ ...owed.items[0], authority: "BKA", accountId: "x" }] });
    expect(Object.keys(parsed.items[0]!).sort()).toEqual(["caseId", "kind", "since"]);
  });

  test("W.8's sentence of what korbat does not hold, version 1, word for word", () => {
    expect(RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION).toBe(1);
    expect(RECORDS_NOT_HELD[RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION]).toBe(
      "korbat holds no name, postal address, date of birth, phone number or IP address of this account. It holds IP addresses, and a phone number the account verified, only as keyed hashes that identify nobody outside korbat; a device's hash is deleted 30 days after the device was last seen. korbat also holds, and has not produced here, the times and device types of the account's sign-ins.",
    );
  });

  test("the record's digest: the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, the same whatever the order of its members", async () => {
    const a = await recordDigestOf({ record: { id: "r", state: "sent", duties: ["dsa18_1"] }, events: [] });
    const b = await recordDigestOf({ events: [], record: { duties: ["dsa18_1"], state: "sent", id: "r" } });
    expect(a).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/);
    expect(b).toBe(a);
    expect(await recordDigestOf({ record: { id: "r", state: "owed", duties: ["dsa18_1"] }, events: [] })).not.toBe(a);
  });
});
```
