```ts
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------- 3f, Task 2: an order's steps (section 6.1, the rows marked 0025)

  /** A removal order of the migrator's in the transaction, received `minutes` ago, with an item open or disabled. */
  async function orderIn(tx: DbTx, minutes: number, options: { disabled?: boolean; open?: boolean; kind?: string; verified?: boolean; reasons?: boolean } = {}): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
      insert into public.legal_orders (id, kind, member_state, authority, reference, channel, section_c, emergency, cross_border, withhold_from_author, received_at, opened_at, opened_via,
                                       verified_at, reasons)
      values (gen_random_uuid(), ${options.kind ?? "tco_removal"}, 'DE', 'BKA', ${`S-${randomUUID()}`}, 'portal', false, false, false, true,
              now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), now() - make_interval(mins => ${minutes}), 'cli',
              ${options.verified ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${options.reasons ? "the authority's reasons" : null})
      returning id`);
    if (options.open ?? true) await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 1, 'https://elsewhere.example/open')`);
    if (options.disabled) {
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_items (order_id, position, link, added_at, disabled_at) values (${row!.id}::uuid, 2, 'https://elsewhere.example/done', now() - make_interval(hours => 2), now() - make_interval(mins => 1))`);
    }
    return row!.id;
  }
  const orderRows = async (tx: DbTx, orderId: string) =>
    (await tx.execute<{ kind: string; step: number; scope: string; priority: number; facts: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select kind, step, scope, priority, facts from public.alert_outbox where order_id = ${orderId}::uuid order by id`,
    )).map((r) => ({ ...r }));
  const restart = (tx: DbTx, orderId: string, annexMinutes: number, clarifiedMinutes: number) =>
    tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'manifest_error', now() - make_interval(mins => ${annexMinutes}), 'cli'),
                     (${orderId}::uuid, 'clarification_received', null, now() - make_interval(mins => ${clarifiedMinutes}), 'cli')`);

  test("order_due for an order: at remind_minutes and at the deadline while an item is open, the clock runs and the order is not closed; never for one given effect in full, stopped or closed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const remind = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1);
      const late = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      const partial = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.remindMinutes + 1, { disabled: true });
      const full = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1, { disabled: true, open: false });
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now() - make_interval(mins => 30), 'cli')`);
      const closed = await orderIn(tx, ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes + 1);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set closed_at = now() where id = ${closed}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const due = (rows: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof orderRows>>) => rows.filter((r) => r.kind === "order_due").map((r) => [r.step, r.facts.itemsOpen, r.scope, r.priority]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, late))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, late))[0]!.facts.minutesLeft).toBe(0);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, partial))).toEqual([[0, 1, "all", 5]]);
      for (const none of [full, stopped, closed]) expect(due(await orderRows(tx, none))).toEqual([]);
      // The deadline passes for the order reminded at remind_minutes: the second reminder, once.
      // The order and its first reminder an hour further back, as the hour would have passed.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.legal_orders set received_at = received_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}), opened_at = opened_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - make_interval(mins => ${ORDER_RULES.hourMinutes}) where order_id = ${remind}::uuid`);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(due(await orderRows(tx, remind))).toEqual([
        [0, 1, "all", 5],
        [1, 1, "all", 5],
      ]);
    });
  });

  test("a restart of an order's clock rings the phone on call again, as a message's first push, once a restart; a second restart alerts again", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const order = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, order, 40, 10);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const first = (await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail");
      expect(first.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "on_call", 5, ["dueAt"]]]);
      // The first restart's row was written when it came, nine minutes before the second.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = now() - make_interval(mins => 9) where order_id = ${order}::uuid`);
      await restart(tx, order, 5, 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, order)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail").map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0, 1]);
      // A stopped clock does not ring.
      const stopped = await orderIn(tx, 50);
      await restart(tx, stopped, 40, 10);
      await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.legal_order_events (order_id, kind, ground, at, via) values (${stopped}::uuid, 'annex3_sent', 'force_majeure', now(), 'cli')`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await orderRows(tx, stopped)).filter((r) => r.kind === "contact_mail")).toEqual([]);
    });
  });

  test("order_unverified, daily: one count for orders given effect and not verified (or with an item added after the check), one for missing reasons, one for holds without an end", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'order_unverified'`);
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: true, verified: true, reasons: true });
      await orderIn(tx, 120, { disabled: false });
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "order_unverified", since);
      // The verified order's disabled item was added two hours before its check: it counts as verified.
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, r.facts.textsMissing, r.facts.holdsOpen, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 1, 1, 0, "string"]]);
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 5: report_owed, daily, while a notification record is owed and was opened more than reportAlertHours ago, with how many and the oldest; none once it is sent", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      // Inside a transaction that ends in a rollback: no other file's owed record may count here.
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.authority_notifications`);
      const record = async (hoursAgo: number) => {
        const [row] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`
          insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via, imported_at)
          values ('owed', '{voluntary}', gen_random_uuid(), gen_random_uuid(), now() - make_interval(hours => ${hoursAgo}), 'cli', now()) returning id`);
        return row!.id;
      };
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours - 1);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since)).toEqual([]);
      const late = await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 2);
      await record(ORDER_RULES.reportAlertHours + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, typeof r.facts.oldestAt])).toEqual([[0, "all", 5, 2, "string"]]);
      // Sent, and the day over: nothing more.
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'not identifiable', closed_at = now() where id <> ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.authority_notifications set state = 'declined', declined_reason = 'a check that ended in no', closed_at = now() where id = ${late}::uuid`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update public.alert_outbox set created_at = created_at - interval '1 day 1 minute' where kind = 'report_owed'`);
      await steps(tx);
      expect((await outboxSince(tx, "report_owed", new Date(since.getTime() - 2 * 24 * 60 * MIN))).map((r) => r.step)).toEqual([0]);
      expect(ALERT_KINDS.report_owed.legs).toEqual(["push", "mail"]);
    });
  });

  test("3f Task 5: handover_undestroyed, daily, while a production with files was delivered more than handoverAlertDays ago and is not destroyed", async () => {
    await rolledBack(w.migrateDb, async (tx) => {
      const since = new Date();
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where kind = 'handover_undestroyed'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`delete from public.productions`);
      const production = async (daysAgo: number, destroyed = false) =>
        tx.execute(sql`
          insert into public.productions (instrument, produced, files, archive_sha256, delivered_at, destroyed_at, destroyed_how, opened_at)
          values ('demand', '{files}', '[{"name": "files/ab/x/small.webp", "bytes": 1, "sha256": null}]'::jsonb, ${"a".repeat(64)},
                  now() - make_interval(days => ${daysAgo}), ${destroyed ? sql`now()` : sql`null`}, ${destroyed ? "deleted" : null}, now())`);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays - 1);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays + 3, true);
      await steps(tx);
      expect(await outboxSince(tx, "handover_undestroyed", since)).toEqual([]);
      await production(ORDER_RULES.handoverAlertDays + 1);
      await steps(tx);
      await steps(tx);
      const rows = await outboxSince(tx, "handover_undestroyed", since);
      expect(rows.map((r) => [r.step, r.scope, r.priority, r.facts.count, Object.keys(r.facts)])).toEqual([[0, "all", 3, 1, ["count"]]]);
    });
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    // The tick's own daily test, which no message names, and the rows of this file's kinds of 3f.
    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.alert_outbox where created_at >= ${started.toISOString()}::timestamptz and kind in ('alert_test', 'alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable')`);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, CHANNEL_TABLES)).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
 * ending in "nothing changed", exit 1, and writes nothing. order-open writes the console's rows through insertOrder with
 * the receipt it is given, its alert order_opened before its audit row, and refuses without HOME_STATE and APP_ORIGIN. An
 * order is named by its id or as <CC>:<reference>, order_ambiguous when several share it; an instant has its offset.
 */

  /** The command's printed lines, each marked with its stream, and its exit code; standard input as given. */
  async function cli(args: string[], options: { env?: Record<string, string>; input?: string | Buffer } = {}) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const input = async () => (options.input === undefined ? Buffer.alloc(0) : Buffer.isBuffer(options.input) ? options.input : Buffer.from(options.input, "utf8"));

    const two = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, staff, { reference, authority: "Authority two", links: ["https://e.example/a2"] });
    orders.push(one.id, two.id);
    const named = await cli(["order-verify", `DE:${reference}`, "--how", "x"]);
    expect(named.code).toBe(1);
    expect(named.text).toContain(`err order_ambiguous: 2 orders of DE have this reference; name one by its id:`);
    expect(named.text).toContain(one.id);
    expect(named.text).toContain(two.id);

  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {

    await removeMessages(w.migrateDb, messages.splice(0));
    await removeOrderAlerts(w.migrateDb, started);

    await w.migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from public.posts where author_id = ${author.id}::uuid`);

});

/**
 * The preservation's two commands (3f design, sections 7.11, 8.11 and 10.5; Task 4): order-preserve-extend moves an
 * item's preserve_until forward on an authority's or a court's request, never back, and is refused once the
 * preservation ended (not_preserved); its event preservation_extended names the item and its audit row order_recorded
 * holds the request's facts, the proceedings only as a digest. order-access prints the preserved snapshot's text, its
 * alt texts and the images' ids, sizes and creation times, never an image, and records the access as preserved_accessed
 * with the purpose and the counts; an access for an authority is a production (Task 5): the command takes the
 * authority's name and reference, opens a production of the instrument preserved_access and names it in the audit row.
 * The effect commits with a real key; the last test removes what the block made.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the preservation's commands", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let world: DeciderWorld;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  let before: Record<string, number>;
  let appOrigin: string;
  const posts: string[] = [];
  const people: string[] = [];
  const started = new Date();

  beforeAll(async () => {
    appOrigin = loadConfig().APP_ORIGIN;
    w = noticesWorld();
    world = deciderWorld(w.apiDb);
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    before = await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES]);
    moderator = await world.staff("moderator");
  }, 90_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await closeDb(migrateDb);
    await world.close({ keepStaff: true });
    await closeNotifyFixtures();
    await w.close();
  });

  async function cli(args: string[]) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    const env = { DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE: process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, HOME_STATE: "DE", APP_ORIGIN: appOrigin };
    const code = await runStaffCommand(args, env, { log: (line) => lines.push(`out ${line}`), error: (line) => lines.push(`err ${line}`) }, async () => Buffer.alloc(0));
    return { code, lines, text: lines.join(NEWLINE) };
  }
  /** A post with two images under a removal order given effect with the moderator's real key: its item. */
  async function preserved(): Promise<{ itemId: string; orderId: string; postId: string; mediaIds: string[] }> {
    const p = await imagePost(w.apiDb, 2);
    posts.push(p.postId);
    people.push(p.authorId);
    const order = await orderForTest(w.apiDb, moderator, { posts: [p.postId] });
    const outcome = await effectForTest(world, moderator, order.id, effectParams(order));
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the effect was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return { itemId: outcome.items[0]!.id, orderId: order.id, postId: p.postId, mediaIds: p.mediaIds };
  }
  const item = async (id: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ until: string; ended: string | null }>(
      sql`select to_char(preserve_until at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as until, preserve_ended_at::text as ended from public.legal_order_items where id = ${id}::uuid`,
    ))[0]!;
  const lastAudit = async (targetId: string) =>
    (await migrateDb.execute<{ action: string; actor_id: string; target_type: string; metadata: Record<string, unknown> }>(
      sql`select action, actor_id, target_type, metadata from public.audit_log where target_id = ${targetId} order by chain_seq desc limit 1`,
    ))[0]!;
  const digest = (text: string) => createHash("sha256").update(text, "utf8").digest("hex");

  test("the usage lists both commands", () => {
    for (const command of ["order-preserve-extend", "order-access"]) expect(STAFF_USAGE, command).toContain(`  ${command} `);
  });

  test("order-preserve-extend moves preserve_until forward, records the request, and is refused backwards, without a flag and once the preservation ended", async () => {
    const { itemId, orderId } = await preserved();
    const was = (await item(itemId)).until;
    const later = new Date(Date.parse(was) + 90 * 86_400_000).toISOString();
    const received = new Date(Date.now() - 3_600_000).toISOString();
    const args = (until: string) => ["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", until, "--by", "Landgericht Berlin", "--reference", "AZ 501/26", "--proceedings", "review of the removal order", "--received", received];
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(was) - 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(`err order-preserve-extend: --until is not later than the preservation's end, ${was}; nothing changed`);
    expect((await cli(["order-preserve-extend", itemId, "--until", later, "--by", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    const done = await cli(args(later));
    expect(done.text).toBe(`out order-preserve-extend: item ${itemId} is preserved until ${later} (was ${was}).`);
    expect((await item(itemId)).until).toBe(later);
    const [event] = await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; via: string; effective: string }>(
      sql`select kind, via, to_char(effective_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"') as effective from public.legal_order_events where item_id = ${itemId}::uuid and kind = 'preservation_extended'`,
    );
    expect([event!.kind, event!.via, event!.effective]).toEqual(["preservation_extended", "cli", received]);
    const audit = await lastAudit(orderId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["order_recorded", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ event: "preservation_extended", itemId, until: later, was, received, by: "Landgericht Berlin", reference: "AZ 501/26", proceedingsSha256: digest("review of the removal order") });
    // Once the preservation ended (here by hand, as the migrator), nothing moves it.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update public.legal_order_items set preserve_ended_at = now() where id = ${itemId}::uuid`);
    expect((await cli(args(new Date(Date.parse(later) + 86_400_000).toISOString()))).text).toBe(
      `err order-preserve-extend: not_preserved: item ${itemId} is not preserved, or its preservation has ended; nothing changed`,
    );
  });

  test("order-access prints the preserved text, alt texts and image facts, never an image, and records the access; an authority's access is a production", async () => {
    const { itemId, mediaIds } = await preserved();
    const done = await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "review", "--for", "the court asked to see it"]);
    expect(done.code).toBe(0);
    expect(done.lines[0]).toBe("out order-access: recorded, purpose review.");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out a post");
    expect(done.lines).toContain("out order-access: alt text of image 1: image 1");
    for (const id of mediaIds) expect(done.text).toMatch(new RegExp(`order-access: image ${id}: 1200 x 800 pixels, created [0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T`));
    const audit = await lastAudit(itemId);
    expect([audit.action, audit.actor_id, audit.target_type]).toEqual(["preserved_accessed", SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID, "order_item"]);
    expect(audit.metadata).toEqual({ purpose: "review", productionId: null, forSha256: digest("the court asked to see it"), images: 2, altTexts: 2, textLength: 6 });
    // Task 5: an authority's access names the authority and its reference, and is recorded as a production.
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "authority", "--for", "BKA"])).text).toBe("err order-access: --authority is required; nothing changed");
    const forAuthority = await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "authority", "--for", "the proceedings", "--authority", "BKA", "--reference", "ST 7/26"]);
    expect(forAuthority.code).toBe(0);
    const recorded = /^out order-access: recorded, purpose authority, production ([0-9a-f-]{36})[.]$/.exec(forAuthority.lines[0]!);
    expect(recorded).not.toBeNull();
    const [production] = await migrateDb.execute<Record<string, unknown>>(
      sql`select instrument, purpose, order_item_id, authority, their_reference, produced, account_id is not null as named from public.productions where id = ${recorded![1]!}::uuid`,
    );
    expect({ ...production }).toEqual({ instrument: "preserved_access", purpose: "authority", order_item_id: itemId, authority: "BKA", their_reference: "ST 7/26", produced: ["content"], named: true });
    expect((await lastAudit(itemId)).metadata).toMatchObject({ purpose: "authority", productionId: recorded![1]! });
    expect((await cli(["order-access", itemId, "--purpose", "curiosity", "--for", "x"])).code).toBe(1);
    expect((await cli(["order-access", randomUUID(), "--purpose", "review", "--for", "x"])).text).toMatch(/^err order-access: not_preserved: /);
  });

  test("leaves no row behind", async () => {
    await removeDecided(world.migrateDb, posts, [moderator.id]);
    await removeOrderAlerts(world.migrateDb, started);
    await removeFixtures(world.migrateDb, people);
    expect(await rowCounts(w.apiDb, [...ORDER_TABLES, ...CHANNEL_TABLES])).toEqual(before);
  });
});
```

```ts
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(sealed.authorId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const cleared = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(cleared.postId));
        const noAction = await decideIn(tx, mod, third.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const decisions = [withheld, removal, seal, noAction];
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [...decisions, ...(await placesOf(tx, decisions)), removed.postId, sealed.postId, cleared.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, ...cleared.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];

        const report1 = await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER);
        expect(about(report1.problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(report1.decisions).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(4);
        expect(report1.seals).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect(report1.images).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5);
        expect(report1.problemCount).toBe(report1.problems.length);
        expect(report1.ok).toBe(report1.problemCount === 0);

        // Retention at work is nothing to report: an erased snapshot and an erased text keep their rows and digests.
        await ageCase(tx, third.caseId, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${third.caseId}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update staff_texts set text = null, salt = null, erased_at = now() where case_id = ${first.caseId}::uuid and confirmed_at is not null`);
        expect(about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine)).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a decision changed as the migrator, a measure removed, a text and a snapshot that are gone or altered, and a decision with no row or with a row and no decision", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "illegal");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [removal]);
        const q = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q.postId));
        const kept = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [keptPlace] = await placesOf(tx, [kept]);
        const mine = [removal, kept, place!, keptPlace!, p.postId];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // The decision's rule and outcome rewritten: what the key confirmed is no longer what is stored.
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE', through_seq = 0 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: category, throughSeq`]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set category = ${SPEECH}, through_seq = 1 where id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // Its measure taken out of the ledger: the decision no longer holds what its row lists, and the post's level no longer follows.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decision_actions where decision_id = ${removal}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`, "post: its level is stored as removed, and the ledger of measures gives visible"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.moderation_apply(array[${p.postId}]::uuid[], true)`);
        // A text deleted, and a snapshot's content rewritten.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where digest = (select legal_reference_digest from decisions where id = ${removal}::uuid)`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = 'another body' where case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([
          "audit: its legalReferenceDigest names no saved text",
          "audit: the snapshot it names no longer recomputes to its digest",
          `decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: actions`,
        ]);
        // The other decision deleted outright, with what hangs on it: its row in the record now names nothing korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intake_items set answered_by = null, outcome = null where answered_by = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from staff_texts where decision_id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from decisions where id = ${kept}::uuid`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(keptPlace)))).toEqual([`decision: the audit row at place ${keptPlace} names it, and korbat holds no such decision`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 5: a decision that marked reports verifies with its marks, a mark taken out of the record or a row whose list was altered is reported, and a row signed before 3e reads its missing list as none", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        const second = await intake(tx, ground.rule((await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)).id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId));
        const items = [first.recorded.items[0]!.id, second.items[0]!.id].sort();
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const q2 = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const other = await report(tx, aPost(q2.postId));
        const plain = await decideIn(tx, mod, other.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        const [place, plainPlace] = [(await placesOf(tx, [marked]))[0]!, (await placesOf(tx, [plain]))[0]!];
        const mine = [marked, plain, place, plainPlace];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The params signed both marks; one taken out of the record as the migrator is a difference in `unfounded`.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
        // A row signed before 3e carries neither member: its missing list reads as no marks, its missing replaced as false.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' #- '{params,replaced}' where chain_seq = ${plainPlace}::bigint`);
        expect((await found()).filter((line) => line.includes(String(plainPlace)))).toEqual([]);
        // And such a row beside a decision that holds a mark is reported: what was not signed is not what korbat holds.
        await tx.execute(sql`update audit_log set metadata = metadata #- '{params,unfounded}' where chain_seq = ${place}::bigint`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("3e Task 7: a mark that korbat's own rules deleted is no difference: its report's day left the frame (the retention job's step) or its sender was forgotten (the account's purge); a mark deleted while korbat still knows its report and sender is", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const senders = [await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db), await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db)];
        const reports = [];
        for (const sender of senders) reports.push(await intake(tx, ground.rule(sender.id, "R1"), aPost(p.postId)));
        const items = reports.map((recorded) => recorded.items[0]!.id);
        const marked = await decideIn(tx, mod, reports[0]!.items[0]!.caseId!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", unfounded: items });
        const [place] = await placesOf(tx, [marked]);
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, [marked, place!]).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The first report's day leaves the frame: forget_report_counts deletes its mark, as the retention job does.
        await tx.execute(sql`update intakes set received_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where id = ${reports[0]!.intakeId}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`update unfounded_marks set reported_at = now() - make_interval(days => ${STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays}::int) where item_id = ${items[0]!}::uuid`);
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_report_counts()`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 2 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The second sender's account is deleted: its purge forgets who sent the report and deletes the mark with it.
        await authAccount(tx, senders[1]!.id, "0 seconds");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.forget_reporter(${senders[1]!.id}::uuid)`);
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select count(*)::int as n from unfounded_marks where decision_id = ${marked}::uuid`)).toEqual({ n: 1 });
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);
        // The third mark taken out by hand, while its report is in the frame and its sender known: that is a difference.
        await tx.execute(sql`delete from unfounded_marks where item_id = ${items[2]!}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`decision: it differs from the audit row at place ${place} that names it: unfounded`]);
      });
    });

    test("it reports a post whose level the migrator set by hand, an image whose state was set, and a seal in force one of whose listed posts has lost an image row", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const removed = await imagePost(tx, 1);
        const first = await report(tx, aPost(removed.postId));
        await decideIn(tx, mod, first.caseId, { kind: "final", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const sealed = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(sealed.postId), "csam");
        const seal = await decideIn(tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const [sealAction] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from decision_actions where decision_id = ${seal}::uuid`);
        const mine = [removed.postId, sealed.postId, ...removed.mediaIds, ...sealed.mediaIds, sealAction!.id];
        const found = async () => about((await textVerify(tx, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)).problems, mine).sort();
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A removed post made visible again by hand, around the one writer of the level.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'visible', state = 'visible' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its level is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives removed"]);
        // The level put right and only the state left: the two must agree unless the author deleted the post.
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set moderation_level = 'removed' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["post: its state is stored as visible, and its level is removed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author' where id = ${removed.postId}::uuid`);
        expect(await found()).toEqual([]);

        // A sealed image shown again by hand.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'visible' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        expect(await found()).toEqual(["image: its state is stored as visible, and the ledger of measures gives sealed"]);
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`update post_media set moderation_state = 'sealed' where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[0]!}'`));
        // A sealed image row destroyed, which only the owner of the database can do: the keep trigger switched off first.
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media disable trigger post_media_keep"));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw(`delete from post_media where id = '${sealed.mediaIds[1]!}'`));
        await tx.execute(sql.raw("alter table public.post_media enable trigger post_media_keep"));
        expect(await found()).toEqual([`seal: it lists post ${sealed.postId} with 2 image rows, and the post has 1 now`]);
      });
    });

    test("the command itself reads on the API's role alone and exits 1 with what it found", async () => {
      // The shared database holds audit rows of decisions that earlier suites removed again, so the run is at fault or clean
      // by what they left; either way it reads, counts and answers, and the exit code follows its first line.
      const run = await cli(["text-verify"], { DATABASE_URL_API: process.env.DATABASE_URL_API! });
      expect(run.lines[0]).toMatch(/^(out text-verify: what the record names is what korbat holds: |err text-verify: FAILED, [0-9]+ problems? in )[0-9]+ confirmed rows, [0-9]+ decisions, [0-9]+ posts, [0-9]+ images and [0-9]+ seals in force/);
      expect(run.code).toBe(run.lines[0]!.startsWith("out ") ? 0 : 1);
    });
  });

  describe("access-request and an authority's demand (3f Task 5)", () => {
    test("a case whose notification record carries a running 'not to the person' is marked access.authorityHold in place of the lane-0 mark, with its day or an open end; one whose end passed is not; the handle's draft runs as the migrator", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // A seal opens the case's record; an authority then asks that the person is not told, with no end.
        const suspect = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        const event = (caseId: string, until: string | null) =>
          tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notification_events (notification_id, kind, at, how, not_to_person, not_to_person_until)
                         select n.id, 'request', now(), 'a letter', true, ${until}::timestamptz from public.authority_notifications n where n.case_id = ${caseId}::uuid`);
        await event(suspect.caseId, null);
        // Two lane-0 cases with records the command line opened: one with an end ahead, one whose end passed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const ahead = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const third = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const passed = await report(tx, aPost(third.postId), "rule", "R5");
        for (const caseId of [ahead.caseId, passed.caseId]) {
          await tx.execute(sql`insert into public.authority_notifications (state, duties, case_id, account_id, opened_at, opened_via) values ('owed', '{dsa18_1}', ${caseId}::uuid, ${p.authorId}::uuid, now(), 'cli')`);
        }
        await event(ahead.caseId, "2030-01-02T03:00:00Z");
        await event(passed.caseId, "2020-01-02T03:00:00Z");

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere, (ids) => authorityHoldsFor(tx, ids));
        const cases = new Map(((drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; authorityHold: string | null }[]).map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect(cases.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null) });
        expect(cases.get(ahead.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: null, authorityHold: ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold("2030-01-02") });
        expect(cases.get(passed.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, authorityHold: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorityHold(null)).toBe(
          "An authority asked that this person is not told of its request (no end given yet). Do not send this case's part of the draft, and do not say that an authority is the reason, before counsel has read it.",
        );
        // Without the migrator's reader nothing is marked: the API's role reads no record.
        const plain = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContactsHere);
        expect(((plain as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft.cases as { authorityHold: string | null }[]).every((c) => c.authorityHold === null)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a handle's draft runs in the migrate service: without the migrator's URL and APP_ORIGIN it is refused and drafts nothing", async () => {
      const lines: string[] = [];

      expect(code).toBe(1);
      expect(lines).toEqual(["access-request: a handle's draft runs in the migrate service, which holds DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE and APP_ORIGIN; nothing was drafted"]);

  });

  describe("access-request", () => {
    const noContacts = async () => [];

    test("for a handle: every case with its items' sources and grounds, its snapshots (an erased one without content, a sealed image by id and state), its decisions and appeals; the urgent cases marked; no reporter anywhere; one audit row of counts", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 2);
        const author = await one<{ handle: string }>(tx, sql`select handle from profiles where id = ${p.authorId}::uuid`);
        // Lane 2, closed without action, and its evidence erased: the snapshot is printed with its day and no content.
        const reporter = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const quiet = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(reporter.id), aPost(p.postId));
        const quietCase = quiet.items[0]!.caseId!;
        await decideIn(tx, mod, quietCase, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        await ageCase(tx, quietCase, "3 days");
        await tx.execute(sql`select public.erase_case_evidence(${quietCase}::uuid)`);
        // Lane 0, closed: a report under R5 that an admin answered with a removal, which the author appealed.
        const second = await imagePost(tx, 0, p.authorId);
        const threat = await report(tx, aPost(second.postId), "rule", "R5");
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, admin, threat.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R5", actions: [act("remove")] });
        await appealOf(tx, removal, p.authorId, "It was a joke.");
        // Lane 0, open: a report of child sexual abuse material about the account, its images sealed while deciding.
        const suspect = await report(tx, anAccount(p.authorId, author.handle), "csam");
        await decideIn(tx, mod, suspect.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
        // A new look at the first post, in a case of its own: its snapshot lists the two images, now sealed.
        const third = await report(tx, aPost(p.postId));
        // The account's own report about someone else.
        const elsewhere = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const own = await intake(tx, ground.illegal(p.authorId), aPost(elsewhere.postId));

        const drafted = await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: `@${author.handle.toUpperCase()}` }, noContacts);
        expect(drafted.ok).toBe(true);
        const draft = (drafted as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft;
        const cases = draft.cases as { id: string; authoritiesCheck: string | null; closedAt: string | null; items: Record<string, unknown>[]; snapshots: { id: string; erasedOn: string | null; withheld: boolean; content: { body: string | null; media: Record<string, unknown>[] } | null }[]; decisions: Record<string, unknown>[]; appeals: Record<string, unknown>[] }[];
        const byId = new Map(cases.map((c) => [c.id, c]));
        expect([...byId.keys()].sort()).toEqual([quietCase, threat.caseId, suspect.caseId, third.caseId].sort());

        // The lane-2 case is not marked; the two urgent ones are, the closed one too.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(third.caseId)!.authoritiesCheck).toBeNull();
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: expect.any(String) });
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)).toMatchObject({ authoritiesCheck: ACCESS_WORDS.authorities, closedAt: null });
        expect(ACCESS_WORDS.authorities).toBe("check the R2, Art. 18 and order records before sending: an authority may need the person not to be told yet, or national law may restrict access (GDPR Art. 23(1)(d))");

        // Sources as categories, with ground, rule and category.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.items).toEqual([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "illegal content", rule: null, category: SPEECH, arrivedAt: expect.any(String) }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a report by another user", ground: "a korbat rule", rule: "R5" }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.items).toMatchObject([{ source: "a notice under Article 16", ground: "child sexual abuse material", rule: null }]);

        // The erased snapshot: its day, and no content.
        expect(byId.get(quietCase)!.snapshots).toEqual([{ id: expect.any(String), takenAt: expect.any(String), erasedOn: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), withheld: true, content: null }]);
        // A held snapshot with its content; each sealed image by id and state, and nothing more.
        const shown = byId.get(third.caseId)!.snapshots[0]!;
        expect(shown).toMatchObject({ erasedOn: null, withheld: false, content: { body: "a post" } });
        expect(shown.content!.media).toEqual(p.mediaIds.map((id) => ({ id, state: "sealed" })));
        // The decisions with their statement's data and texts, and the author's own appeal with its statement.
        // 3e: the removal under R5 gave the post its strike, which the draft lists among the decision's measures.
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ id: removal, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", rule: "R5", measures: [{ kind: "remove", image: null, noEffect: null }, { kind: "strike", image: null, noEffect: null }], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(threat.caseId)!.appeals).toMatchObject([{ decisionId: removal, statement: "It was a joke.", result: null }]);
        expect(byId.get(suspect.caseId)!.decisions).toMatchObject([{ kind: "interim", rule: "R2", measures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] }]);

        // Under withheld: the identities, counted and never printed, and each text another person wrote, marked.
        expect(draft.withheld.identities).toEqual({ count: 3, reason: "rights of others: GDPR Art. 15(4), recital 63" });
        expect(draft.withheld.texts).toEqual([{ caseId: quietCase, kind: "explanation", text: "It breaks the law.", note: "send only after a person has weighed the writer's rights (C-203/22)" }]);
        const printed = JSON.stringify(draft);
        for (const hidden of [reporter.id, reporter.handle, quiet.intakeId]) expect(printed).not.toContain(hidden);
        // The account's own reports, as it sent them.
        expect(draft.ownReports).toMatchObject([{ ref: own.ref, ground: "illegal content", explanation: "It breaks the law.", items: [{ item: 1, link: `${ORIGIN}/post/${elsewhere.postId}`, shownOutcome: null, reexamination: false }] }]);
        // One audit row: the account, and counts.
        expect((await auditRows(tx, "access_request_drafted", p.authorId)).map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([{ actor_id: "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000", target_type: "user", target_id: p.authorId, metadata: { cases: 4, contacts: 0 }, step_up: null }]);

        expect(await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: "nobody_has_this" }, noContacts)).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "no account has the handle @nobody_has_this" });
      });
    });

    test("an R4 removal made final leaves no R4 text in the draft: the snapshots are printed without content and the post's body is gone", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const author = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const secret = `a home address ${randomUUID()}`;
        const [post] = await tx.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`insert into posts (author_id, body, created_at) values (${author.id}::uuid, ${secret}, now() - interval '30 days') returning id`);
        const { caseId } = await report(tx, aPost(post!.id));
        const removal = await decideIn(tx, mod, caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("remove")] });
        const draftOf = async () => JSON.stringify(((await accessRequest(tx, ORIGIN, { handle: author.handle }, noContacts)) as { draft: AccountAccessDraft }).draft);
        expect(await draftOf()).toContain(secret);
        await ageCase(tx, caseId, "7 months");
        expect(await one(tx, sql`select public.redact_r4_body(${removal}::uuid) as done`)).toEqual({ done: true });
        const after = await draftOf();
        expect(after).not.toContain(secret);
        expect(after).toContain('"contentErasedOn":"');
      });
    });

    test("for an address: the contacts the auth module found, each with the name it gave and its notices; the audit row names nobody", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (tx) => {
        const p = await imagePost(tx, 0);
        const named = await newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
        const contactId = randomUUID();
        const intakeId = await insertIntake(tx, { kind: "user", channel: "signed_out", contactId, allegesIllegal: true, category: SPEECH, explanation: "This post is unlawful.", citedLaw: "Section 5", bonaFide: true, lookupHash: hex64() });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "post", p.postId), targetId: p.postId, lane: 1 });
        await insertItem(tx, { intakeId, caseId: await openCase(tx, "account", named.id), targetType: "account", targetId: named.id, position: 2, lane: 1, namedHandle: "as_named" });
        const [notice] = await tx.execute<{ ref: string }>(sql`select ref from intakes where id = ${intakeId}::uuid`);
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import type { MeProfile } from "@korbat/contracts";
import pino from "pino";
import type { AuthConfig, AuthDeps, ProfileStore, RequestContext } from "../../src/auth/context";
import { decrypt, parseVersionedKey, randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { signIn } from "../../src/auth/flows/signin";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { createLockout } from "../../src/auth/lockout";
import { hashPassword } from "../../src/auth/passwords";
import type { AuthRepo } from "../../src/auth/repo";
import { createSessions } from "../../src/auth/sessions";
import { currentStep, hotp } from "../../src/auth/totp";
import { devProvider } from "../../src/auth/verify/dev";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { fakeClock } from "./auth-fixtures";

/**
 * Handles unique per store, like the real public.profiles index. A new profile has never changed its handle, holds no
 * badge and shows its posts in Explore, as the column's default has it.
 */
export function memoryProfiles(): ProfileStore {
  const byHandle = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  const byId = new Map<string, MeProfile>();
  return {
    async create({ id, handle, displayName }) {
      if (byHandle.has(handle) || byId.has(id)) return { ok: false, reason: "handle_taken" };
      const profile = { id, handle, displayName, handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true };
      byHandle.set(handle, profile);
      byId.set(id, profile);
      return { ok: true, profile: { id, handle, displayName } };
    },
    async find(id) {
      return byId.get(id) ?? null;
    },
    async setVerified(id, at) {
      const profile = byId.get(id);
      if (profile) profile.verified = at !== null;
      return true;
    },
    // No account of these suites is suspended: the real store and its predicate are http-badge.test.ts's.
    async suspended() {
      return false;
    },
  };
}

export const TEST_TERMS = "draft-test";
export const CHROME_WINDOWS = "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/139.0.0.0 Safari/537.36";

/**
 * Real auth repository (Postgres) with an in-memory key-value store, mailer and profile store, a fake
 * clock shared by all of them, Turnstile that fails only for the token "fail", and a breach checker
 * that flags passwords containing "breached". A suite whose profiles live in the public schema (the
 * deletion flow compares the typed handle with the profile's) passes the real profile store instead. The staff
 * console is off unless a suite names its origin and relying party ID, as the staff suites do (3a design, section 12).
 */
export function flowHarness(repo: AuthRepo, options: { profiles?: ProfileStore; console?: { origin: string; rpId: string } } = {}) {
  const clock = fakeClock();
  const kv = new MemoryKv(clock.ms);
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const config: AuthConfig = {
    appOrigin: "http://localhost:8081",
    allowedOrigins: ["http://localhost:8081"],
    authHmacKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 3),
    ipHashKey: Buffer.alloc(32, 4),
    totpKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 5).toString("base64")}`),
    totpPreviousKeys: [],
    notifierKey: parseVersionedKey(`v1:${Buffer.alloc(32, 6).toString("base64")}`),
    notifierPreviousKeys: [],
    termsVersion: TEST_TERMS,
    trustProxy: "none",
    verifyProvider: "dev",
    webauthn: { rpId: "localhost", rpName: "korbat", origins: ["http://localhost:8081"] },
    console: options.console ?? null,
    homeState: null,
    contactPoint: null,
    // 3f Task 5: the report hold, on as by default.
    reportHold: true,
  };
  const deps: AuthDeps = {
    repo,
    kv,
    mailer,
    config,
    now: clock.now,
    sessions: createSessions({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    lockout: createLockout({ repo, kv, now: clock.now }),
    turnstile: { verify: async (token) => token !== "fail" },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async (password) => password.includes("breached") },
    profiles: options.profiles ?? memoryProfiles(),
    verify: devProvider(),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
  };
  const ctx: RequestContext = { ipHash: randomToken(), userAgent: CHROME_WINDOWS };
  return { deps, clock, kv, mailer, ctx };
}

export type FlowHarness = ReturnType<typeof flowHarness>;

export const newTestEmail = (prefix = "flow") => `${prefix}-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
export const newTestDevice = () => ({ deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" as const });
export const wrongCode = (code: string) => String((Number(code) + 1) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0");

/** An onboarded account, optionally with a password, signed in on one web device. */
export async function onboardedUser(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, options: { password?: string } = {}) {
  const email = newTestEmail("account");
  const created = await repo.createUser({ email, termsVersion: TEST_TERMS, now: new Date() });
  await repo.markOnboarded(created.id, new Date());
  if (options.password) await repo.setPasswordHash(created.id, await hashPassword(options.password), new Date());
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(created.id))!;
  const device = newTestDevice();
  const signed = await signIn(h.deps, user, device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
  return { email, user, device, session: signed.issued.session, token: signed.issued.token };
}

export type OnboardedUser = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof onboardedUser>>;

/** The TOTP code for a user's stored secret at the harness clock. */
export async function currentTotpCode(h: FlowHarness, repo: AuthRepo, userId: string): Promise<string> {
  const user = (await repo.findUserById(userId))!;
  const secret = new Uint8Array(decrypt(user.totpSecretEnc!, [h.deps.config.totpKey]));
  return hotp(secret, currentStep(h.clock.ms()));
}
```

```ts
import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    // 3e: only the migrator writes a suspension into a profile row, as the ledger's standing_apply does.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 1 });
    const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
    auth = createAuth({
      config,
      logger,
      authDb,
      kv: new MemoryKv(),
      mailer,
      profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
      turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
      breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
    });
    const media = createMedia({
      apiDb,
      uploadsDir: path.join(root, "uploads"),
      storeDir: path.join(root, "store"),
      formats: config.MEDIA_FORMATS,
      minFreeBytes: 0,
      logger,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      resolveSession: auth.resolveSession,
      rateLimitStore,
      enforceUploadLimit: (userId, accountCreatedAt, at) => enforceWriteLimit(rateLimitStore, userId, "upload", accountCreatedAt, at),
    });
    await media.prepare();
    const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), media: media.forPosts, events: { append: auth.appendEvent } });
    const account = createAccount({
      auth: auth.forAccount,
      social: social.forAccount,
      media: media.forAccount,
      requireSession: auth.requireSession,
      requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
      requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
      rateLimitStore,
      logger,
    });
    app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, media, account });
  });
  afterAll(async () => {
    rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** A signed-in web account, onboarded unless told otherwise. */
  async function signUp(onboard = true) {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `deletion-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = newHandle();
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });

    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);

  /** The session's only factor is the sign-up's email code; moved ten minutes back, nothing within the window is left, so the freshness check fails. */
  async function makeStale(b: Browser) {

    expect(refused.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await error(refused)).code).toBe("reauth_required");
    const refusedConfirm = await stale.b.fetch("/api/account/delete/confirm", { json: { flowId: randomToken(), code: "123456", handle: stale.handle } });
    expect(refusedConfirm.status).toBe(403);
    expect((await error(refusedConfirm)).code).toBe("reauth_required");
    // Nothing was sent or changed for a refused start.

    expect((await stale.b.fetch("/api/me")).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("the typed handle must be the account's own, then the code must be right", async () => {

    const code = mailer.lastCodeFor(ada.email)!;

    const mismatch = await ada.b.fetch("/api/account/delete/confirm", { json: { flowId, code, handle: "someone_else" } });
    expect(mismatch.status).toBe(400);

    const wrong = await ada.b.fetch("/api/account/delete/confirm", { json: { flowId, code: String((Number(code) + 1) % 1_000_000).padStart(6, "0"), handle: ada.handle } });
    expect(wrong.status).toBe(400);
    expect((await error(wrong)).code).toBe("invalid_code");
    // Still signed in, still there.
    expect((await ada.b.fetch("/api/me")).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/profiles/${ada.handle}`)).status).toBe(200);
  });

  test("a web session's deletion answers 204 with both cookies cleared, and leaves nothing of the account reachable", async () => {

    expect(started.status).toBe(200);
    const deletion = DeleteStartResponse.parse(await started.json());
    const confirmed = await native.fetch("/api/account/delete/confirm", { json: { flowId: deletion.flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email)!, handle } });
    expect(confirmed.status).toBe(204);
    expect(confirmed.headers.getSetCookie()).toHaveLength(0);
    expect((await native.fetch("/api/me")).status).toBe(401);
    expect((await app.request(`/api/profiles/${handle}`)).status).toBe(404);
  });
});
```

```ts
const SEAL_FOR_GOOD: DecisionInput = { kind: "final", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] };

/**
 * Every method of the media repository, in one record (3c design, section 12). A method that deletes image rows is run
 * against a frozen post below; a method that gives an image, or what an image is, to someone is run against sealed
 * images; and a method that does neither says why. The record is typed over the repository's methods and compared with
 * them at run time, so a method added to createMediaRepo fails this file until whoever adds it has said which it is,
 * and a new deleter or reader fails it until it has a run of its own.
 */
type Role = { is: "deleter" } | { is: "reader" } | { is: "neither"; why: string };
const METHODS: Record<keyof MediaRepo, Role> = {
  accountCreatedAt: { is: "neither", why: "reads when an account was onboarded, and no image row" },
  pendingCount: { is: "neither", why: "counts an account's uploads that are on no post" },
  insertProcessing: { is: "neither", why: "inserts an upload on no post" },
  find: { is: "reader" },
  finalize: { is: "neither", why: "records the worker's verdict on an upload that is still processing" },
  deleteUnattached: { is: "deleter" },
  fileAccess: { is: "reader" },
  attach: { is: "neither", why: "puts its author's own upload on a new post" },
  detachAll: { is: "deleter" },
  purgeOwner: { is: "deleter" },
  forPosts: { is: "reader" },
  readyImages: { is: "reader" },
  isExportable: { is: "reader" },
  processingIds: { is: "neither", why: "lists uploads that are still processing, which are on no post" },
  failStale: { is: "neither", why: "fails uploads that are still processing, which are on no post" },
  deleteUnattachedBefore: { is: "deleter" },
  existing: { is: "neither", why: "says which ids have a row, to the reconcile pass, and must see every row" },
  deleteRow: { is: "deleter" },
  hold: { is: "neither", why: "locks image rows and places holds; what it answers is text and sizes for a case's snapshot" },
  reach: { is: "neither", why: "answers counts, a day and a time, never an id or anything of an image" },
  staffAccess: { is: "reader" },
  dropDisposable: { is: "deleter" },
  overdueDeletions: { is: "neither", why: "answers how many rows the disposal should have taken by now" },
  moderationStates: { is: "neither", why: "answers each attached row's id, post, stored state and erasure time to text-verify, and nothing of an image itself" },
  // 3f, Task 2: opening an order takes an image's address as its post, and an order's screen counts a post's images.
  imagePost: { is: "neither", why: "answers which post an image id is attached to, for an order's item, and nothing of the image" },
  imageCounts: { is: "neither", why: "answers how many image rows each post holds, for an order's screen, and nothing of an image" },
  preservedImages: { is: "neither", why: "answers a preserved post's image ids, pixel sizes and creation times for order-access, never a file or its content" },
  // 3f Task 5: the image rows of one seal's posts, by id, for handover-list, which prints their stored names; it opens no

  sealImageRows: { is: "neither", why: "answers the ids of the image rows of a seal's posts for handover-list, never a file or its content" },
};
const methodsThatAre = (role: Role["is"]) => (Object.keys(METHODS) as (keyof MediaRepo)[]).filter((name) => METHODS[name].is === role).sort();

/** What a deleter is run on: the repository on the test's transaction, and the frozen post with its author and images. */
interface Frozen {
  repo: MediaRepo;
  tx: DbTx;
  ownerId: string;
  postId: string;

}

/** Each deleter run as hard as it can be against the post's images; it answers the ids it says are gone. */
const DELETERS = {
  deleteUnattached: async (f: Frozen) => {
    const gone: string[] = [];
    for (const id of f.mediaIds) if (await f.repo.deleteUnattached(id, f.ownerId)) gone.push(id);
    return gone;
  },
  detachAll: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.detachAll(f.tx, f.postId),
  purgeOwner: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.purgeOwner(f.tx, f.ownerId),
  // Every upload on no post that is older than tomorrow: every one there is.
  deleteUnattachedBefore: (f: Frozen) => f.repo.deleteUnattachedBefore(new Date(Date.now() + DAY)),
  deleteRow: async (f: Frozen) => {
    for (const id of f.mediaIds) await f.repo.deleteRow(id);
    return [] as string[];
  },
  // Batch after batch until one is not full: everything that is disposable now.
  dropDisposable: async (f: Frozen) => {
    const gone: string[] = [];
    for (;;) {
      const batch = await f.repo.dropDisposable(f.tx, 500);
      gone.push(...batch);
      if (batch.length < 500) return gone;
    }
  },
} satisfies Partial<Record<keyof MediaRepo, (f: Frozen) => Promise<string[]>>>;

        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining([...free.mediaIds, upload].filter((id) => !kept.includes(id))));
        for (const id of frozen.mediaIds) expect((await ask(w, id, ada.id)).kind).toBe("not_found");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, frozen.postId)).toBe(true);
      });
    });

    test("a purge whose transaction does not commit has asked for no file: a report that then freezes the account keeps rows whose files nobody was told to delete, neither the rerun nor the sweeper asks for them, and a seal lists images that are still there", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => own.mediaIds.includes(id));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The first run deletes the rows, and its transaction does not commit: the process stops, or the connection is lost.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        // The rows are back, and no file of them was asked for: the worker deletes whatever a request names.
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // Before the purge job's next round, a report on the protected path about the account: every image is frozen.
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId)).toBe(true);
        // The job's rerun keeps the frozen rows and asks for nothing of them.
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(await existing(w.tx, own.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(own.mediaIds));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        // The sweeper, which asks again for whatever a deleter still owes: a row that is still there is owed nothing,
        // at once or two days on, when the marker the failed run left is forgotten.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(Date.now() + 2 * DAY), { reconcile: true });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).filter((entry) => own.mediaIds.includes(entry.id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of own.mediaIds) expect(await w.h.files.imageRemains(id)).toBe(true);

        // An admin seals: the seal lists the rows, and their files are there for whoever they are released to.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, SEAL_FOR_GOOD);
        const states = await w.tx.execute<{ moderation_state: string }>(sql`select moderation_state from post_media where id = any(${uuids(own.mediaIds)})`);
        expect(states.map((row) => row.moderation_state)).toEqual(["sealed", "sealed"]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
      });
    });

    test("a purge that commits and whose request for the files then fails still finishes: what it deleted stays owed, is counted as late, and the sweeper's next pass asks for exactly those files", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const upload = await w.h.readyImage(ada.id);
        const mine = [...own.mediaIds, upload];
        const requested = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const owed = async () => sorted((await w.h.files.owedDeletions(Date.now())).map((entry) => entry.id).filter((id) => mine.includes(id)));
        const deps = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        // The requests' directory cannot be written when the purge comes to ask.
        const failing: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          media: mediaForAccount({
            ...w.h.deps,
            files: {
              ...w.h.files,
              requestDeletion: async () => {
                throw new Error("EROFS: the uploads volume cannot be written");
              },
            },
          }),
        };
        await purge(failing, ada.id);
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id]);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, mine)).toEqual([]);
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await owed()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        // Ten minutes on, what is still owed counts among the late erasures of the staff's home screen.
        const drained = await mediaForCases(w.h.deps).overdueDeletions();
        const later = mediaForCases({ ...w.h.deps, now: () => new Date(Date.now() + 11 * 60_000) });
        expect((await later.overdueDeletions()) - drained).toBe(mine.length);

        // The sweeper's next pass, with the volume back: the files are asked for, and nothing is owed any more.
        await sweep(w.h.deps, new Date(), { reconcile: false });
        expect(await requested()).toEqual(sorted(mine));
        expect(await owed()).toEqual([]);
        expect(await later.overdueDeletions()).toBe(drained);
      });
    });

    test("the account's purge end to end with open cases about it and a report it sent: a run that does not commit asks for nothing; the request's run and the job's keep what a case holds or a freeze keeps, ask for none of its files and forget her report; the cases then go on to their decisions, the disposal and the erasure of statements", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const own = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const second = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        const other = await imagePost(w.tx, 0);
        // She reported someone else's post, signed in; someone reported a post of hers under a rule; and her account is
        // reported on the protected path. The take-down has marked her auth row.
        const hers = await intake(w.tx, ground.illegal(ada.id), aPost(other.postId));
        const rule = await report(w.tx, aPost(own.postId), "rule");
        const suspect = await report(w.tx, anAccount(ada.id, ada.handle), "csam");
        await authAccount(w.tx, ada.id, "0 seconds");
        const images = [...own.mediaIds, ...second.mediaIds];
        const requested = async () => (await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => images.includes(id));
        const base = accountDeps(w, [ada.id]);
        const deps: typeof base = {
          ...base,
          moderation: {
            forgetAccount: async (userId) => void (await forgetReporter(w.tx, userId)),
            exportFor: () => Promise.reject(new Error("not exercised here")),
            takeDownDue: async () => ({ terminated: 0, failed: 0 }),
          },
        };

        // A first run whose transaction does not commit: nothing of it stands, and no file was asked for.
        const stopping: AccountDeps = {
          ...deps,
          social: {
            ...deps.social,
            purgeProfile: (userId, now, within) =>
              w.s.repo.purgeProfile(userId, now, async (tx) => {
                await within(tx);
                throw new Error("the transaction did not commit");
              }),
          },
        };
        await expect(purge(stopping, ada.id)).rejects.toThrow("the transaction did not commit");
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);

        // The request's run, and the job's after it.
        await purge(deps, ada.id);
        expect(await purgePending(deps)).toEqual({ purged: 1, failed: 0, terminated: 0, held: 0 });
        expect(deps.finished).toEqual([ada.id, ada.id]);
        const [profile] = await w.tx.execute<{ display_name: string; bio: string; deleted: boolean; handle: string }>(sql`select display_name, bio, deleted_at is not null as deleted, handle from profiles where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect({ ...profile! }).toEqual({ display_name: "Deleted account", bio: "", deleted: true, handle: ada.handle });
        expect([...(await w.tx.execute<{ state: string; body: string }>(sql`select state, body from posts where author_id = ${ada.id}::uuid`))].map((row) => ({ ...row }))).toEqual([
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
          { state: "deleted_by_author", body: "" },
        ]);
        // Every image row stays (the freeze keeps them all, the rule case holds one), and none of their files was asked for.
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(sorted(images));
        expect(await requested()).toEqual([]);
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([true, true]);
        // Her report no longer names her, on the notice or on its items.
        const [forgotten] = await w.tx.execute<{ intake: boolean; items: boolean }>(
          sql`select n.reporter_id is null as intake, (select bool_and(i.reporter_account_id is null) from intake_items i where i.intake_id = n.id) as items from intakes n where n.id = ${hers.intakeId}::uuid`,
        );
        expect({ ...forgotten! }).toEqual({ intake: true, items: true });

        // The rule case is decided on its copy: the removal changes nothing, the post being deleted, and says so.
        const removal = await decideIn(w.tx, mod, rule.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
        // 3e: the strike it gives counts all the same (a strike never has a no_effect): what counts is the breach.
        expect((await actionsOf(w.tx, removal)).map((action) => [action.kind, action.no_effect])).toEqual([
          ["remove", "deleted"],
          ["strike", null],
        ]);
        expect(statementParagraphs((await decisionStatement(w.tx as unknown as Db, removal))!.statement)[0]).toContain(STATEMENT_WORDS.deletedPost);
        // Its mail finds nobody: the auth module answers no_address for an account that is gone.
        expect(await sendStatement({ apiDb: w.tx as unknown as Db, auth: { mailAccount: async () => "no_address" } as never, social: socialForModeration(w.tx as unknown as Db) }, removal)).toBe("no_address");

        // The admin answers the report about her account without a seal: the freeze ends, and the disposal takes the image
        // no case holds and keeps the one the rule case holds.
        await decideIn(w.tx, admin, suspect.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
        expect([await postFrozen(w.tx, own.postId), await postFrozen(w.tx, second.postId)]).toEqual([false, false]);
        const gone = await w.cases.dropDisposable(w.tx);
        expect(gone.filter((id) => images.includes(id))).toEqual(second.mediaIds);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, images)).toEqual(own.mediaIds);

        // Thirteen months after her account was deleted, the removal's statement texts are due and erased.
        await ageCase(w.tx, rule.caseId, "13 months");
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update auth.users set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        await w.tx.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() - interval '13 months' where id = ${ada.id}::uuid`);
        expect(await dueStatements(w.tx, 12)).toContain(removal);
        expect(await eraseStatementTexts(w.tx, removal)).toBe(2);
      }, migrateDb);
    });

    test("a deleted post whose images a case holds, with no freeze: the same for every reader and for the export", async () => {
      await inWorld(async (w) => {
        const ada = await w.s.established();
        const held = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 2);
        const free = await w.h.postWithImages(ada.id, 1);
        // A report under a rule: its case holds the post's images as evidence.
        await report(w.tx, aPost(held.postId), "rule");
        expect(await postFrozen(w.tx, held.postId)).toBe(false);
        await deletePost(w.s.deps, ada.id, held.postId);
        expect(await existing(w.tx, held.mediaIds)).toEqual(sorted(held.mediaIds));
        expect((await w.h.files.deletionRequests()).filter((id) => held.mediaIds.includes(id))).toEqual([]);
        for (const id of held.mediaIds) {

        }

        expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === held.postId)).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", media: [] });
        expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);
```
