```ts
    expect(paragraphs(hostile.text)).toHaveLength(4);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { subject: "post_restricted" })).toThrow(/statement/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_decision", { statement })).toThrow(/subject/);
  });
});

describe("the staff alerts of deciding", () => {
  test("moderation_burst names the staff account and how many decisions it confirmed, tells its holder what to do, and carries no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna", count: "20" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: many staff decisions in a short time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "The staff account @mod_anna confirmed 20 decisions in the last 15 minutes.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm them, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "If that was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/count/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_burst", { count: "20" })).toThrow(/handle/);
  });

  test("moderation_csam_lifted has two texts for what the decision did, and says what staff do next", () => {
    const data = { handle: "mod_anna", time: TIME, what: "unsealed" };
    const unsealed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", data);
    expect(unsealed.subject).toBe("korbat: reported images are no longer protected");
    expect(paragraphs(unsealed.text)).toEqual([
      `The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that lifted a seal.`,
      "Unless another seal or another open report of this kind still covers them, the images its case reaches are served again as before and staff may open them. After an answer without a seal, whoever is on duty opens them the same day and, where one breaks a rule or the law, opens a finding on its post. Nobody at korbat could open those images while they were protected.",
      "Every staff account gets this email. If @mod_anna is your account and you did not confirm it, someone else holds your key: tell the operator at once.",
      "The staff console's home screen lists every such decision of the last 30 days with its case. A seal for good is lifted only on the answer of the authority korbat reported the images to, and a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: the operator compares this decision with their R2 records. If it was not expected, ask them; if their key may be in someone else's hands, the operator revokes it with staff.js revoke, and whoever is on duty opens a finding citing R2 on the post or the account and seals its images while deciding.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(unsealed);
    const dismissed = renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "dismissed" });
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text)[0]).toBe(`The staff account @mod_anna confirmed a decision at ${TIME} that answered a report or finding of child sexual abuse material without a seal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(dismissed.text).slice(1)).toEqual(paragraphs(unsealed.text).slice(1));
    linkless(dismissed);
    // What it did is one of two words, never a text handed over.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, what: "released the images" })).toThrow(/what/);
    for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
      const { [key]: _left, ...rest } = data as Record<string, string>;
      expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", rest), key).toThrow(new RegExp(key));
    }
    // It names no case, no post and no person but the staff account.
    expect(renderTemplate("moderation_csam_lifted", { ...data, caseId: "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a", author: "ada" }).text).toBe(unsealed.text);
  });

  test("moderation_waiting: one line for each lane with a case past its time, in lane order, a single case worded as one, and the cases that hold a measure taken while deciding", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2", lane0Oldest: TIME, lane1Count: "1", lane1Oldest: TIME, lane2Count: "12", lane2Oldest: TIME, interimCount: "3" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat: cases are waiting longer than their response time");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `The urgent lane: 2 cases waiting longer than 24 hours; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `Lane 2: 12 cases waiting longer than 7 days; the oldest since ${TIME}.`,
      "3 cases have held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; their authors cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(r);
    // Only the lanes that have such a case, and the measures' line only when there is one.
    const one = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane2Count: "1", lane2Oldest: TIME });
    expect(paragraphs(one.text)).toEqual([`Lane 2: 1 case waiting longer than 7 days, since ${TIME}.`, "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.", LAST_STAFF]);
    const held = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { interimCount: "1" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)).toEqual([
      "1 case has held a measure taken while deciding for more than 24 hours; its author cannot appeal until the case is decided.",
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    // 3e: the replies to a suspension or a termination unanswered for longer than korbat's aim, after the lanes and the measures.
    const replies = renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane1Count: "1", lane1Oldest: TIME, replyCount: "2", replyOldest: TIME });
    expect(paragraphs(replies.text)).toEqual([
      `Lane 1: 1 case waiting longer than 24 hours, since ${TIME}.`,
      `2 replies to a suspension or termination have waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, the oldest since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
      "Open the staff console. The same reminder went to every staff phone.",
      LAST_STAFF,
    ]);
    linkless(replies);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "1", replyOldest: TIME }).text)[0]).toBe(
      `1 reply to a suspension or termination has waited more than ${REPLY_AIM_HOURS} hours, since ${TIME}. A reply sent before the start holds its suspension until someone answers.`,
    );
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { replyCount: "2" })).toThrow(/replyOldest/);
    // A count without its time, and a mail about nothing, are programming errors.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", { lane0Count: "2" })).toThrow(/lane0Oldest/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("moderation_waiting", {})).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });
});

describe("notice_update: decisions on a person's reports, once a day", () => {
  const POST = "http://localhost:8081/post/0190f3a2-7c1e-7b1a-9f00-0123456789ab";
  const PAGE = "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ABCDEFGH23#t=AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA";
  const TERMS = "http://localhost:8081/terms";
  const COURTS = "go to court, or complain to the Digital Services Coordinator of the EU country where you live (Article 53 of the Digital Services Act).";
  const REEXAMINE = "You can ask korbat once, within six months and free of charge, to re-examine a moderator's decision to take no action: it is decided again as a new report.";
  const FINAL = "A decision changed on review or by a correction, or given on re-examination, is final within korbat.";
  const line = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateLine> = {}): NoticeUpdateLine => ({
    ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
    item: 1,
    link: POST,
    outcome: outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_legal", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null }),
    reexamination: false,
    changed: false,
    reexaminable: false,
    unseen: false,
    automatic: false,
    ...more,
  });
  const noAction = outcomeWords({ outcome: "no_violation", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
  const update = (more: Partial<NoticeUpdateData>): NoticeUpdateData => ({ signedIn: false, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [], ...more });

  test("signed out: one paragraph per line, the page of each notice it has a line for, that nothing was automated, and the courts", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada" })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(r.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`,
      "N-ABCDEFGH23, item 2 (http://localhost:8081/u/ada): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.",
      `To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `You can ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // The page link stands at the end of its paragraph, and nothing is an anchor.
    expect(r.text).toMatch(/#t=A{43}$/m);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
  });

  test("signed in: no page link, and the re-examination points to Your reports", () => {
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`,
      "No automated means were used to decide.",
      `${REEXAMINE} Use korbat's Settings, Cases, Your reports.`,
      `You can also ${COURTS}`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[/]notice[/]|#t=/);
    // A signed-in update never carries a page or a receipt: handed either, it is refused rather than mailed.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ signedIn: true, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }))).toThrow(/signed-in/);
  });

  test("the re-examination sentence goes only with a re-examinable line, and points to the page when signed out", () => {
    const withIt = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true })], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`${REEXAMINE} Use the page linked in this email for that report.`);
    expect(paragraphs(withIt.text)).toContain(`You can also ${COURTS}`);
    const without = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(without.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    expect(paragraphs(without.text)).toContain(`You can ${COURTS}`);
  });

  test("a re-examination's answer and a changed outcome are final within korbat; a line that reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION never is, re-examined again or not", () => {
    const answered = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.`);
    expect(paragraphs(answered.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    expect(answered.text).not.toContain("re-examine a moderator's decision");
    const changed = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it.", changed: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(changed.text)).toContain(FINAL);
    // An answer given while nobody could open the images does not spend the re-examination, also when it answered one.
    const unseenLine = { outcome: UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, unseen: true };
    const open = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(open.text)[0]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}), re-examined: ${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION}`);
    expect(open.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(open.text).toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // Asked again before a retried mail went out: no longer re-examinable, and still not final.
    const asked = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ ...unseenLine, reexamination: true, reexaminable: false })] }));
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(FINAL);
    expect(asked.text).not.toContain(REEXAMINE);
    // A line of each kind in one update: each sentence once.
    const both = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line({ outcome: noAction, reexaminable: true }), line({ item: 2, outcome: noAction, reexamination: true })] }));
    expect(both.text.split(FINAL).length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(both.text.split(REEXAMINE).length - 1).toBe(1);
  });

  test("only a link that named nothing is called automatic", () => {
    const dead = outcomeWords({ outcome: "not_available", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null });
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line(), line({ item: 2, outcome: dead, automatic: true })] }));
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide, except for links found to name nothing on korbat, which were checked automatically.");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toContain("If a link was wrong, send a new report with the right link.");
    const live = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: [line()] }));
    expect(paragraphs(live.text)).toContain("No automated means were used to decide.");
    expect(live.text).not.toContain("If a link was wrong");
  });

  test("the outcome's words are the contracts': ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, the scopes, the sealed phrase and UNSEEN_NO_ACTION stand in a line exactly as composed, with one full stop", () => {
    const facts = { rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null } as const;
    const outcomes = [
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", noEffect: true }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "account" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "restricted_legal", sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", scope: "quote" }),
      outcomeWords({ ...facts, outcome: "no_violation", unseen: true }),
    ];
    const r = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ lines: outcomes.map((outcome, index) => line({ item: index + 1, outcome })) }));
    const lines = paragraphs(r.text).slice(0, outcomes.length);
    outcomes.forEach((outcome, index) => expect(lines[index]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item ${index + 1} (${POST}): ${outcome}`));
    for (const sentence of [ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN, ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE, ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE, QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE, SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed, UNSEEN_NO_ACTION]) expect(r.text).toContain(sentence);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/[.][.]/);
  });

  test("a folded receipt rides in the update with its page link; an update of receipts alone has another subject and none of the decisions' sentences", () => {
    const receipt = { ref: "N-ZZZZZZZZ77", time: TIME, items: POST, pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB" };
    const alone = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt], termsUrl: TERMS }));
    expect(alone.subject).toBe("korbat received your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(alone.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 at ${TIME}. It names: ${POST}.`,
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a re-examination of a decision, confirm that you sent it, or stop korbat's emails about reports to this address, open this page: http://localhost:8081/notice/N-ZZZZZZZZ77#t=BBBB",
      `How korbat handles reports, and what it keeps: ${TERMS}.`,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    // Two folds on one day and a line of another notice: the receipts first, the terms once, then the line and its page.
    const second = { ...receipt, ref: "N-YYYYYYYY66", pageUrl: "http://localhost:8081/notice/N-YYYYYYYY66#t=CCCC" };
    const full = renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt, second], termsUrl: TERMS, lines: [line()], pages: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", pageUrl: PAGE }] }));
    expect(full.subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    const out = paragraphs(full.text);
    expect(out.slice(0, 5).map((paragraph) => paragraph.slice(0, 42))).toEqual([
      "korbat received your report N-ZZZZZZZZ77 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "korbat received your report N-YYYYYYYY66 a",
      "To see where your report stands, ask for a",
      "How korbat handles reports, and what it ke",
    ]);
    expect(full.text.split("How korbat handles reports").length - 1).toBe(1);
    expect(out[5]).toBe(`N-ABCDEFGH23, item 1 (${POST}): access restricted: korbat found it illegal.`);
    expect(out[6]).toBe(`To see report N-ABCDEFGH23 or ask for a re-examination of a decision on it, open this page: ${PAGE}`);
    // A receipt needs the terms' address, and an update of nothing at all is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({ receipts: [receipt] }))).toThrow(/termsUrl/);
    expect(() => renderNoticeUpdate(update({}))).toThrow(/nothing/);
  });

  test("it carries only what korbat generated: no member of the data holds a report's words", () => {
    const keys = Object.keys(line()).sort();
    expect(keys).toEqual(["automatic", "changed", "item", "link", "outcome", "reexaminable", "reexamination", "ref", "unseen"]);
  });
});

describe("the mailers take the union of messages", () => {
  test("the memory mailer renders a flat message with renderTemplate and the structured one with renderNoticeUpdate, keeps the two apart, and reads a code only from a flat message", async () => {
    const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
    const structured: MailMessage = { to: "a@b.io", template: "notice_update", data: { signedIn: true, lines: [], receipts: [], pages: [] } };
    // An update of nothing is refused as the real mailer would refuse it, before it counts as sent.
    await expect(mailer.send(structured)).rejects.toThrow(/nothing/);
    expect([mailer.sent.length, mailer.updates.length]).toEqual([0, 0]);
    await mailer.send({ to: "a@b.io", template: "sign_in_code", data: { code: "111111" } });
    await mailer.send({
      to: "a@b.io",
      template: "notice_update",
      data: { signedIn: true, lines: [{ ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23", item: 1, link: "http://localhost:8081/u/ada", outcome: "no action.", reexamination: false, changed: false, reexaminable: false, unseen: false, automatic: false }], receipts: [], pages: [] },
    });
    // The two kinds are kept apart, so a reader of the flat ones never meets a structure.
    expect(mailer.sent.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["sign_in_code"]);
    expect(mailer.updates.map((message) => message.template)).toEqual(["notice_update"]);
    expect(mailer.lastCodeFor("a@b.io")).toBe("111111");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.updates[0]!).subject).toBe("Decisions on your reports to korbat");
    expect(renderMail(mailer.sent[0]!).subject).toBe("Your korbat sign-in code");
  });

  test("a time in a mail is printed as noticeTime prints it", () => {
    expect(noticeTime(new Date("2026-10-04T06:59:59.999Z"))).toBe(TIME);
  });
});

describe("3e: the statement mails of a suspension taken at once and of its lift (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat suspended your account for 7 days, from this decision until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC, without notice beforehand.", "The facts: The account posted a threat."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

  test("suspension_started_at_once: its subject, its lead with the days and the end, the statement's paragraphs, where to read it, and no link", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "7", endsAt: "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat suspended your account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat suspended your korbat account for 7 days, until 2026-10-11 09:30 UTC. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    // A termination's lead names no days and no end.
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "terminate", statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat terminated your account");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe("korbat terminated your korbat account. It did so at once, without notice beforehand; the reasons follow. You can reply and appeal in korbat from now: sign in and use the banner on any screen.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_started_at_once", { measure: "suspend", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted: a lead for each state of the period, for a lift and for a basis that broke, and none says the account is free of every measure", () => {
    const lead = (why: string, period: string) => {
      const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement });
      expect(paragraphs(r.text).slice(1)).toEqual([...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
      return [r.subject, paragraphs(r.text)[0]];
    };
    expect(lead("lifted", "not_started")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account that it had announced: it never starts."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "running")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted the suspension of your korbat account. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("lifted", "ended")).toEqual(["korbat lifted the suspension of your account", "korbat lifted a past suspension of your korbat account: it no longer counts toward a later suspension."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "not_started")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account will not start", "korbat reversed a decision that the suspension it announced for your korbat account rested on. The suspension will not start."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "running")).toEqual(["A suspension of your account has ended", "The suspension of your korbat account has ended, because a decision it rested on was reversed. This suspension no longer restricts your account."]);
    expect(lead("basis", "ended")).toEqual(["A past suspension of your account no longer counts", "korbat reversed a decision that a past suspension of your account rested on; that suspension no longer counts."]);
    for (const why of ["lifted", "basis"]) {
      for (const period of ["not_started", "running", "ended"]) expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why, period, statement }).text).not.toMatch(/as before|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    }
    expect(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "lifted", period: "running", statement }).subject).toBe("korbat lifted the termination of your account");
    // Task 4: a withdrawal needs the withdrawn decision's time; a why the template does not have is a programming error.
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/decidedAt/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "answered", period: "running", statement })).toThrow(/why/);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 4: the mails of an announced measure, of the answer to a reply, of a withdrawal, and of a termination's take-down (design, section 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat will suspend your account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet.", "The facts: The account had 3 active strikes."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";
  const EARLIEST = "2026-10-11 09:30 UTC";

  test("suspension_announced: its subject, its lead with the days, the window and the earliest start, the reply, then the statement; a termination's without days", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", window: String(STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours), earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to suspend your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      `korbat has decided to suspend your korbat account for 3 days. Nothing is restricted yet. The suspension starts ${STANDING_RULES.replyWindowHours} hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`,
      `You can reply before it starts: sign in to korbat, where this decision is always shown and a banner on every screen gives the exact time and a Reply button. A reply sent before ${EARLIEST} is certainly in time, and holds the start until a moderator has answered you.`,
      "The decision and its reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|handed to your mail provider|delivered/);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "1", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day.");
    const t = renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "terminate", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement });
    expect(t.subject).toBe("korbat has decided to terminate your account: you can reply first");
    expect(paragraphs(t.text)[0]).toBe(`korbat has decided to terminate your korbat account. Nothing is restricted yet. The termination starts 168 hours after korbat sent this email, and not before ${EARLIEST}.`);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", window: "168", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("suspension_announced", { measure: "suspend", days: "3", earliestStart: EARLIEST, statement })).toThrow(/window/);
  });

  test("reply_answered: a lead for a kept and for a reversed answer, then the answer's statement", () => {
    const kept = renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "kept", statement });
    expect(kept.subject).toBe("korbat answered your reply");
    expect(paragraphs(kept.text)).toEqual(["A moderator read your reply and kept the decision. The answer and its reasons follow.", ...lines, READ, LAST_USER]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "reversed", statement }).text)[0]).toBe("A moderator read your reply and reversed the decision. The answer follows.");
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reply_answered", { outcome: "withdrawn", statement })).toThrow(/outcome/);
  });

  test("suspension_lifted for a withdrawal: never an answer to the reply, and the sentence on the reply only when one was filed", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "suspend", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "true", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat withdrew the suspension it announced");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat withdrew the suspension of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account. This is not a decision on your reply.",
      "The decision about the other measure reaches you separately.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("suspension_lifted", { measure: "terminate", why: "replaced", decidedAt: "2026-10-04 09:30 UTC", replied: "false", statement }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "korbat withdrew the termination of your korbat account that it announced on 2026-10-04 09:30 UTC, because it is taking another measure on your account.",
    );
  });

  test("termination_final: the decision's day, that it is final, what is deleted, the sentence on sealed images only when images are sealed, and never that korbat keeps nothing when they are", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "false" });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat has closed your terminated account");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat's decision of 2026-04-04 09:30 UTC to terminate your korbat account is final: the time to appeal has passed, or your appeal was answered and the decision kept, and no reply of yours is unanswered.",
      "korbat has closed the account and is now deleting its posts and profile and every image it has not sealed, as that decision said. This cannot be undone. The handle stays reserved, so nobody else can take it.",
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    const sealed = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(sealed.text)[2]).toBe(
      "korbat keeps nothing to recognise a new account of yours by. Images of yours that korbat sealed stay with it for the authorities alone, as the decision that sealed them said. A new account that carries on what this one was terminated for breaks korbat's terms.",
    );
    for (const mail of [r, sealed]) expect(mail.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]|@[a-z]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("termination_final", { imagesSealed: "false" })).toThrow(/decided/);
    // 3f (7.15 step 8): a termination's take-down holds the address as a deletion does, and its mail says so the same way.
    const held = renderTemplate("termination_final", { decided: "2026-04-04 09:30 UTC", imagesSealed: "true", heldUntil: "2026-04-11", holdFinal: "true" });
    expect(paragraphs(held.text)[3]).toBe(ACCOUNT_DELETED_HELD.final("2026-04-11"));
    expect(paragraphs(held.text).at(-1)).toBe(LAST_USER);
  });
});

describe("3e Task 5: the statement mails of a warning about reporting and of a restriction of it (design, sections 7.15 and 18, W.6)", () => {
  const lines = ["korbat warns you about your reports. Nothing is restricted.", "The facts: In the 90 days up to 2026-10-04 the account sent 8 reports."];
  const statement = lines.join(String.fromCharCode(10));
  const READ = "Read it in korbat under Settings, Cases. korbat's emails never contain a link to act on a decision.";

    const r = renderTemplate("reporting_warned", { statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat warns you about your reports");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat has looked at the reports your account sent under its rules and warns you about them. Nothing is restricted. The reasons, the reports concerned and what may follow are below.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(r.html).not.toMatch(/<img|<a |href=/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reporting_warned", {})).toThrow(/statement/);
  });

  test("reporting_restricted: its subject, its lead with the days and the end and that illegal content can still be reported, then the statement", () => {
    const r = renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { days: "30", endsAt: "2026-11-03 09:30 UTC", statement });
    expect(r.subject).toBe("korbat restricted your reports under its rules");
    expect(paragraphs(r.text)).toEqual([
      "korbat takes no reports under its rules from your account for 30 days, until 2026-11-03 09:30 UTC. You can still report illegal content. The reasons follow.",
      ...lines,
      READ,
      LAST_USER,
    ]);
    expect(paragraphs(renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { days: "1", endsAt: "2026-10-05 09:30 UTC", statement }).text)[0]).toContain("for 1 day, until");
    expect(r.text).not.toMatch(/https?:|www[.]/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { endsAt: "2026-11-03 09:30 UTC", statement })).toThrow(/days/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("reporting_restricted", { days: "30", statement })).toThrow(/endsAt/);
  });
});

describe("3f: the staff mails whose words are their push's (W.4)", () => {
  const NOW = "2026-10-16T09:00:00.000Z";
  /** A kind's mail as the alert tick sends it: the row's facts as text, and the time it is sent, for the day of its times. */
  const mail = (template: TemplateName, facts: Record<string, string>) => renderTemplate(template as Parameters<typeof renderTemplate>[0], { ...facts, now: NOW });

  test("each is the kind's title after korbat:, then its sentence and its line of what to do from ALERT_TEXTS, and the staff mails' last sentence", () => {
    const cases: [TemplateName, AlertKind, Record<string, string>][] = [
      ["contact_mail", "contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["contact_mail_escalated", "contact_mail_escalated", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_due", "order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "15" }],
      ["mailbox_unreachable", "mailbox_unreachable", { since: "2026-10-15T23:00:00.000Z" }],
      ["alert_channel_down", "alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" }],
      // Task 2: an order opened (with a deadline, and without a time of receipt), a record corrected, the daily unverified.
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "2", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", unknown: "0" }],
      ["order_opened", "order_opened", { items: "1", unknown: "1" }],
      ["order_corrected", "order_corrected", { count: "2", at: "2026-10-16T08:50:00.000Z" }],
      ["order_unverified", "order_unverified", { count: "1", textsMissing: "1", holdsOpen: "0", oldestAt: "2026-10-15T22:00:00.000Z" }],
    ];
    for (const [template, kind, facts] of cases) {
      const r = mail(template, facts);
      const counted = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(facts).map(([name, value]) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? value : Number(value)]));
      const text = renderAlert(kind, counted, new Date(NOW));
      expect(r.subject, template).toBe(`korbat: ${text.title}`);
      expect(paragraphs(r.text), template).toEqual([text.sentence, text.todo, LAST_STAFF]);
      linkless(r);
    }
    expect(paragraphs(mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z", dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z" }).text)[0]).toBe(
      "Mail at the authorities' contact point, received 08:05 UTC. If it is a removal order it is due 09:05 UTC.",
    );
    expect(mail("order_due", { dueAt: "2026-10-16T09:05:00.000Z", minutesLeft: "0" }).subject).toBe("korbat: 0 minutes left");
  });

  test("they carry counts and UTC times only: a fact of another name, a time that is no time and a missing one are refused, and no handle or address is printed", () => {
    expect(() => mail("contact_mail", { receivedAt: "2026-10-16T08:05:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/dueAt/);
    expect(() => mail("mailbox_unreachable", { since: "yesterday" })).toThrow(/since/);
    expect(() => mail("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z", handle: "mod_anna" })).toThrow(/handle/);
    expect(() => renderTemplate("alert_channel_down", { since: "2026-10-16T08:57:00.000Z" })).toThrow(/now/);
    for (const template of ["contact_mail", "contact_mail_escalated", "order_due", "mailbox_unreachable", "alert_channel_down", "order_opened", "order_corrected", "order_unverified"] as const) {
      const facts = Object.fromEntries(ALERT_KINDS[template].facts.map((name) => [name, isTimeFact(name) ? "2026-10-16T08:00:00.000Z" : "3"]));
      expect(mail(template, facts).text, template).not.toMatch(/@/);
    }
  });
});
```

```tsx
const REPO = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "..", "..", "..");

// Link does with `asChild`: hand the child its href, which react-native-web renders as a real anchor. A
// screen also reads its route parameters, and could navigate, which a static render never does.
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  router: { replace: () => undefined },
  useLocalSearchParams: () => route.params,
}));
// A screen reads the session only to refresh it after its call; a static render never makes one.
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ refresh: async () => undefined }) }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);

/** Every anchor's opening tag in the markup. */
const anchors = (markup: string): string[] => markup.match(/<a\b[^>]*>/g) ?? [];

  });

  test("every settings screen shows the row and names itself as the current page", () => {

    // A page is a file of the folder, or a folder of its own whose screens all belong to it, at any depth (Cases: its list,
    // one decision, and that decision's reply screen).
    const filesUnder = (folder: string): string[] =>
      readdirSync(path.join(dir, folder), { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => (entry.isDirectory() ? filesUnder(path.join(folder, entry.name)) : [path.join(folder, entry.name)]));
    const screens = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
      .filter((entry) => !entry.name.startsWith("_"))
      .flatMap((entry) =>
        entry.isDirectory() ? filesUnder(entry.name).map((file) => ({ page: entry.name, file })) : [{ page: entry.name.endsWith(".tsx") ? entry.name.slice(0, -".tsx".length) : entry.name, file: entry.name }],
      );
    expect([...new Set(screens.map((screen) => screen.page))].sort()).toEqual([...PAGES].sort());
```

```ts
import { ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS, ExportFormat, MEASURE_KINDS } from "../src/index";

const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const at = "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z";

/** A complete export of a small account: every list holds one entry so each entry shape is exercised. */
const full = {
  format: "korbat-export-1",
  exportedAt: at,
  account: {
    id: id(1),
    email: "ada@example.com",
    createdAt: at,
    role: "user",
    mfaEnabled: true,
    hasPassword: true,
    verified: false,
    termsVersion: "draft-2026-09",
    termsAcceptedAt: at,
    passkeys: [
      { name: "Laptop", createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at, synced: true, createdOn: "Chrome on Windows" },
      { name: "Security key", createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: null, synced: false, createdOn: null },
    ],
  },
  profile: { handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", bio: "hello", createdAt: at, handleHistory: ["ada_l", "ada"], showInExplore: false, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: at }] },
  posts: [
    { id: id(2), body: "first", createdAt: at, replyToId: null, quoteOfId: null, state: "visible", deletedAt: null, media: [{ id: id(3), file: `media/${id(3)}.webp`, altText: "a cat", width: 2048, height: 1536 }] },
    { id: id(4), body: "", createdAt: at, replyToId: id(2), quoteOfId: null, state: "deleted_by_author", deletedAt: at, media: [] },
  ],
  likes: [{ postId: id(5), at }],
  reposts: [{ postId: id(5), at }],
  bookmarks: [{ postId: id(5), at }],
  following: [{ handle: "grace", since: at }],
  blocks: [{ handle: "troll", since: at }],
  mutes: [{ handle: "loud", since: at }],
  // A session is named by its handle, as the session list names it; the token's hash stays on the server.
  sessions: [{ id: id(9), createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at, current: true }],
  devices: [{ label: "Chrome on Windows", platform: "web", firstSeenAt: at, lastSeenAt: at }],
  events: [{ type: "signup", at }],
  missingMedia: [id(6)],
  // Last in the document since 3c: the decisions the account was told of, and the reports it sent itself.
  moderation: {
    decisions: [
      {
        id: id(10),
        decidedOn: "2026-09-24",
        postId: id(2),
        kind: "final",
        outcome: "restricted",
        ground: "incompatible",
        ruleId: "R3",
        rulesVersion: 2,
        measures: [
          { kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null },
          { kind: "remove_media", mediaId: id(3), noEffect: "already" },
        ],
        reversals: [],
        facts: "The post calls for a named group to be excluded.",
        reason: "That is an attack on people for what they are.",
        legalReference: null,
        appeal: { state: "answered", result: "kept" },
      },
      // A correction about the account itself: it names no post, lifts a reset, and carries no text that is still held.
      { id: id(11), decidedOn: "2026-09-25", postId: null, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: 2, measures: [], reversals: [{ kind: "restore_bio", mediaId: null }], facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null, appeal: null },
    ],
    reports: [
      {
        ref: "N-ABCDEFGH23",
        receivedAt: at,
        ground: "illegal",
        ruleId: null,
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD",
        explanation: "It offers a fake giveaway.",
        items: [
          { position: 1, link: `https://korbat.example/post/${id(12)}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "no_violation", outcomeText: "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.", reexaminationOpen: true },
          // Decided or not, an item says nothing of its outcome before the daily release.
          { position: 2, link: "https://korbat.example/u/grace", reexamines: false, outcome: null, outcomeText: null, reexaminationOpen: null },
        ],
      },
    ],
    // 3e: the strikes the account was given, newest first.
    strikes: [{ decisionId: id(10), postId: id(1), ruleId: "R3", givenAt: at, countsUntil: "2027-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", overruledAt: null }],
    // 3e (W.8): a suspension taken at once and lifted, which answered the account's reply, and a warning about reporting.
    standing: [
      {
        decisionId: id(30),
        kind: "suspend",
        basis: "threat",
        days: 7,
        announced: false,
        decidedAt: at,
        earliestStart: at,
        startsAt: at,
        endsAt: "2026-09-25T10:00:00.000Z",
        liftedAt: "2026-09-25T10:00:00.000Z",
        liftedBy: id(31),
        replaced: false,
        basisEndedAt: null,
        basisEndedBy: null,
      },
      { decisionId: id(32), kind: "warn_reporting", basis: "reports", days: null, announced: null, decidedAt: at, earliestStart: null, startsAt: at, endsAt: "2026-12-23T10:00:00.000Z", liftedAt: null, liftedBy: null, replaced: false, basisEndedAt: null, basisEndedBy: null },
    ],
    replies: [{ decisionId: id(30), filedAt: at, onTime: false, text: "I did not write that post.", erasedAt: null, answeredAt: "2026-09-25T10:00:00.000Z", answeredBy: id(31) }],
    reporting: {
      frameDays: 90,
      days: [{ day: "2026-09-24", reports: 6 }],
      marks: [
        { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH24", position: 1, sentOn: "2026-09-24", markedAt: at, withdrawnAt: null, counts: true },
        { ref: "N-ABCDEFGH25", position: 2, sentOn: "2026-09-24", markedAt: at, withdrawnAt: at, counts: false },
      ],
      markedReports: 1,
    },
  },
};

/** The three members 3e adds to the moderation member, empty, as an account with no standing measure, reply or report has them. */
const NO_STANDING = { standing: [], replies: [], reporting: { frameDays: 90, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 } };

describe("what deleting an account removes, and what korbat keeps", () => {
  test("one sentence, word for word, that the deletion screen and both deletion mails say: nothing in it says that everything is gone for good, and (3f) it names what the law obliges korbat to keep, for every account", () => {
    expect(ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS).toBe(
      "Your posts, images and profile are removed from korbat for everyone, except what korbat keeps for a time: where a post or your profile was reported or restricted, its copy for that case, and what the law obliges korbat to keep, each for the periods in its terms (Terms, Your data).",
    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_DELETION_WORDS).not.toMatch(/for good|gone/);
  });
});

describe("export format", () => {
  test("a complete export parses unchanged, and every list may be empty", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full)).toEqual(full);
    const empty = {
      ...full,
      account: { ...full.account, passkeys: [] },
      posts: [],
      likes: [],
      reposts: [],
      bookmarks: [],
      following: [],
      blocks: [],
      mutes: [],
      sessions: [],
      devices: [],
      events: [],
      missingMedia: [],
      moderation: { decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING },
    };
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(empty)).toEqual(empty);
  });

  test("the format name is fixed, so a reader can tell what it opened", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, format: "korbat-export-2" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, format: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the account and the profile carry the nullable facts as null, never missing", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, termsVersion: null, termsAcceptedAt: null } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, email: "not-an-email" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, role: "owner" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, handleHistory: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, handleHistory: [1] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the profile carries the author's Explore switch, always, as it stands", () => {
    // Part of the format since 2c, beside the handle history: on as well as off, never left out.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: true } }).profile.showInExplore).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.showInExplore).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: "off" } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the profile lists the account's own handles that korbat retired, each with when, beside the handle history (3e design, W.8)", () => {
    // Added to korbat-export-1 last in the profile, as the Explore switch was: always there, empty when nothing is retired.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: at }]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [] } }).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([]);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: null }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the account's passkeys carry a name, their times, whether they are synced and where they were added, and nothing that identifies the key", () => {
    const [laptop] = full.account.passkeys;
    const withPasskeys = (passkeys: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys } }).success;
    // The list is part of the format since 1c: always present, empty for an account without passkeys.
    expect(withPasskeys(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: null, createdOn: null }])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdOn: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, name: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdAt: "last week" }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, synced: "yes" }])).toBe(false);
    // A reader gets the five fields and no more: nothing of the key, its id or its authenticator is part of the format.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys: [{ ...laptop, id: id(7), credentialId: "Y3JlZA", publicKey: "cose", aaguid: id(8) }] } });
    expect(parsed.account.passkeys).toEqual([laptop]);
  });

  test("a deleted post keeps its place with an empty body and a deletion time; an attached image has its dimensions", () => {
    const [post] = full.posts;
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, state: "hidden" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, replyToId: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: [{ id: id(3), file: "media/x.webp", altText: "a cat" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("engagement entries name a post and a time, graph entries a handle and a time", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, likes: [{ postId: "nope", at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, bookmarks: [{ postId: id(5) }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, following: [{ handle: "grace" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, mutes: [{ handle: "loud", since: "last week" }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("sessions, devices, events and missing media keep their shapes", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, sessions: [{ id: id(9), createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], label: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], platform: "desktop" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, events: [{ type: "signup" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, missingMedia: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the export's moderation member", () => {
  const [decision, correction] = full.moderation.decisions;
  const [report] = full.moderation.reports;
  const [released, waiting] = report!.items;
  const withModeration = (moderation: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation }).success;
  const withDecision = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [{ ...decision, ...change }], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withReport = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [{ ...report, ...change }], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withItem = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReport({ items: [{ ...released, ...change }] });

  test("is part of korbat-export-1 since 3c, the last member of the document: always present, with its two lists, either of which may be empty", () => {
    // Added without a new format name, as the passkeys and the Explore switch were: a reader that skips it loses nothing.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).format).toBe("korbat-export-1");
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape).at(-1)).toBe("moderation");
    expect(withModeration(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    // 3e: the strikes, the standing measures, the replies and the reporting counts are always there too.
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], standing: [], replies: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [decision], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [report], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a decision carries its day, the post it concerns, its kind, outcome, ground, rule and rules version, its measures with whether each changed anything, its reversals, the texts still held and where the appeal stands", () => {
    expect(withDecision({})).toBe(true);
    // The day, never the time: the list of decisions shows a day too.
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A decision about the account names no post; the member is null then, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ postId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: "the-post" })).toBe(false);
    // 3f (W.7): an order's decision is an entry like any other once its author was told.
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final", "order", "review", "correction"]) expect(withDecision({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ kind: "appeal" })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ outcome: "suspended" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // The fourteen measures (3c's seven, 3e's six and 3f's order measure) and nothing else; a reversal is no measure, and a measure no reversal.
    for (const kind of MEASURE_KINDS) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    for (const noEffect of ["already", "deleted", null]) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect }] }), String(noEffect)).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: "no" }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["restore", "unseal_media", "restore_media", "restore_display_name", "restore_bio"]) expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind, mediaId: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A text that is not held, or that the decision never had, is null, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["facts", "reason", "legalReference"]) expect(withDecision({ [text]: undefined }), text).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation.decisions[1]).toEqual(correction);
  });

  test("an appeal is pending without a result or answered with one, and null when none was filed", () => {
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: null } })).toBe(true);
    for (const result of ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result } }), result).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: "kept" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: null } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "withdrawn", result: null } })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision is read with its own members and no more: nothing of who reported, who decided or how many reports there were is part of the format", () => {
    const extra = { ...decision, decidedBy: id(20), staffHandle: "mod_one", reporterId: id(21), reporterHandle: "grace", reports: 3, source: "report", caseId: id(22) };
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [extra], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.decisions).toEqual([decision]);
  });

  test("a report carries its reference, when korbat received it, its ground with the rule it cited, its category and its sender's own explanation while that is held", () => {
    expect(withReport({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ ref: "N-abc" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ receivedAt: "last week" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" })).toBe(true);
    // A report on the path for child sexual abuse material records no sender, so it is in nobody's export.
    expect(withReport({ ground: "csam" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: "R9" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // Read with its own members and no more.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, reporterId: id(1), contactId: id(23), lookupHash: "f".repeat(64), token: "secret" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports).toEqual([report]);
  });

  test("an item carries its place in the report, its link and whether it is a re-examination; its outcome, the outcome's words and whether a re-examination is open come together, with the release, or not at all", () => {
    expect(withItem({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ items: [waiting] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ position: 21 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ link: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexamines: undefined })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withItem({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: false })).toBe(true);
    // Released, all three are told; before the release, none is.
    expect(withItem({ outcome: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ outcomeText: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, reexaminationOpen: false }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, outcomeText: "no action" }] })).toBe(false);
    // An item is read with its own members and no more: the list's id of an item is not part of the export.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, items: [{ ...released, id: id(24), caseId: id(25), answeredBy: id(26) }] }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([released]);
  });
});

describe("the moderation member's standing, replies and reporting (3e design, W.8)", () => {
  const [suspension, warning] = full.moderation.standing;
  const [answered] = full.moderation.replies;
  const [counting, withdrawn] = full.moderation.reporting.marks;
  const withModeration = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, ...change } }).success;
  const withStanding = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ standing: [{ ...suspension, ...change }] });
  const withReply = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ replies: [{ ...answered, ...change }] });
  const withReporting = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ reporting: { ...full.moderation.reporting, ...change } });
  const withMark = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReporting({ marks: [{ ...counting, ...change }] });

  test("come after the strikes, in this order, and every one of them is always there", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape.moderation.shape)).toEqual(["decisions", "reports", "strikes", "standing", "replies", "reporting"]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation).toEqual(full.moderation);
    for (const member of ["standing", "replies", "reporting"]) expect(withModeration({ [member]: undefined }), member).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a standing entry is a suspension, a termination, a warning or a restriction of reporting, with its basis, days, times, lift and broken basis", () => {
    expect(withStanding({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ standing: [warning] })).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    // A strike is in strikes, a retirement in the profile's retired handles; neither is a standing entry.
    for (const kind of ["strike", "retire_handle", "remove"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(false);
    for (const basis of ["strikes", "threat", "terrorist", "flood", "protective", "threat_repeat", "ladder_end", "reports"]) expect(withStanding({ basis }), basis).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basis: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: null, kind: "terminate" })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 31 })).toBe(false);
    // A period that never started, or a termination without end, has no start or no end.
    expect(withStanding({ startsAt: null, endsAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basisEndedAt: at, basisEndedBy: id(33) })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ replaced: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ liftedBy: "a staff member" })).toBe(false);
    // An entry is read with its own members and no more: who decided is not part of it.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, standing: [{ ...suspension, decidedBy: id(40), handle: "staff" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.standing).toEqual([suspension]);
  });

  test("a reply carries when it was filed, whether it was on time, its text while korbat holds it, when that was erased and its answer", () => {
    expect(withReply({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: at })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ answeredAt: null, answeredBy: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: "x".repeat(2001) })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReply({ onTime: undefined })).toBe(false);
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE,
  ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE,
  ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN,
  CaseView,
  DecisionStatement,
  ITEM_OUTCOMES,
  OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE,
  SEAL_DRAFTS,
  SUSPECT_NO_SEAL,
  SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES,
  StaffOverview,
  UNSEEN_NO_ACTION,
  outcomeWords,
  sealFactsDraft,
  type ItemOutcome,
  type OutcomeWordsInput,
} from "../src/index";

/**
 * The words a report's sender reads for an outcome, and the console's fixed drafts for a seal (3c design, section 10).
 * Each table is the one place its words are written: the mails, the status page, the app's list and the console take
 * them from here, so this file pins every word once.
 */
const RULE = { id: "R1", title: "No sexual or pornographic content" };

/** One item's facts, plain unless a test says otherwise: a post that quotes nothing, answered by a decision that saw its images. */
const words = (outcome: ItemOutcome, facts: Partial<OutcomeWordsInput> = {}): string =>
  outcomeWords({ outcome, rule: outcome === "restricted_rule" ? RULE : null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null, ...facts });

describe("the outcome phrases", () => {
  test("there is exactly one phrase for each outcome an item can be shown, word for word", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(OUTCOME_PHRASES).sort()).toEqual([...ITEM_OUTCOMES].sort());
    expect(OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({
      restricted_rule: "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule {rule} ({title})",
      restricted_legal: "access restricted: korbat found it illegal",
      no_violation: "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal",
      not_evident:
        "no action: korbat found no breach of its rules, and whether it is illegal cannot be seen without a detailed legal examination; a court or an authority can order its removal",
      not_available: "no action: the link names nothing korbat can show (checked automatically)",
      partly_reversed: "korbat reversed part of its decision to restrict it",
      reversed: "korbat reversed its decision to restrict it",
    });
  });

  test("the sentences that follow an outcome, and the phrases of the path for child sexual abuse material, word for word", () => {
    expect(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN).toBe("It was already not shown on korbat, so nothing changed now; korbat's restriction stays in force should that change.");
    expect(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE).toBe("This answer concerns the account's display name and bio. korbat decides about its posts and images in cases of their own and does not report those here.");
    expect(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns this post's own text and images. korbat decides about the post it quotes, shown inside its card, in a case of its own and does not report that here.",
    );
    expect(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE).toBe(
      "This answer concerns the account's display name and bio and, taken together, the images on its posts. korbat decides about single posts of the account, and about what its posts say, in cases of their own and does not report those here.",
    );
    expect(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES).toEqual({
      sealed: "access restricted: korbat sealed its images without opening them. They are shown to nobody, their author included, and are kept for the authorities.",
      no_action:
        "no action: korbat's staff do not open images reported this way. An admin found in the report, and in what korbat can read and still holds of it, no sufficient ground to seal images or to restrict anything else.",
    });
    expect(SUSPECT_NO_SEAL).toBe("No image was sealed; korbat's staff do not open images reported this way.");
    expect(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION).toBe(
      "no action for now: when korbat decided, its staff could not open this post's images, because a report of another kind about them was waiting or they were sealed. If your report is about an image, ask for a re-examination.",
    );
  });
});

describe("outcomeWords: one item's outcome as its sender reads it", () => {
  test("an ordinary item reads its outcome's phrase, a rule's with its id and title, and ends in one full stop", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule")).toBe("access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).");
    expect(words("restricted_legal")).toBe("access restricted: korbat found it illegal.");
    expect(words("no_violation")).toBe("no action: korbat found no breach of its rules and nothing illegal.");
    expect(words("not_evident")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}.`);
    expect(words("not_available")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed")).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
    // A phrase that fills nothing in never keeps a placeholder, and no outcome ends in two full stops.
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      for (const facts of [{}, { suspect: true }, { sealed: true }, { unseen: true }, { noEffect: true }, { scope: "account" as const }, { scope: "quote" as const }, { scope: "account_suspect" as const }]) {
        const text = words(outcome, facts);
        expect(text, `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).not.toMatch(/[{}]|[.][.]|[.] [.]/);
        expect(text.endsWith("."), `${outcome} ${JSON.stringify(facts)}`).toBe(true);
      }
    }
  });

  test("a restriction under a rule that is not named is refused: the phrase would keep its placeholder", () => {
    expect(() => outcomeWords({ outcome: "restricted_rule", rule: null, suspect: false, sealed: false, unseen: false, noEffect: false, scope: null })).toThrow(/rule/);
  });

  test("ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN follows a restricting outcome whose measures all changed nothing, a seal's included, and no other outcome", () => {
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { noEffect: true }), outcome).not.toContain(ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are not suspect and whose decision sealed nothing", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      const text = words(outcome, { scope: "account" });
      expect(text.endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      expect(text, outcome).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
      for (const scope of [null, "quote", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    // After the already-not-shown sentence when both apply.
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { noEffect: true, scope: "account" })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about a post that quotes another, after ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN when both apply", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "quote" }).endsWith(` ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "account_suspect"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE);
    }
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { noEffect: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${ALREADY_NOT_SHOWN} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE follows the outcome of exactly the items about an account that are suspect or that a sealing decision answered, a rule report merged into a sealed account case among them", () => {
    for (const outcome of ITEM_OUTCOMES) {
      expect(words(outcome, { scope: "account_suspect", suspect: true }).endsWith(` ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`), outcome).toBe(outcome !== "not_available");
      for (const scope of [null, "account", "quote"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { scope }), `${outcome} ${String(scope)}`).not.toContain(ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE);
    }
    // A rule report about an account that an answer with a seal answered: the sealed phrase, then the scope.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, scope: "account_suspect" })).toBe(`${SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed} ${ACCOUNT_SUSPECT_SCOPE}`);
  });

  test("a suspect item is worded from SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES, never from the four words for a finding alone", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("not_evident", { suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    // Answered by a measure on the post's text without a seal: the phrase of that finding, then that no image was sealed.
    expect(words("restricted_rule", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content). ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    expect(words("restricted_legal", { suspect: true })).toBe(`access restricted: korbat found it illegal. ${SUSPECT_NO_SEAL}`);
    for (const outcome of ["no_violation", "not_evident", "restricted_rule", "restricted_legal"] as const) {
      for (const sealed of [false, true]) {
        const text = words(outcome, { suspect: true, sealed });
        expect(text === `${OUTCOME_PHRASES[outcome]}.` || text === "access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R1 (No sexual or pornographic content).", `${outcome} ${sealed}`).toBe(false);
      }
    }
    // The other three outcomes are worded as for any item.
    expect(words("not_available", { suspect: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`);
    expect(words("partly_reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.partly_reversed}.`);
    expect(words("reversed", { suspect: true, sealed: true })).toBe(`${OUTCOME_PHRASES.reversed}.`);
  });

  test("the sealed phrase stands for every item a sealing decision answered, suspect or not, in place of both restricting phrases", () => {
    for (const suspect of [false, true]) {
      expect(words("restricted_rule", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
      expect(words("restricted_legal", { sealed: true, suspect })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.sealed);
    }
  });

  test("an item on another ground about a post, answered without action while nobody could open its images, reads UNSEEN_NO_ACTION, and no other item does", () => {
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("not_evident", { unseen: true })).toBe(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    // A restriction, a reversal and a link that named nothing keep their own words, and a suspect item its own phrase.
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"] as const) expect(words(outcome, { unseen: true }), outcome).not.toContain(UNSEEN_NO_ACTION);
    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, suspect: true })).toBe(SUSPECT_OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_action);

    expect(words("no_violation", { unseen: true, scope: "quote" })).toBe(`${UNSEEN_NO_ACTION} ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`);
  });
});

    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_account);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_post);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("account", [item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_account);
    // A notice among findings makes it a notice's draft.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding"), item("user")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    // Every item added for a quoted post (or a re-examination of one): the added form; one named item among them: the post's.
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("user", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("finding", true)])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.finding_added);
    expect(sealFactsDraft("post", [item("user", true), item("finding")])).toBe(SEAL_DRAFTS.facts.notice_post);
    expect(() => sealFactsDraft("post", [])).toThrow(/suspect item/);
  });
});
```
