```ts
  "tell_person_set",
  "person_told",
  "imported",
] as const;
export type OrderEventKind = (typeof ORDER_EVENT_KINDS)[number];

/** Who wrote an event: the console (through a definer function), the command line, or the database itself. */
export const ORDER_EVENT_VIA = ["console", "cli", "system"] as const;
export type OrderEventVia = (typeof ORDER_EVENT_VIA)[number];

/** An Annex III's ground: force majeure (TCO Art. 3(7)), a manifest error or missing information (Art. 3(8)). */
export const ANNEX3_GROUNDS = ["force_majeure", "manifest_error", "insufficient_information"] as const;
export type Annex3Ground = (typeof ANNEX3_GROUNDS)[number];
/** The ground of a reinstatement after an order. */
export const ORDER_GROUNDS = ["withdrawn", "annulled", "scrutiny", "not_authentic", "wrong_item"] as const;
export type OrderGround = (typeof ORDER_GROUNDS)[number];
/** The ground of closing an order without effect: a reinstatement's, or that the order is not addressed to korbat. */
export const ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS = ["withdrawn", "annulled", "scrutiny", "not_authentic", "wrong_item", "not_addressed"] as const;
export type OrderCloseGround = (typeof ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS)[number];
/** Which rule allowed a correction (7.4), stored as the ground of its event `corrected`. */
export const ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES = ["entry", "caution", "admin"] as const;
export type OrderCorrectionRule = (typeof ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES)[number];
/** Why an open item was closed without effect: it names nothing to disable, korbat entered it by mistake, or the authority withdrew it. */
export const ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS = ["no_post", "not_named", "withdrawn"] as const;
export type OrderItemCloseReason = (typeof ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS)[number];
/** Why a hold was ended from the command line, or by a correction that unset Section C (not_ordered). */
export const HOLD_END_REASONS = ["not_authentic", "annulled", "released_by_authority", "not_ordered"] as const;
export type HoldEndReason = (typeof HOLD_END_REASONS)[number];
/** Which rule a hold's end follows: the computed end of a removal order, or the end a DSA order's authority states. */
export const HOLD_BASES = ["regulation", "authority"] as const;
export type HoldBasis = (typeof HOLD_BASES)[number];
/** When the person an order to provide information concerns may be told (DSA Art. 10(5)). */
export const TELL_PERSON_RULES = ["at_effect", "at_instant", "never"] as const;
export type TellPersonRule = (typeof TELL_PERSON_RULES)[number];
/** A scrutiny's outcome (TCO Art. 4). */
export const SCRUTINY_OUTCOMES = ["upheld", "annulled"] as const;
export type ScrutinyOutcome = (typeof SCRUTINY_OUTCOMES)[number];

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- records to authorities (Task 5)
// Each list below is the one spelling of section 6.5's CHECK of the same meaning; a database test holds them equal.

/** A notification record's state: owed until the command line records it as sent or declined. */
export const NOTIFICATION_STATES = ["owed", "sent", "declined"] as const;
export type NotificationState = (typeof NOTIFICATION_STATES)[number];
/** The duties a notification meets (one may meet several): DSA Art. 18 (two readings), TCO Art. 14(5), or none. */
export const NOTIFICATION_DUTIES = ["dsa18_1", "dsa18_2", "tco14_5", "voluntary"] as const;
export type NotificationDuty = (typeof NOTIFICATION_DUTIES)[number];
/**
 * What a notification sent, and what an order to provide information asked for, by kind and never by value: the one
 * list of `notification-sent --kinds`, of `production-account --asked` and of the CHECKs on `sent_kinds` and `asked`.
 */
export const NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS = ["handle", "address", "created_at", "post_ids", "post_times", "report_time", "files"] as const;
export type NotificationSentKind = (typeof NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS)[number];
/** An authority's answer to a notification: a word, never a sentence about a person. No word releases or destroys anything. */
export const NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS = ["not_illegal", "illegal", "no_assessment", "other"] as const;
export type NotificationAnswer = (typeof NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS)[number];
/** A later step of a notification's matter: the authority's request, its answer, or the operator's note. */
export const NOTIFICATION_EVENT_KINDS = ["request", "answer", "note"] as const;
export type NotificationEventKind = (typeof NOTIFICATION_EVENT_KINDS)[number];
/** Who opened a notification record: a seal (the database's trigger) or the command line. */
export const NOTIFICATION_OPENED_VIA = ["system", "cli"] as const;
/** What a production answers. A recipient is an authority, never a hotline, a lawyer or a company. */
export const PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS = ["notification", "demand", "court_order", "seizure", "dsa_art10", "preserved_access"] as const;
export type ProductionInstrument = (typeof PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS)[number];
/** The instruments under which sealed files are handed over (`handover-list --instrument`). */
export const HANDOVER_INSTRUMENTS = ["notification", "demand", "court_order", "seizure"] as const satisfies readonly ProductionInstrument[];
/** Why preserved content was opened (`order-access --purpose`); only `authority` is a production. */
export const ACCESS_PURPOSES = ["review", "complaint", "authority"] as const;
export type AccessPurpose = (typeof ACCESS_PURPOSES)[number];
/**
 * What a production gave, by kind: the kinds a notification can send, and `content`, a preserved post's text, alt texts
 * and its images' facts as `order-access` prints them. Never a value.
 */
export const PRODUCED_KINDS = [...NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS, "content"] as const;
/** What korbat does not hold of an account (W.8's sentence), by kind, as a production stores it. */
export const NOT_HELD_KINDS = ["name", "postal_address", "date_of_birth", "phone_number", "ip_address"] as const;
/**
 * Why an address hold was released: the record was sent, or declined (also by the database when no seal of the account
 * is left). A hold older than ORDER_RULES.reportHoldDays simply reads as not held; `expired` is kept for a hand-written end.
 */
export const REPORT_HOLD_RELEASES = ["sent", "declined", "expired"] as const;
/**
 * W.8's sentence of what korbat does not hold, and of what it holds and has not produced, by version: a notification's
 * record stores the version that went with it (`not_kept_version`), so a changed sentence is a new version.
 */
export const RECORDS_NOT_HELD = {
  1: "korbat holds no name, postal address, date of birth, phone number or IP address of this account. It holds IP addresses, and a phone number the account verified, only as keyed hashes that identify nobody outside korbat; a device's hash is deleted 30 days after the device was last seen. korbat also holds, and has not produced here, the times and device types of the account's sign-ins.",
} as const;
export const RECORDS_NOT_HELD_VERSION = 1;

/**
 * The digest that a later step of a notification record (its answer, an event) and every step of a production hold in
 * their audit row in place of the facts (10.5): the SHA-256, in hex, of the record's row at that step in the canonical
 * JSON (canonical.ts), as the database printed it. The chain proves the record existed and was not changed afterwards,
 * and `staff.js records --verify` recomputes it from the row, without the audit log ever naming the person.
 */
export async function recordDigestOf(row: unknown): Promise<string> {
  return hex(await sha256(sortedJson(row)));
}

/** The grounds each kind of event takes; a kind not named here takes none. legal_order_events_ground is written from it. */
export const ORDER_EVENT_GROUNDS = {
  annex3_sent: ANNEX3_GROUNDS,
  closed_without_effect: ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS,
  corrected: ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES,
  reinstated: ORDER_GROUNDS,
  hold_ended: HOLD_END_REASONS,
  scrutiny_decided: SCRUTINY_OUTCOMES,
} as const satisfies Partial<Record<OrderEventKind, readonly string[]>>;

/** The grounds of a kind of event, or null for a kind that takes none. */
export function orderEventGrounds(kind: OrderEventKind): readonly string[] | null {
  return (ORDER_EVENT_GROUNDS as Partial<Record<OrderEventKind, readonly string[]>>)[kind] ?? null;
}

/** An order's state on the list (10.2): a removal order is given_effect only once none of its items is open. */
export const ORDER_STATES = ["running", "stopped", "overdue", "unknown_deadline", "given_effect", "closed", "no_clock"] as const;
export type OrderState = (typeof ORDER_STATES)[number];

/**
 * The two kinds of the ledger that the migration orders adds to action_kind: the measure of an order decision and its
 * reversal. Since Task 3 they are the last two of the contracts' ACTION_KINDS too, with MEASURES' labels (W.1); this names
 * them apart for the code that handles an order's ledger alone.
 */
export const ORDER_ACTION_KINDS = ["disable_by_order", "reinstate_by_order"] as const;

/** The most items an order holds (its positions), and how much of a public post's body an order's screen previews. */
export const ORDER_ITEMS_MAX = 50;
export const ORDER_ITEM_PREVIEW = 80;
/** TCO Art. 4(4): the hours from receipt in which korbat may ask for the scrutiny of an order from another state. */
export const ORDER_SCRUTINY_HOURS = 48;
/** The bounds of an order's strings (10.1): a name or reference, a link, a short text of the command line, the authority's reasons and redress. */
export const ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS = { name: 200, link: 500, short: 500, long: 4000 } as const;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the member states (10.1)

/** The EU's 27 Member States by ISO code, the issuing states an order may name. */
export const EU_MEMBER_STATES = {
  AT: "Austria",
  BE: "Belgium",
  BG: "Bulgaria",
  HR: "Croatia",
  CY: "Cyprus",
  CZ: "Czechia",
  DK: "Denmark",
  EE: "Estonia",
  FI: "Finland",
  FR: "France",
  DE: "Germany",
  GR: "Greece",
  HU: "Hungary",
  IE: "Ireland",
  IT: "Italy",
  LV: "Latvia",
  LT: "Lithuania",
  LU: "Luxembourg",
  MT: "Malta",
  NL: "Netherlands",
  PL: "Poland",
  PT: "Portugal",
  RO: "Romania",
  SK: "Slovakia",
  SI: "Slovenia",
  ES: "Spain",
  SE: "Sweden",
} as const;
export type MemberState = keyof typeof EU_MEMBER_STATES;
const MEMBER_STATE_CODES = Object.keys(EU_MEMBER_STATES) as [MemberState, ...MemberState[]];
/** An issuing state's code: two upper-case letters of one of the 27. */
export const MemberStateCode = z.enum(MEMBER_STATE_CODES);

/** An authority as a state's facts list it, with the words of the Commission's register to check an order against. */
export interface StateAuthority {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  /** Null while nobody verified the register's words: the console then prints state.unknown. */
  registerEntry: string | null;
}

/** What korbat knows of a Member State (10.1); a member without a verified value is null. */
export interface StateFacts {
  name: string;
  authorities: readonly StateAuthority[];
  /** The address that gets a copy of Annex II and III. */
  annexCopy: string | null;
  /** Where a notification to the authorities goes, and how. */
  notificationIntake: { name: string; how: string } | null;
  /** The languages the contact point declares: the operator's choice. */
  languages: readonly string[] | null;
  /** The state's own yearly filing, as a line of the runbook. */
  yearlyFiling: string | null;
  /** The state's default for when the person an order to provide information concerns is told. */
  tellPersonDefault: TellPersonRule | null;
}

/**
 * The states' facts, by ISO code; HOME_STATE picks one. Germany's entry is the worked example, from the research the
 * design cites (korbat-scratch/research-3e: gap-E-orders-law.md, gap-E-authorities.md): the BKA issues removal orders and
 * names TCO@bka.bund.de for questions about one, which is also its entry in the Commission's register; a German host
 * informs the BKA of Annex II and III as well; notifications go to the BKA's portal after registration; the yearly filing
 * is two numbers to the Bundesnetzagentur; a request under TDDDG s. 22 carries silence by statute. The contact point's
 * languages are the operator's to declare, so null. Any other state's entry is the owner's to fill.
 */
export const STATE_FACTS: Partial<Record<MemberState, StateFacts>> = {
  DE: {
    name: "Germany",
    authorities: [{ id: "bka", name: "Bundeskriminalamt (BKA)", registerEntry: "Bundeskriminalamt (BKA), contact point TCO@bka.bund.de" }],
    annexCopy: "TCO@bka.bund.de",
    notificationIntake: {
      name: "BKA reporting portal (u-entrance.bka.de)",
      how: "After registration by mail to U-Entrance@bka.bund.de, which itself takes no report; urgent matters by telephone, +49 611 55-35062; in an emergency 110.",
    },
    languages: null,
    yearlyFiling:
      "By 1 March, to the Bundesnetzagentur: the authorities' requests for access to preserved content and the complaint procedures of the year before (TCO Art. 7(3)(c) and (d)), only when either is not zero.",
    tellPersonDefault: "never",
  },
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the requests (10.2, 10.3)

/** A uuid in the lower case PostgreSQL writes: the one spelling a hashed param may take. */
const LowerUuid = z.uuid().regex(/^[0-9a-f-]+$/, { message: "a uuid in lower case" });

/** Whether a text holds a control character: C0, DEL or C1. */
const hasControl = (text: string) =>
  [...text].some((char) => {
    const code = char.codePointAt(0)!;
    return code < 32 || (code >= 127 && code < 160);
  });
/** Whether a string is whole text, with no half of a surrogate pair. */
const isWellFormed = (text: string) => (text as string & { isWellFormed(): boolean }).isWellFormed();

/**
 * One line typed from an order's document: an authority's name, a reference, a link. Stored as written or refused: well
 * formed, no control character, none of the invisible direction and spacing characters, some text, at most `max`
 * characters as PostgreSQL counts them. It is an outsider's text, and the console draws it as such.
 */
const orderLine = (max: number) =>
  z
    .string()
    // A character outside the basic plane is two UTF-16 units, so this bound never refuses what the count below accepts.
    .max(2 * max)
    .refine(isWellFormed, { message: "half of a surrogate pair is not text" })
    .refine((text) => !hasControl(text), { message: "control characters are not allowed" })
    .refine((text) => !FORBIDDEN_FORMAT.test(text), { message: "invisible direction and spacing characters are not allowed" })
    .refine((text) => text.trim().length > 0, { message: "some text is needed" })
    .refine((text) => Array.from(text).length <= max, { message: `at most ${max} characters` });
export const OrderAuthority = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.name);
export const OrderReference = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.name);
export const OrderLinkText = orderLine(ORDER_TEXT_LIMITS.link);

const distinct = (values: readonly string[]) => new Set(values).size === values.length;
const orderLinks = (min: number) => z.array(OrderLinkText).min(min).max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction).refine(distinct, { message: "a link is named once" });

/**
 * POST /api/staff/orders (7.4). sectionC is required and has no default: the form's third choice, "I cannot tell", is
 * sent as true. A named message comes with the channel mailbox, which the database forces too. The withholding is true
 * for a removal order and whenever Section C is set, so no request can hold a notice on a post its author sees; an order
 * to provide information names no post, so it does not withhold unless Section C forces it. It takes no link; the other
 * two kinds take one to itemsPerAction.
 */
export const OrderOpenRequest = z
  .strictObject({
    messageId: z.uuid().nullable(),
    channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS),
    kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS),
    memberState: MemberStateCode,
    authority: OrderAuthority,
    reference: OrderReference,
    links: orderLinks(0),
    sectionC: z.boolean(),
    emergency: z.boolean(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
  })
  .superRefine((request, ctx) => {
    if (request.messageId !== null && request.channel !== "mailbox") ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["channel"], message: "an order opened from a message arrived in the mailbox" });
    if ((request.kind === "tco_removal" || request.sectionC) && !request.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "a removal order, and an order whose author must not be told, keeps the post from its author" });
    }
    if (request.kind === "dsa_art10" && !request.sectionC && request.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "an order to provide information names no post to withhold" });
    }
    if (request.kind === "dsa_art10" ? request.links.length > 0 : request.links.length === 0) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["links"], message: "an order to provide information takes no link; the other kinds take at least one" });
    }
  });
export type OrderOpenRequest = z.infer<typeof OrderOpenRequest>;

/** POST /api/staff/orders/:order/items: one to itemsPerAction more links, up to ORDER_ITEMS_MAX in all. */
export const OrderItemsRequest = z.strictObject({ links: orderLinks(1) });
export type OrderItemsRequest = z.infer<typeof OrderItemsRequest>;

/**
 * What a correction changes (7.4): only the members to change, at least one. crossBorder is the API's, set with
 * memberState. closeItems closes open items, each with one reason, no item twice. Section C set never comes with the
 * withholding unset.
 */
export const OrderCorrectFacts = z
  .strictObject({
    kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS).optional(),
    memberState: MemberStateCode.optional(),
    authority: OrderAuthority.optional(),
    reference: OrderReference.optional(),
    channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS).optional(),
    sectionC: z.boolean().optional(),
    emergency: z.boolean().optional(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean().optional(),
    closeItems: z
      .array(z.strictObject({ itemId: LowerUuid, reason: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS) }))
      .min(1)
      .max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction)
      .refine((items) => distinct(items.map((item) => item.itemId)), { message: "an item is closed once" })
      .optional(),
  })
  .refine((facts) => Object.keys(facts).length > 0, { message: "a correction changes something" })
  .refine((facts) => !(facts.sectionC === true && facts.withholdFromAuthor === false), { message: "an order whose author must not be told keeps the post from its author", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"] });
export type OrderCorrectFacts = z.infer<typeof OrderCorrectFacts>;

/** The step-up params of order_corrected, asked only under the rule admin: the request's facts (10.3). */
export const OrderCorrectedParams = z.strictObject({ facts: OrderCorrectFacts });
export type OrderCorrectedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderCorrectedParams>;

/** Every ground a console event takes: an Annex III's and a closing's, each once. A param is never a free string. */
const CONSOLE_EVENT_GROUNDS = [...ANNEX3_GROUNDS, ...ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS] as const;

/**
 * The step-up params of order_event_recorded (10.3): the kind, its ground (one of its kind's list, or null for a kind
 * without one) and the message it names, which a clarification and an extension need, a cease may have and nothing else
 * takes.
 */
export const OrderEventRecordedParams = z
  .strictObject({ kind: z.enum(ORDER_CONSOLE_EVENTS), ground: z.enum(CONSOLE_EVENT_GROUNDS).nullable(), messageId: LowerUuid.nullable() })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    const grounds = orderEventGrounds(params.kind);
    if (grounds === null ? params.ground !== null : params.ground === null || !grounds.includes(params.ground)) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["ground"], message: grounds === null ? "this event has no ground" : "a ground of this event's list" });
    }
    const needs = params.kind === "clarification_received" || params.kind === "hold_extended";
    const may = needs || params.kind === "grounds_ceased";
    if ((needs && params.messageId === null) || (!may && params.messageId !== null)) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["messageId"], message: needs ? "this event names the message it came in" : "this event names no message" });
    }
  });
export type OrderEventRecordedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderEventRecordedParams>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the answers (10.2)

const At = z.iso.datetime();

/** A removal order's clock: one row of legal_order_clock, with the newest Annex III's time and ground while it is stopped. */
export const OrderClock = z.strictObject({
  clockStart: At.nullable(),
  stopped: z.boolean(),
  stoppedAt: At.nullable(),
  stopGround: z.enum(ANNEX3_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  deadlineAt: At.nullable(),
  targetAt: At.nullable(),
  itemsOpen: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  firstEffectAt: At.nullable(),
  lastEffectAt: At.nullable(),
  withinHour: z.boolean().nullable(),
});
export type OrderClock = z.infer<typeof OrderClock>;

/** One order on the list: its facts as typed, its clock (null for a DSA order), its state and its counts. */
export const OrderSummary = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(ORDER_KINDS),
  memberState: MemberStateCode,
  authority: z.string(),
  reference: z.string(),
  openedAt: At,
  state: z.enum(ORDER_STATES),
  clock: OrderClock.nullable(),
  /** A DSA order's deadline as its text states it, or null. */
  dueAt: At.nullable(),
  closedAt: At.nullable(),
  closeGround: z.enum(ORDER_CLOSE_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  items: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  itemsInForce: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  noticesHeld: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type OrderSummary = z.infer<typeof OrderSummary>;

/** GET /api/staff/orders: the orders that are not closed, the nearest deadline first, and those closed in the last 30 days. */
export const OrdersPage = z.strictObject({ open: z.array(OrderSummary), closed: z.array(OrderSummary) });
export type OrdersPage = z.infer<typeof OrdersPage>;

/** The stored states of a post, as an order's item reads them live. */
export const ORDER_ITEM_POST_STATES = ["visible", "withheld", "removed", "deleted_by_author", "disabled"] as const;

/** One item of an order: its link as named, what it resolved to (read live), and what became of it. */
export const OrderItemView = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  position: z.number().int().min(1).max(ORDER_ITEMS_MAX),
  link: z.string(),
  linkKind: z.enum(ORDER_LINK_KINDS),
  addedAt: At,
  /** The order is not verified, or the item was added after its verification. */
  unverified: z.boolean(),
  postId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  /** Null when the link named no post; the preview only while the post is public, and never an image. */
  post: z
    .strictObject({
      authorHandle: z.string().nullable(),
      state: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_POST_STATES),
      images: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
      preview: z.string().nullable(),
      createdAt: At,
      deletedOn: z.iso.date().nullable(),
    })
    .nullable(),
  decisionId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  caseId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  inForce: z.boolean(),
  disabledAt: At.nullable(),
  noEffect: z.enum(["deleted", "already"]).nullable(),
  preserveUntil: At.nullable(),
  preserveEndedAt: At.nullable(),
  /**
   * Task 4 (sections 6.4 and 8.5, [item.erased]): when the preservation's end erased the post's content, the same instant
   * as preserveEndedAt; null while nothing was erased, and when the preservation ended without an erasure (a
   * reinstatement, a correction to another kind, or a measure no longer in force).
   */
  erasedAt: At.nullable(),
  reinstatedAt: At.nullable(),
  reinstatedGround: z.enum(ORDER_GROUNDS).nullable(),
  closedAt: At.nullable(),
  closedReason: z.enum(ORDER_ITEM_CLOSE_REASONS).nullable(),
  /** True when an open restore gap names the item (Task 6 builds the gaps); false until then. */
  gap: z.boolean(),
});
export type OrderItemView = z.infer<typeof OrderItemView>;

/** One event of an order: who wrote it as a staff handle, or null for the command line and the database. */
export const OrderEventView = z.strictObject({
  id: z.uuid(),
  kind: z.enum(ORDER_EVENT_KINDS),
  ground: z.string().nullable(),
  at: At,
  effectiveAt: At.nullable(),
  itemId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  by: z.string().nullable(),
  via: z.enum(ORDER_EVENT_VIA),
});
export type OrderEventView = z.infer<typeof OrderEventView>;

/** What the command line still owes an order (7.5), and until when korbat may ask for a scrutiny. */
export const OrderOwed = z.strictObject({
  received: z.boolean(),
  verification: z.boolean(),
  issuedAt: z.boolean(),
  texts: z.boolean(),
  document: z.boolean(),
  holdUntil: z.boolean(),
  tellPerson: z.boolean(),
  scrutinyUntil: At.nullable(),
});
export type OrderOwed = z.infer<typeof OrderOwed>;

/** An order's hold, for an order with Section C: its end (null while a DSA order's has none recorded) and what became of it. */
export const OrderHold = z.strictObject({
  until: At.nullable(),
  basis: z.enum(HOLD_BASES),
  open: z.boolean(),
  extended: z.boolean(),
  endedAt: At.nullable(),
  endReason: z.enum(HOLD_END_REASONS).nullable(),
  releasedAt: At.nullable(),
  noticesHeld: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
});
export type OrderHold = z.infer<typeof OrderHold>;

/**
 * GET /api/staff/orders/:order: the summary with its items as a list, the row's facts, the events oldest first, what the
 * command line owes, the hold, and the console's aids (the database decides). No text of reasons, redress, scope,
 * verified_how or hold_basis: those are the command line's, and the author's notice is where the first three are read.
 */
export const OrderView = OrderSummary.extend({
  channel: z.enum(ORDER_CHANNELS),
  messageId: z.uuid().nullable(),
  receivedAt: At.nullable(),
  sentAt: At.nullable(),
  issuedAt: At.nullable(),
  sectionC: z.boolean(),
  emergency: z.boolean(),
  crossBorder: z.boolean(),
  withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
  preserve: z.boolean(),
  openedBy: z.string().nullable(),
  openedVia: z.enum(["console", "cli"]),
  importedAt: At.nullable(),
  tellPerson: z.strictObject({ rule: z.enum(TELL_PERSON_RULES), at: At.nullable() }).nullable(),
  items: z.array(OrderItemView).max(ORDER_ITEMS_MAX),
  events: z.array(OrderEventView),
  owed: OrderOwed,
  hold: OrderHold.nullable(),
  mayClose: z.boolean(),
  mayEvents: z.array(z.enum(ORDER_CONSOLE_EVENTS)),
  mayCorrect: z.enum(ORDER_CORRECTION_RULES).nullable(),
});
export type OrderView = z.infer<typeof OrderView>;

/** The one refusal of 3f that carries a member: order_exists names the order that stands, so the console links to it. */
export const OrderExistsDetails = z.strictObject({ orderId: z.uuid() });
export type OrderExistsDetails = z.infer<typeof OrderExistsDetails>;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- giving effect (Task 3: 7.6, 7.9, 10.1, 10.3, 10.4)

/**
 * What an order decision is by its order's kind (10.1), which decisions_record forces and OrderEffectedParams therefore
 * does not carry. The category of a DSA Article 9 order is a filler for a column that may not be null: korbat did not
 * assess the content, and nothing reads the column for such a decision. A dsa_art10 order is never given effect.
 */
export const ORDER_DECISION = {
  tco_removal: { category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY", keyword: "KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT", preserves: true, effectBeforeVerified: true, holdBasis: "regulation" },
  dsa_art9: { category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE", keyword: null, preserves: false, effectBeforeVerified: false, holdBasis: "authority" },
} as const;

/** One item of an effect: an order's item and the post it names, both in lower case. */
const EffectItem = z.strictObject({ itemId: LowerUuid, postId: LowerUuid });

/**
 * The step-up params of order_effected (10.3): the order's facts as the console showed them, `urgent` and the items, 1 to
 * itemsPerAction, sorted by postId with no repeat of either id, so one action has one hash and its order is the lock
 * order. `authority` and `reference` are the one named exception to the rule that a param is never a free string: an
 * authority's name and its file number, bound as an order's lines are, which decision_holds compares with the order's
 * row at commit. `withholdFromAuthor` is true for a removal order and whenever Section C is set, and `urgent` is refused
 * for a removal order (the database refuses it on a verified order too).
 */
export const OrderEffectedParams = z
  .strictObject({
    kind: z.enum(["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"]),
    memberState: MemberStateCode,
    authority: OrderAuthority,
    reference: OrderReference,
    sectionC: z.boolean(),
    emergency: z.boolean(),
    withholdFromAuthor: z.boolean(),
    urgent: z.boolean(),
    items: z.array(EffectItem).min(1).max(ORDER_RULES.itemsPerAction),
  })
  .superRefine((params, ctx) => {
    if ((params.kind === "tco_removal" || params.sectionC) && !params.withholdFromAuthor) {
      ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["withholdFromAuthor"], message: "a removal order, and an order whose author must not be told, keeps the post from its author" });
    }
    if (params.kind === "tco_removal" && params.urgent) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["urgent"], message: "a removal order is given effect without a check first: urgent means nothing for it" });
    const posts = params.items.map((item) => item.postId);
    if (posts.some((post, i) => i > 0 && posts[i - 1]! >= post)) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["items"], message: "the items are sorted by post, without repeats" });
    if (!distinct(params.items.map((item) => item.itemId))) ctx.addIssue({ code: "custom", path: ["items"], message: "an item is named once" });
  });
export type OrderEffectedParams = z.infer<typeof OrderEffectedParams>;

/**
 * The fixed reasons of a reinstatement (W.2's reinstated.<ground>), which the composer saves as the correction's reason
 * and which nobody edits: a free text beside an order could say what a non-disclosure decision forbids.
 */
export const ORDER_DRAFTS = {
  reinstate: {
    withdrawn: "The authority that issued the order withdrew it.",
    annulled: "A court annulled the order.",
    scrutiny:
      "The competent authority of korbat's own Member State scrutinised the order and decided that it infringes the Regulation or fundamental rights, so the order no longer has effect (Article 4 of Regulation (EU) 2021/784).",
    not_authentic: "The order was not authentic: it did not come from the authority it named. korbat disabled your post on a forged order, and regrets it.",
    wrong_item: "korbat made a mistake: the order did not name this post. korbat disabled it wrongly, and regrets it.",
  },
} as const satisfies { reinstate: Record<OrderGround, string> };

const Day = z.string().regex(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/, "must be a UTC day");

/**
 * What an order's notice is rendered from (10.4, W.2), built by the API at every read from the decision's row, its item's
 * and the order's as they stand, so the notice grows without a new decision. `verified` says whether order-verify has
 * run (until then the lead says only that the order names that authority); `orderedOn` is the day of the order's own
 * time stamp (`orderedFrom` issued) or of its receipt (received), or null; `held` whether the notice was held, and
 * `informedAt` the one instant the author was told (the release, for a held one); `holdEndReason` a hold ended by hand.
 */
export const OrderNoticeFacts = z.object({
  kind: z.enum(["tco_removal", "dsa_art9"]),
  memberState: MemberStateCode,
  authority: z.string(),
  reference: z.string(),
  verified: z.boolean(),
  orderedOn: Day.nullable(),
  orderedFrom: z.enum(["issued", "received"]).nullable(),
  crossBorder: z.boolean(),
  homeState: MemberStateCode.nullable(),
  withholdAuthor: z.boolean(),
  disabledAt: At,
  held: z.boolean(),
  informedAt: At.nullable(),
  holdEndReason: z.enum(HOLD_END_REASONS).nullable(),
  preserveUntil: At.nullable(),
  preserveExtended: z.boolean(),
  preserveEndedOn: Day.nullable(),
  orderGround: z.enum(ORDER_GROUNDS).nullable(),
});
export type OrderNoticeFacts = z.infer<typeof OrderNoticeFacts>;

/** The authority's words as the command line recorded them, read fresh, and since when the author holds the newest (10.4). */
export const OrderTexts = z.object({ reasons: z.string().nullable(), redress: z.string().nullable(), scope: z.string().nullable(), textsAt: At.nullable() });
export type OrderTexts = z.infer<typeof OrderTexts>;

/** Home's [home.unverified] (10.2): the orders with a disabled item that are not verified, or whose disabled item was added after the check. */
export const OrdersUnverified = z.object({ total: z.number().int().nonnegative(), items: z.array(z.object({ orderId: z.uuid(), effectAt: At })).max(100) });
export type OrdersUnverified = z.infer<typeof OrdersUnverified>;

/**
 * Task 5 (sections 7.13 and 10.2): what `reports_owed()` answers and nothing more, for Home's [home.owed]: each owed
 * notification record's case, its kind (`sealed_images` for a seal's record, otherwise its first duty) and since when.
 * Who was reported to whom is the command line's alone.
 */
export const REPORT_OWED_KINDS = ["sealed_images", ...NOTIFICATION_DUTIES] as const;
export const ReportsOwed = z.object({
  total: z.number().int().nonnegative(),
  items: z.array(z.object({ caseId: z.uuid(), kind: z.enum(REPORT_OWED_KINDS), since: At })).max(100),
});
export type ReportsOwed = z.infer<typeof ReportsOwed>;
```

### Replace `packages/db/src/schema/auth.ts` (whole file)

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { bigint, bigserial, boolean, check, foreignKey, index, integer, jsonb, pgPolicy, pgSchema, primaryKey, text, unique, uniqueIndex, uuid } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { authRole, bytea, emptyTextArray, fullAccess, ts } from "./helpers";

export const auth = pgSchema("auth");

export const emailCodePurpose = auth.enum("email_code_purpose", ["signup", "login", "change_email", "recovery", "reauth", "delete_account"]);

export const userRole = auth.enum("user_role", ["user", "moderator", "admin"]);

export const authEventType = auth.enum("auth_event_type", [
  "signup",
  "signin_success",
  "signin_failure",
  "mfa_enabled",
  "mfa_disabled",
  "recovery_code_used",
  "recovery_codes_regenerated",
  "password_set",
  "password_changed",
  "session_revoked",
  "sessions_revoked_all",
  "account_locked",
  "new_device",
  "not_me",
  "profile_updated",
  "handle_changed",
  "email_changed",
  "badge_verified",
  "badge_removed",
  "export_created",
  "account_deleted",
  "passkey_added",
  "passkey_removed",
  "passkey_counter_regression",
  // The staff console (3a design, section 6).
  "staff_enrollment_issued",
  "staff_key_added",
  "staff_key_revoked",
  "staff_key_counter_regression",
  "staff_sign_in",
  "staff_signed_out",
  "staff_session_revoked",
]);

export const users = auth.table(
  "users",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    email: text("email").notNull(),
    emailVerifiedAt: ts("email_verified_at"),
    /** Salted hash; the raw phone number is discarded after OTP verification. */
    phoneHash: text("phone_hash"),
    /** argon2id encoded string, null for passkey-only accounts. */
    passwordHash: text("password_hash"),
    /** Encrypted with the server-side key; never stored in clear. */
    totpSecretEnc: text("totp_secret_enc"),
    totpEnabledAt: ts("totp_enabled_at"),
    recoveryCodesHash: text("recovery_codes_hash").array().notNull().default(emptyTextArray),
    failedLogins: integer("failed_logins").notNull().default(0),
    lockedUntil: ts("locked_until"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    deletedAt: ts("deleted_at"),
    role: userRole("role").notNull().default("user"),
    /** When the 16+ check passed. Date of birth itself is never stored. */
    ageConfirmedAt: ts("age_confirmed_at"),
    termsVersion: text("terms_version"),
    termsAcceptedAt: ts("terms_accepted_at"),
    /** Set once the public profile (handle) exists. */
    onboardedAt: ts("onboarded_at"),
    passwordChangedAt: ts("password_changed_at"),
    /** Last accepted TOTP time step; a code for this step or earlier is rejected (replay protection). */
    totpLastStep: bigint("totp_last_step", { mode: "number" }),
    /**
     * When the purge after deletion finished anonymising this row. deleted_at means the owner confirmed
     * deletion and the account is gone for every purpose; purged_at null with deleted_at set means the purge
     * job still has work to do.
     */
    purgedAt: ts("purged_at"),
    /**
     * The WebAuthn user handle: 32 random bytes that every passkey of the account carries and a discoverable passkey
     * returns at sign-in. Never the account id, so a password manager's records say nothing about the account. Null
     * until the first passkey is added; the passkey flows set it once with a compare-and-set, and the account's
     * deletion clears it (1c design, sections 6 and 7.7).
     */
    webauthnUserId: bytea("webauthn_user_id"),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("users_email_lower_idx").on(sql`lower(${t.email})`),
    /** One phone number per account, as a database fact; accounts without a number stay out of the index. */
    uniqueIndex("users_phone_hash_idx").on(t.phoneHash).where(sql`phone_hash is not null`),
    /** A user handle names one account; accounts without passkeys stay out of the index. */
    uniqueIndex("users_webauthn_user_id_idx").on(t.webauthnUserId).where(sql`webauthn_user_id is not null`),
    fullAccess("users_auth_all", authRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

export const devices = auth.table(
  "devices",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    deviceHash: text("device_hash").notNull(),
    label: text("label"),
    /** 'web' | 'ios' | 'android' */
    platform: text("platform").notNull(),
    firstSeenAt: ts("first_seen_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    lastSeenAt: ts("last_seen_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Salted hash; purged by the 30-day job. Raw IPs are never stored. */
    ipHash: text("ip_hash"),
    revokedAt: ts("revoked_at"),
  },
  (t) => [index("devices_user_idx").on(t.userId), index("devices_ip_hash_idx").on(t.ipHash), fullAccess("devices_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

export const sessions = auth.table(
  "sessions",
  {
    /** sha256 hex of the opaque token handed to the client. The token itself is never stored. */
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    deviceId: uuid("device_id").notNull().references(() => devices.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Sliding expiry, extended on use. */
    expiresAt: ts("expires_at").notNull(),
    /** Hard cap, never extended. */
    absoluteExpiresAt: ts("absolute_expires_at").notNull(),
    lastUsedAt: ts("last_used_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    revokedAt: ts("revoked_at"),
    /** Last time the user proved possession of a credential on this session: the latest of `factors`. */
    reauthAt: ts("reauth_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /**
     * A random id the session keeps for its whole life, while the token and with it `id` rotate. The re-authentication
     * limits and the passkey challenges are keyed by it, so a rotation cannot reset them and no other session can
     * spend them.
     */
    handle: uuid("handle").notNull().defaultRandom(),
    /**
     * The factors this session has proven and when: kind (email, password, totp, recovery, passkey, passkey_uv) to
     * epoch milliseconds. Sessions from before migration 0010 have none and re-authenticate before a sensitive action.
     */
    factors: jsonb("factors").$type<Record<string, number>>().notNull().default(sql`'{}'::jsonb`),
    /** The passkey that started this session, for the lockdown and the Security list; it outlives the passkey. */
    passkeyId: uuid("passkey_id").references(() => passkeys.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
  },
  (t) => [index("sessions_user_idx").on(t.userId), uniqueIndex("sessions_handle_idx").on(t.handle), fullAccess("sessions_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

export const emailCodes = auth.table(
  "email_codes",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    email: text("email").notNull(),
    codeHash: text("code_hash").notNull(),
    purpose: emailCodePurpose("purpose").notNull(),
    expiresAt: ts("expires_at").notNull(),
    attempts: integer("attempts").notNull().default(0),
    consumedAt: ts("consumed_at"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** Random id returned to the client; a code can only complete the flow that requested it. */
    flowId: text("flow_id").notNull(),
    ipHash: text("ip_hash"),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("email_codes_email_idx").on(t.email),
    uniqueIndex("email_codes_flow_idx").on(t.flowId),
    fullAccess("email_codes_auth_all", authRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

export const passkeys = auth.table(
  "passkeys",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    credentialId: text("credential_id").notNull(),
    /** base64url COSE public key */
    publicKey: text("public_key").notNull(),
    counter: bigint("counter", { mode: "number" }).notNull().default(0),
    transports: text("transports").array().notNull().default(emptyTextArray),
    backedUp: boolean("backed_up").notNull().default(false),
    name: text("name").notNull(),
    /** Written from the flows' clock, like password_changed_at, because the lockdown compares it with flow times. */
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    lastUsedAt: ts("last_used_at"),
    /** The authenticator model the registration reported (all zeros for most synced passkeys); null when none was given. */
    aaguid: uuid("aaguid"),
    /** The BE flag at registration: the key may be synced to other devices. backed_up is the BS flag, which can change. */
    backupEligible: boolean("backup_eligible").notNull().default(false),
    /** The registration verified the user (UV flag); only then does a verified sign-in with it count as two factors. */
    uvInitialized: boolean("uv_initialized").notNull().default(false),
    /** The device whose session added it, for the Security list; it outlives the device. */
    createdDeviceId: uuid("created_device_id").references(() => devices.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    /** When a sign-in showed a signature counter that went backwards (a copy of the key may exist); refused from then on. */
    suspectAt: ts("suspect_at"),
  },
  (t) => [uniqueIndex("passkeys_credential_idx").on(t.credentialId), index("passkeys_user_idx").on(t.userId), fullAccess("passkeys_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

/** Append-only security log. UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE are also revoked at the grant level (migration 0003). */
export const authEvents = auth.table(
  "auth_events",
  {
    id: bigserial("id", { mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
    type: authEventType("type").notNull(),
    deviceId: uuid("device_id"),
    ipHash: text("ip_hash"),
    metadata: jsonb("metadata").notNull().default(sql`'{}'::jsonb`),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    index("auth_events_user_created_idx").on(t.userId, t.createdAt),
    pgPolicy("auth_events_auth_insert", { for: "insert", to: authRole, withCheck: sql`true` }),
    pgPolicy("auth_events_auth_select", { for: "select", to: authRole, using: sql`true` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * Staff keys (3a design, section 6): WebAuthn credentials on the staff console's relying party, which alone open it. Only
 * keys whose registration reported user verification and no backup eligibility exist. They are added only by the
 * migrator-owned function auth.add_staff_key, which spends an enrolment the command line issued; migration 0012 leaves the
 * auth role SELECT and UPDATE of counter, last_used_at, revoked_at and suspect_at, and a trigger refuses to clear or change a
 * set revoked_at or suspect_at. A row is never deleted: audit-verify checks old confirmations against its public key,
 * owner, origin and relying party ID, so revocation and an account's take-down only set revoked_at.
 */
export const staffKeys = auth.table(
  "staff_keys",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    /** On delete restrict: the development cleaner, which deletes accounts, must never take a key with them. */
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    credentialId: text("credential_id").notNull(),
    /** base64url COSE public key */
    publicKey: text("public_key").notNull(),
    counter: bigint("counter", { mode: "number" }).notNull().default(0),
    transports: text("transports").array().notNull().default(emptyTextArray),
    /** What the key's holder called it at enrolment; blanked with the AAGUID and transports when the account is deleted. */
    name: text("name").notNull(),
    /** The authenticator model the registration reported; null when none was given, and after the account's deletion. */
    aaguid: uuid("aaguid"),
    /** The console's origin and relying party ID when the key was enrolled, copied from its enrolment. */
    origin: text("origin").notNull(),
    rpId: text("rp_id").notNull(),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    lastUsedAt: ts("last_used_at"),
    /** Set once and never cleared: the key opens and confirms nothing more. A key is live while this is null. */
    revokedAt: ts("revoked_at"),
    /** Set together with revoked_at when a signature counter went backwards: a revoked key whose record says why. */
    suspectAt: ts("suspect_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("staff_keys_credential_idx").on(t.credentialId),
    index("staff_keys_user_idx").on(t.userId),
    // The pair the staff sessions' foreign key names, so a session's key always belongs to its account.
    unique("staff_keys_id_user_id_unique").on(t.id, t.userId),
    check("staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked", sql`${t.suspectAt} is null or ${t.revokedAt} is not null`),
    fullAccess("staff_keys_auth_all", authRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * One-time enrolment links (3a design, section 6), issued only by `staff.js enroll` as the migrator and spent only by
 * auth.add_staff_key. Only the sha256 of the link's token is kept. The auth role may read them and delete them (cancelling an
 * open one, or the janitor removing a spent one), nothing else; a set used_at is never cleared.
 */
export const staffEnrollments = auth.table(
  "staff_enrollments",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    tokenHash: text("token_hash").notNull(),
    /** CONSOLE_ORIGIN and the console's relying party ID when the link was issued; a link for a moved console enrols nothing. */
    origin: text("origin").notNull(),
    rpId: text("rp_id").notNull(),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    expiresAt: ts("expires_at").notNull(),
    usedAt: ts("used_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("staff_enrollments_token_hash_idx").on(t.tokenHash),
    index("staff_enrollments_user_idx").on(t.userId),
    fullAccess("staff_enrollments_auth_all", authRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * Staff sessions (3a design, section 6), apart from the app's sessions: 12 hours absolute and 15 minutes idle, read from the
 * database on every request. The database keeps a row within 12 hours of its creation whoever writes it.
 */
export const staffSessions = auth.table(
  "staff_sessions",
  {
    /** sha256 hex of the opaque token in the staff cookie. The token itself is never stored. */
    id: text("id").primaryKey(),
    /** A random id for the session's whole life: the console lists and revokes sessions by it, and step-up binds to it. */
    handle: uuid("handle").notNull().defaultRandom(),
    userId: uuid("user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    /** The staff key that opened the session; its foreign key below also names the account. */
    keyId: uuid("key_id").notNull(),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** The person's last action in the console, never a request the page sent by itself. */
    lastUsedAt: ts("last_used_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    idleExpiresAt: ts("idle_expires_at").notNull(),
    absoluteExpiresAt: ts("absolute_expires_at").notNull(),
    revokedAt: ts("revoked_at"),
    /** The coarse label deviceLabel gives ("Firefox on Linux"); never the user agent itself, never an address. */
    browser: text("browser").notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [
    uniqueIndex("staff_sessions_handle_idx").on(t.handle),
    index("staff_sessions_user_idx").on(t.userId),
    foreignKey({ name: "staff_sessions_key_user_fk", columns: [t.keyId, t.userId], foreignColumns: [staffKeys.id, staffKeys.userId] }).onDelete("cascade"),
    check(
      "staff_sessions_lifetime",
      sql`${t.absoluteExpiresAt} <= ${t.createdAt} + interval '12 hours' and ${t.idleExpiresAt} <= ${t.absoluteExpiresAt}`,
    ),
    fullAccess("staff_sessions_auth_all", authRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * What a signed-out notifier gave to be told about their notice (3c design, section 6.1): a name and an address, each
 * encrypted under NOTIFIER_ENC_KEY, a keyed hash of the address for the caps and for suppression, and the contact's mail
 * token. The public intake row holds only this row's id, which the moderation module chose, and the API role reaches none
 * of this. Migration 0015 leaves the auth role SELECT, INSERT, DELETE and UPDATE of forget_after only, so a contact is
 * never re-encrypted.
 */
export const notifierContacts = auth.table(
  "notifier_contacts",
  {
    /** Chosen by the moderation module: the intake row names it before the contact is stored. */
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey(),
    nameEnc: text("name_enc"),
    emailEnc: text("email_enc"),
    emailHash: text("email_hash"),
    /** The contact's mail token, which alone confirms or stops the address; null without an address. */
    mailTokenEnc: text("mail_token_enc"),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** When the janitor deletes the row: 13 months after creation unless the notice is still owed something. */
    forgetAfter: ts("forget_after").notNull(),
  },
  () => [fullAccess("notifier_contacts_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

/** An address a notifier confirmed, by its keyed hash, for 30 days. */
export const notifierConfirmations = auth.table(
  "notifier_confirmations",
  {
    emailHash: text("email_hash").primaryKey(),
    confirmedAt: ts("confirmed_at").notNull(),
    expiresAt: ts("expires_at").notNull(),
  },
  () => [fullAccess("notifier_confirmations_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

/** An address that asked korbat to stop its report mails, by its keyed hash. Its notices are still processed. */
export const notifierSuppressions = auth.table(
  "notifier_suppressions",
  {
    emailHash: text("email_hash").primaryKey(),
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  () => [fullAccess("notifier_suppressions_auth_all", authRole)],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The personal accounts the operator linked to a staff account, so that a staff member never decides where an account of
 * their own is a party. Only `staff.js link` and `unlink` write it, as the migrator, and only migrator-owned definer
 * functions read it: migration 0015 revokes everything from the auth role, and the one policy, which the rule that every
 * table has one asks for, lets that role see no row. On delete restrict: the development cleaner must not take a link
 * with an account.
 */
export const staffPersonalAccounts = auth.table(
  "staff_personal_accounts",
  {
    staffUserId: uuid("staff_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    personalUserId: uuid("personal_user_id").notNull().references(() => users.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    linkedAt: ts("linked_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
  },
  (t) => [
    primaryKey({ columns: [t.staffUserId, t.personalUserId] }),
    check("staff_personal_accounts_differ", sql`${t.staffUserId} <> ${t.personalUserId}`),
    pgPolicy("staff_personal_accounts_auth_none", { for: "select", to: authRole, using: sql`false` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * 3f (design, sections 6.5 and 7.15): the hold of an account's address while a report of its sealed images is owed. One
 * row an account, written only by the trigger report_open(), report_close_unsealed() and the command line, as the
 * migrator: migration 0030 revokes everything from the auth role, which reads it only through auth.address_held,
 * auth.address_held_until and auth.address_hold_final, and its one policy lets that role see no row. It holds no
 * address: the address stays in auth.users until finishPurge's second statement finds no hold. A hold reads as held
 * while it is not released and set_at + reportHoldDays is ahead; after that it releases nothing by itself.
 */
export const reportHolds = auth.table(
  "report_holds",
  {
    /** No foreign key: the row outlives nothing, and the record that set it names the account by its id too. */
    userId: uuid("user_id").primaryKey(),
    setAt: ts("set_at").notNull(),
    /** False while only a seal taken while deciding holds the record; true once a seal for good does. */
    sealFinal: boolean("seal_final").notNull(),
    releasedAt: ts("released_at"),
    releaseReason: text("release_reason"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("report_holds_release_reason", sql`${t.releaseReason} in ('sent', 'declined', 'expired')`),
    // A row inserted only to be locked is released with no reason; a reason is only ever given with its time.
    check("report_holds_released", sql`${t.releaseReason} is null or ${t.releasedAt} is not null`),
    pgPolicy("report_holds_auth_none", { for: "select", to: authRole, using: sql`false` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();
```

```ts
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import { bigint, bigserial, boolean, check, index, integer, jsonb, pgPolicy, pgTable, smallint, text, unique, uniqueIndex, uuid } from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";
import { apiRole, fullAccess, notifyRole, ts } from "./helpers";
import { profiles } from "./identity";

/**
 * Append-only, and since 3a a hash chain (3a design, section 6): the record of every staff action. UPDATE, DELETE and
 * TRUNCATE are revoked from the API role at the grant level (migration 0001). The trigger audit_chain, which migration 0012
 * installs and the migrator owns, sets id, created_at and the four chain columns of every inserted row, whatever the insert
 * supplied, under a lock on audit_head that lasts until the inserting transaction ends: an audit row is always the last
 * statement of its transaction.
 */
export const auditLog = pgTable(
  "audit_log",
  {
    id: bigserial("id", { mode: "number" }).primaryKey(),
    actorId: uuid("actor_id").notNull(),
    action: text("action").notNull(),
    targetType: text("target_type"),
    targetId: text("target_id"),
    metadata: jsonb("metadata").notNull().default(sql`'{}'::jsonb`),
    requestId: text("request_id"),
    /** When the row joined the chain, in milliseconds: the trigger sets it. */
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull().defaultNow(),
    /** The handle of the staff session the action came from. */
    staffSession: uuid("staff_session"),
    /** The staff key: the one a step-up confirmed with, or the key a key's row is about. */
    keyId: uuid("key_id"),
    /** The lower-case hex sha256 of the confirmed action's sorted JSON, when a step-up confirmed it. */
    actionHash: text("action_hash"),
    /** The step-up assertion (authenticatorData, clientDataJSON, signature), base64url exactly as the browser sent them. */
    stepUp: jsonb("step_up").$type<{ authenticatorData: string; clientDataJSON: string; signature: string }>(),
    // The chain. The defaults are placeholders the trigger always overwrites: they keep drizzle's insert type from asking
    // for these columns and let migration 0012 add them over existing rows.
    /** The canonical text's version the row was hashed with. */
    chainVersion: smallint("chain_version").notNull().default(0),
    /** The row's place: the order in which inserts took the head's lock, from 1, with no gap. */
    chainSeq: bigint("chain_seq", { mode: "number" }).notNull().default(0),
    /** The hash of the row before it; 64 zeros for the first. */
    prevHash: text("prev_hash").notNull().default(""),
    /** sha256 hex of prev_hash followed by the row's canonical text. */
    hash: text("hash").notNull().default(""),
  },
  (t) => [
    // Serves the viewer and audit-verify. Migration 0012 creates it after the back-fill, which the placeholders would fail.
    uniqueIndex("audit_log_chain_seq_idx").on(t.chainSeq),
    // A step-up leaves its action's hash and its assertion together, with the key that made it.
    check("audit_log_step_up_complete", sql`(${t.actionHash} is null) = (${t.stepUp} is null) and (${t.actionHash} is null or ${t.keyId} is not null)`),
    pgPolicy("audit_log_api_insert", { for: "insert", to: apiRole, withCheck: sql`true` }),
    pgPolicy("audit_log_api_select", { for: "select", to: apiRole, using: sql`true` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The newest row of the audit chain: its place and hash, or (1, 0, 64 zeros) for an empty log. One row, which only the
 * trigger moves. The API role may read it (audit-head and audit-verify check that it names the newest row) but neither write
 * nor lock it: migration 0012 revokes every other privilege, and SELECT ... FOR UPDATE needs UPDATE.
 */
export const auditHead = pgTable(
  "audit_head",
  {
    id: smallint("id").primaryKey(),
    seq: bigint("seq", { mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    hash: text("hash").notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [check("audit_head_single_row", sql`${t.id} = 1`), pgPolicy("audit_head_api_select", { for: "select", to: apiRole, using: sql`true` })],
).enableRLS();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the contact point and the alert channel (3f design, section 6.1)

/**
 * One message at the authorities' contact point, one row a message, which the watcher (role korbat_notify) inserts with
 * four columns: the folder, the two numbers IMAP gives it and the mail host's time of final delivery. It holds no sender,
 * no subject and no content. The triggers of the migration messages_alerts force `seen_at` and `stale`, store a
 * `received_at` ahead of the database's clock as the clock's time, and write the first push's row of alert_outbox; the
 * API sets a disposition once, with who set it, and the trigger stamps when. Each closed list here is written from the
 * contracts' constant of the same name, and a database test holds the two to each other.
 */
export const contactMessages = pgTable(
  "contact_messages",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    /** `inbox` or `junk`: the folder the watcher read it in. */
    folder: text("folder").notNull(),
    /** The folder's UIDVALIDITY and the message's UID: unique together with the folder. */
    uidvalidity: bigint("uidvalidity", { mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    uid: bigint("uid", { mode: "number" }).notNull(),
    /** The IMAP internal date, the time of final delivery at the mail host; never later than the database's clock. */
    receivedAt: ts("received_at").notNull(),
    /** Forced: clock_timestamp() at the insert. */
    seenAt: ts("seen_at").notNull(),
    /** Forced: received more than order_rules().stale_hours before it was seen, which raises no push. */
    stale: boolean("stale").notNull(),
    /** Null, or what the message turned out to be (CONTACT_DISPOSITIONS); once set it never changes. */
    disposition: text("disposition"),
    handledBy: uuid("handled_by").references(() => profiles.id, { onDelete: "restrict" }),
    /** Forced when the disposition is set. */
    handledAt: ts("handled_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    unique("contact_messages_uid_key").on(t.folder, t.uidvalidity, t.uid),
    check("contact_messages_folder", sql`${t.folder} in ('inbox', 'junk')`),
    check("contact_messages_disposition", sql`${t.disposition} in ('order', 'referral', 'first_order_notice', 'preservation_request', 'scrutiny_decision', 'clarification', 'not_an_order')`),
    check("contact_messages_handled", sql`(${t.disposition} is null) = (${t.handledAt} is null)`),
    /** The Contact point screen, newest first by the time of receipt. */
    index("contact_messages_received_idx").on(t.receivedAt, t.id),
    /** The messages nobody handled: the home screen's count and the alert steps' subjects. */
    index("contact_messages_open_idx").on(t.receivedAt).where(sql`disposition is null`),
    fullAccess("contact_messages_api_all", apiRole),
    fullAccess("contact_messages_notify_all", notifyRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * One alert with its two legs: the watcher publishes its push (`pushed_at`), and the API mails it (`mailed_at`) when its
 * kind's mail is its sentence. Its facts are counts and times only. The subject of a time-driven alert (a message or an
 * order) has no foreign key, so a record's erasure never waits for an alert's row. Every row's created_at, pushed_at,
 * mailed_at and push_attempts are forced at insert for every role. The unique key of a time-driven alert's step,
 * alert_outbox_step_key (kind, message_id, order_id, step) NULLS NOT DISTINCT WHERE step IS NOT NULL, is made by hand in
 * the migration: drizzle cannot write NULLS NOT DISTINCT on a partial index.
 */
export const alertOutbox = pgTable(
  "alert_outbox",
  {
    id: bigint("id", { mode: "number" }).primaryKey().generatedAlwaysAsIdentity(),
    /** One of the contracts' ALERT_KIND_LIST. */
    kind: text("kind").notNull(),
    /** 3 or 5, ntfy's default and highest priority. */
    priority: smallint("priority").notNull(),
    /** The push topic: the phone on call, or every staff phone. */
    scope: text("scope").notNull(),
    /** Null for an alert an event raised; a running number from 0, counted for each kind and subject, for a time-driven one. */
    step: smallint("step"),
    facts: jsonb("facts").$type<Record<string, number | string>>().notNull(),
    messageId: uuid("message_id"),
    orderId: uuid("order_id"),
    /** Forced: clock_timestamp(). */
    createdAt: ts("created_at").notNull(),
    pushedAt: ts("pushed_at"),
    mailedAt: ts("mailed_at"),
    /** A count of failed publishes, for the log; no cap. */
    pushAttempts: integer("push_attempts").notNull(),
  },
  (t) => [
    check(
      "alert_outbox_kind",
      sql`${t.kind} in ('contact_mail', 'contact_mail_escalated', 'order_due', 'order_opened', 'order_corrected', 'order_effected', 'order_reinstated', 'order_unverified', 'hold_ending', 'report_owed', 'handover_undestroyed', 'copy_overdue', 'copy_taken', 'alert_channel_down', 'mailbox_unreachable', 'alert_test', 'moderation_urgent', 'moderation_waiting', 'moderation_burst', 'moderation_reads', 'moderation_reveal', 'moderation_csam_lifted')`,
    ),
    check("alert_outbox_priority", sql`${t.priority} in (3, 5)`),
    check("alert_outbox_scope", sql`${t.scope} in ('on_call', 'all')`),
    check("alert_outbox_step", sql`${t.step} is null or ${t.step} >= 0`),
    // Counts and times only: an object of at most six members, each a number or a string of the form of an instant in UTC.
    // The paths are strict: in lax mode a member's list would be unwrapped and its numbers read as members.
    check(
      "alert_outbox_facts",
      sql`jsonb_typeof(${t.facts}) = 'object' and jsonb_array_length(jsonb_path_query_array(${t.facts}, 'strict $.*')) <= 6 and not jsonb_path_exists(${t.facts}, 'strict $.* ? (@.type() != "number" && !(@.type() == "string" && @ like_regex "^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}([.][0-9]{1,6})?Z$"))')`,
    ),
    /** The rows the watcher may still owe a push, oldest first. */
    index("alert_outbox_push_idx").on(t.createdAt).where(sql`pushed_at is null`),
    /** The rows the alert tick may still owe a mail. */
    index("alert_outbox_mail_idx").on(t.createdAt).where(sql`mailed_at is null`),
    fullAccess("alert_outbox_api_all", apiRole),
    fullAccess("alert_outbox_notify_all", notifyRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * The watcher's one row: its heartbeat after each round, when it last read both folders and last published (or owed
 * nothing), and the word of its last failure. The API reads it for the channel's health.
 */
export const notifyState = pgTable(
  "notify_state",
  {
    id: smallint("id").primaryKey(),
    beatAt: ts("beat_at"),
    mailboxOkAt: ts("mailbox_ok_at"),
    pushOkAt: ts("push_ok_at"),
    /** Null, or one of the contracts' NOTIFY_ERRORS. */
    error: text("error"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("notify_state_single_row", sql`${t.id} = 1`),
    check("notify_state_error", sql`${t.error} in ('imap_connect', 'imap_timeout', 'imap_tls', 'imap_login', 'imap_folder', 'imap_protocol', 'push_connect', 'push_refused')`),
    fullAccess("notify_state_api_all", apiRole),
    fullAccess("notify_state_notify_all", notifyRole),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/** The watcher's mark in each folder: the folder's UIDVALIDITY and the highest UID it has inserted. */
export const notifyFolders = pgTable(
  "notify_folders",
  {
    folder: text("folder").primaryKey(),
    uidvalidity: bigint("uidvalidity", { mode: "number" }),
    lastUid: bigint("last_uid", { mode: "number" }),
  },
  (t) => [check("notify_folders_folder", sql`${t.folder} in ('inbox', 'junk')`), fullAccess("notify_folders_api_all", apiRole), fullAccess("notify_folders_notify_all", notifyRole)],
).enableRLS();

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- records to authorities (3f design, section 6.5)
// The lists are written from the contracts' constants of the same meaning (NOTIFICATION_STATES, NOTIFICATION_DUTIES,
// NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS, NOTIFICATION_ANSWERS, NOTIFICATION_EVENT_KINDS, NOTIFICATION_OPENED_VIA,
// PRODUCTION_INSTRUMENTS, ACCESS_PURPOSES, PRODUCED_KINDS, NOT_HELD_KINDS): @korbat/db does not depend on
// @korbat/contracts, so a database test holds each migrated CHECK to its constant.
const NOTIFICATION_DUTIES = ["dsa18_1", "dsa18_2", "tco14_5", "voluntary"];
const NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS = ["handle", "address", "created_at", "post_ids", "post_times", "report_time", "files"];
const PRODUCED_KINDS = [...NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS, "content"];
const NOT_HELD_KINDS = ["name", "postal_address", "date_of_birth", "phone_number", "ip_address"];
/** The values as a SQL array of string literals: plain lower-case words of this file. */
const arrayOf = (values: readonly string[]) => sql.raw(`array[${values.map((value) => `'${value}'`).join(", ")}]::text[]`);

/**
 * One notification to an authority that is owed, sent or declined (3f design, sections 6.5 and 7.13). Only the command
 * line, as the migrator, reads and writes it, and the trigger report_open() opens one when a seal is taken: the API role
 * holds no grant, and its one policy lets it see no row. No column holds an address, a handle or a value that was sent; an
 * account, a case and a seal are named by their ids, without foreign keys, since the record outlives a purge and a case.
 * opened_at is forced, except that a row with imported_at keeps a supplied time that is not after the clock.
 */
export const authorityNotifications = pgTable(
  "authority_notifications",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    state: text("state").notNull(),
    /** The duties it meets; empty while a seal's record is only owed. */
    duties: text("duties").array().notNull().default(sql`'{}'::text[]`),
    caseId: uuid("case_id"),
    /** The seal_media row that opened it; null for one the command line opened. */
    sealActionId: uuid("seal_action_id"),
    accountId: uuid("account_id"),
    openedAt: ts("opened_at").notNull(),
    openedVia: text("opened_via").notNull(),
    /** Awareness: the first suspect report's time, and the admin's answer's. */
    firstReportAt: ts("first_report_at"),
    adminAnswerAt: ts("admin_answer_at"),
    /** The check: who, when, yes or no, why. */
    checkedBy: text("checked_by"),
    checkedAt: ts("checked_at"),
    checkResult: boolean("check_result"),
    checkReason: text("check_reason"),
    /** An ISO code and why that state; or null and why none is identifiable. */
    stateConcerned: text("state_concerned"),
    stateBasis: text("state_basis"),
    authority: text("authority"),
    channel: text("channel"),
    sentAt: ts("sent_at"),
    receipt: text("receipt"),
    sentBy: text("sent_by"),
    ownReference: text("own_reference"),
    theirReference: text("their_reference"),
    /** What was sent, by kind, never by value. */
    sentKinds: text("sent_kinds").array(),
    /** Which version of the fixed sentence of what korbat does not hold went with it (RECORDS_NOT_HELD). */
    notKeptVersion: smallint("not_kept_version"),
    /** The authority's answer as one word, and its day. */
    answer: text("answer"),
    answeredAt: ts("answered_at"),
    /** `unsealed` when the database closed it; else the operator's reason. */
    declinedReason: text("declined_reason"),
    closedAt: ts("closed_at"),
    importedAt: ts("imported_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("authority_notifications_state", sql`${t.state} in ('owed', 'sent', 'declined')`),
    check("authority_notifications_duties", sql`${t.duties} <@ ${arrayOf(NOTIFICATION_DUTIES)}`),
    check("authority_notifications_sent_kinds", sql`${t.sentKinds} <@ ${arrayOf(NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS)}`),
    check("authority_notifications_answer", sql`${t.answer} in ('not_illegal', 'illegal', 'no_assessment', 'other')`),
    check("authority_notifications_opened_via", sql`${t.openedVia} in ('system', 'cli')`),
    // A seal opens a record and names its row; the command line opens one for a duty and names no seal.
    check("authority_notifications_seal", sql`(${t.openedVia} = 'system') = (${t.sealActionId} is not null)`),
    check("authority_notifications_closed", sql`(${t.state} = 'owed') = (${t.closedAt} is null)`),
    check("authority_notifications_declined", sql`(${t.state} = 'declined') = (${t.declinedReason} is not null)`),
    check(
      "authority_notifications_sent",
      sql`${t.state} <> 'sent' or (${t.sentAt} is not null and ${t.authority} is not null and ${t.channel} is not null and ${t.sentKinds} is not null and cardinality(${t.duties}) > 0 and ${t.notKeptVersion} is not null)`,
    ),
    check("authority_notifications_answered", sql`${t.answer} is null or ${t.answeredAt} is not null`),
    check(
      "authority_notifications_texts",
      sql`char_length(${t.checkReason}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.stateBasis}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.declinedReason}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.checkedBy}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.sentBy}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.authority}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.channel}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.receipt}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.ownReference}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.theirReference}) <= 200`,
    ),
    /** One owed record a seal opened, for each account: a second seal finds it, and the trigger's lock orders the two. */
    uniqueIndex("authority_notifications_owed_seal_key").on(t.accountId).where(sql`state = 'owed' and opened_via = 'system'`),
    /** reports_owed() and the alert's count. */
    index("authority_notifications_owed_idx").on(t.openedAt).where(sql`state = 'owed'`),
    index("authority_notifications_account_idx").on(t.accountId),
    index("authority_notifications_case_idx").on(t.caseId),
    pgPolicy("authority_notifications_api_none", { for: "select", to: apiRole, using: sql`false` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * A later request or answer of the authority about a notification's matter, or the operator's note (7.13 step 6), with
 * the authority's demand that the person is not told and that demand's end, which may be open (null with the mark set).
 * `at` is forced, except for an imported record's event, which keeps a supplied time that is not after the clock.
 */
export const authorityNotificationEvents = pgTable(
  "authority_notification_events",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    notificationId: uuid("notification_id")
      .notNull()
      .references(() => authorityNotifications.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
    kind: text("kind").notNull(),
    at: ts("at").notNull(),
    /** When the request or answer was made, as the authority dated it. */
    occurredAt: ts("occurred_at"),
    reference: text("reference"),
    /** How it came and what it asked, about the act and never about the person (at most 500 characters). */
    how: text("how").notNull(),
    notToPerson: boolean("not_to_person").notNull(),
    notToPersonUntil: ts("not_to_person_until"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("authority_notification_events_kind", sql`${t.kind} in ('request', 'answer', 'note')`),
    check("authority_notification_events_until", sql`${t.notToPerson} or ${t.notToPersonUntil} is null`),
    check("authority_notification_events_texts", sql`char_length(${t.how}) between 1 and 500 and char_length(${t.reference}) <= 200`),
    index("authority_notification_events_notification_idx").on(t.notificationId, t.at),
    pgPolicy("authority_notification_events_api_none", { for: "select", to: apiRole, using: sql`false` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();

/**
 * One row for every time something leaves korbat for an authority (3f design, sections 6.5 and 7.14): account data for
 * an order or a notification, a hand-over of one seal's files, a seizure, an access to preserved content for an
 * authority. What was asked for, produced and not held is stored by kind, never as a text; a hand-over's files by name,
 * size and SHA-256. opened_at is forced as a notification's.
 */
export const productions = pgTable(
  "productions",
  {
    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
    instrument: text("instrument").notNull(),
    notificationId: uuid("notification_id"),
    orderId: uuid("order_id"),
    orderItemId: uuid("order_item_id"),
    sealActionId: uuid("seal_action_id"),
    accountId: uuid("account_id"),
    /** For preserved_access alone: why the content was opened. */
    purpose: text("purpose"),
    authority: text("authority"),
    ownReference: text("own_reference"),
    theirReference: text("their_reference"),
    asked: text("asked").array(),
    produced: text("produced").array().notNull(),
    notHeld: text("not_held").array(),
    /** A hand-over: each listed file's name, and once recorded its size and SHA-256. */
    files: jsonb("files").$type<{ name: string; bytes: number | null; sha256: string | null }[]>(),
    archiveSha256: text("archive_sha256"),
    channel: text("channel"),
    receipt: text("receipt"),
    deliveredAt: ts("delivered_at"),
    destroyedAt: ts("destroyed_at"),
    destroyedHow: text("destroyed_how"),
    notToPersonUntil: ts("not_to_person_until"),
    openedAt: ts("opened_at").notNull(),
    recordedBy: text("recorded_by"),
    importedAt: ts("imported_at"),
  },
  (t) => [
    check("productions_instrument", sql`${t.instrument} in ('notification', 'demand', 'court_order', 'seizure', 'dsa_art10', 'preserved_access')`),
    check("productions_purpose", sql`(${t.instrument} = 'preserved_access') = (${t.purpose} is not null)`),
    // Compared as text: 'authority' is also a value 3f added to an enum (intake_channel), and the enum-literal rule reads
    // the migrations' words, not their types.
    check("productions_purposes", sql`${t.purpose}::text in ('review', 'complaint', 'authority')`),
    check("productions_asked", sql`${t.asked} <@ ${arrayOf(NOTIFICATION_SENT_KINDS)}`),
    check("productions_produced", sql`${t.produced} <@ ${arrayOf(PRODUCED_KINDS)}`),
    check("productions_not_held", sql`${t.notHeld} <@ ${arrayOf(NOT_HELD_KINDS)}`),
    check("productions_archive", sql`${t.archiveSha256} ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'`),
    check("productions_files", sql`jsonb_typeof(${t.files}) = 'array'`),
    check("productions_destroyed", sql`(${t.destroyedAt} is null) = (${t.destroyedHow} is null)`),
    check(
      "productions_texts",
      sql`char_length(${t.authority}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.ownReference}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.theirReference}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.channel}) <= 200 and char_length(${t.receipt}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.destroyedHow}) <= 500 and char_length(${t.recordedBy}) <= 200`,
    ),
    /** handover_undestroyed's count, and the records command's list. */
    index("productions_undestroyed_idx").on(t.deliveredAt).where(sql`files is not null and destroyed_at is null`),
    index("productions_account_idx").on(t.accountId),
    pgPolicy("productions_api_none", { for: "select", to: apiRole, using: sql`false` }),
  ],
).enableRLS();
```
